verses.text: the book of the pedigree of Yehoshua the Moshiach, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
Abraham has fathered Isaac, and Isaac has fathered Jacob, and Jacob has fathered Yehudah and his brothers.
and Yehudah has fathered Perez and Zerach from Tamar. and Perez has fathered Hetsron, and Hetsron has fathered Ram.
and Ram has fathered Amminadav, and Amminadav has fathered Nachshon, and Nachshon has fathered Salmon,
and Salmon has fathered Boaz from Rachab, and Boaz has fathered Obed from Ruth, and Obed has fathered Jesse,
and Jesse has fathered David the king.
and Solomon has fathered Rechavam, and Rechavam has fathered Aviyah, and Aviyah has fathered Asa,
and Asa has fathered Yehoshafat, and Yehoshafat has fathered Yoram, and Yoram has fathered Uzziah,
and Uzziah has fathered Yotam, and Yotam has fathered Achaz, and Achaz has fathered Y'chizkiyahu,
and Y'chizkiyahu has fathered Menasheh, and Menasheh has fathered Amon, and Amon has fathered Yoshiyahu,
and Yoshiyahu has fathered Yechanyahu and his brothers, to the time of the deportation (to) Babylon.
and after the being taken away to Babylon has Yechanyahu fathered Shealtiel, and Shealtiel has fathered Zerubavel,
and Zerubavel has fathered Avihud, and Avihud has fathered Elikim, and Elikim has fathered Azur,
and Azur has fathered Tsadok, and Tsadok has fathered Yachin, and Yachin has fathered Elihud,
and Elihud has fathered El'azar, and El'azar has fathered Mattan, and Mattan has fathered Jacob,
and Jacob has fathered Joseph, the husband of Mary, of which there is born become Yehoshua, who is called Moshiach.

and in this way are all generations from Abraham until David fourteen generations; and from David until to the deportation (to) Babylon fourteen generations; and from the deportation (to) Babylon until to the Moshiach fourteen generations.

and the birth of Yehoshua the Moshiach is happened on such way: when his mother Mary was engaged to Joseph, before they were themselves come together, is she found having become pregnant from the Spirit the Holy.
Joseph, her husband, has however been a righteous person, and has her not wanted to put on any shame, has he plan had, quietly with her themselves to separate.

and thinking in this way about the matter, look, an angel of the L-rd (Hashem) has himself shown to him in a dream, in this way to say: Joseph son of David, fear you not to take Mary, your wife; because this, which is in her conceived become, is from the Spirit the Holy.
and she will bear a son, and you (SG) you shall call his name Yehoshua; because he will save his people from their sins.
and this all is happening, so that it may fulfilled to be, which it is said become from the L-rd (Hashem) through the prophet, in this way to say:
look the virgin will progress in to carry,
and when Joseph is woken up from sleep, has he done, as the angel of the L-rd (G-d) has him commanded, and he has taken to himself his wife;
and has himself with her not had marital relations, until she had borne a son, and he has called his name Yehoshua.
and when Yehoshua is born become in Bethlehem Yehudah, in the days of king Herod, look, star seers from the east are came to Jerusalem,
and have said: where is he, who was born become, the king of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and have come, ourselves to worship to him.
and as the king Herod has this heard, has he himself terrified and all Jerusalem with him.
and calling together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, has he them asked, where the Moshiach must be born become.
and they have to him said: in Bethlehem Yehudah; because so it is written become through the prophet.
and you (SG) Bethlehem, land Yehudah,
first has Herod quietly called the star seers, and thoroughly researched with them the time, when the star has itself shown.
and he has them sent to Bethlehem, and said: go and search after effort for the child; and when you (PL) will it find, report to me, so that I may also come and me worship to him.

and they, having heard the king, have themselves set out on their way; and look, the star, which they have seen on the east, went before them, until it is come and itself stood over the place of, where the child was.
and seeing the star, have they rejoice with a their greater joy.

and are entered in house and have seen the child with Mary, his mother; and are knelt down and have themselves paid homage to him; and have opened their treasure chests and (to) him brought gifts, gold and frankincense and myrrh.
and becoming warned in a dream, themselves not to return to Herod, are they went away by an other way to their own land into.

and after their going away, look, an angel of the L-rd (G-d) showed himself to Joseph in a dream, in this way to say: stand up and take the child and his mother, and flee to Egypt, and remain there, until I will you (SG) tell; because Herod will seek this child, so that him destroy.
and he is woken up and has taken the child and his mother by night, and is went away to Egypt.
and is there was until Herod is died, so that it may fulfilled to be, which it is said become from the L-rd through the prophet, in this way to say:

then has Herod seen, that he is become mocked from the star seers, is he become terrible angry, and has sent, and let to kill all youngsters, who are was in Bethlehem and in all its district, of two years and younger, according to the time, which he has exactly found out from the star seers.
then is fulfilled become, which it is said become through Yirmeyah the prophet, in this way to say:
a voice is heard become in Ramah,
when but Herod was already been dead, look, an angel of the L-rd (G-d) showed himself in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
and said: get up and take the child and his mother, and go to land of Israel; because are already died the (ones), who have sought the life of the child.
and he is woken up and has taken the child and his mother, and is come to land of Israel.

but on hearing, that Archelaus ruling over Yehudah on the place of his father Herod, has he himself afraid there to go; and after these as he was warned become in a dream, is he went away in the district of Galilee,

and is come and has lived in a city, which they calls it Natsaret, so that it may fulfilled to be, which it is said become through the prophets, that he will called to be Netzer/Tsemach. (Yeshayah 11, 1)
in those days comes John of the (Yarden) mikveh, and calls out in the wilderness of Yehudah, in this way to say:
do repentance; because the kingdom of the heavens has itself come near.
because this is he, of whom it is spoken become through Isaiah the prophet, in this way to say:
and John himself has had a clothing of camel hair, and a leather belt around his waist; and his food was locusts and wild honey.
then is to him went out Jerusalem, and all Yehudah, and the whole region along Yarden;
and have themselves allowed immerse be in the mikveh of him in the river Yarden, confess making themselves about their sins.

when however he did see a many of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees come to the mikveh, has he to them said: you (PL) children of snakes, who did you (PL) give to understand, that you (PL) may flee from the coming fury?
bear therefore fruit, which is worthy for repentance!

and may you (PL) not come upon the thoughts to say: we have Abraham as our father (merit of the fathers); because I tell you (PL), that Hashem is able from the these stones to raise up children for Abraham.
and the axe lies already by the root of the trees; therefore every tree, which bears not any good fruit, is chopped down, and thrown in fire into.

I immerse you (PL) in a mikveh with water for repentance; but this one, who comes after me, is stronger than I, who I am not worthy carried in his shoes; he will you (PL) immerse do in a mikveh with the Spirit the Holy and with fire.
his wind shovel is in his hand, and he will good clean out his threshing floor; and he will gather his wheat in barn into, but the chaff will he burn in fire, which quench itself not out.
then comes Yehoshua from Galilee to the Yarden to John, so that mikveh immersed to be in a mikveh of Him.
he but has it him prevented, saying: I have need from you (SG) immersed to be in a mikveh, and you (SG) come to me?
but Yehoshua has answered to him said: let it now to be; because in this way send for us to fulfil every righteousness. then has he him permitted.
as Yehoshua has immersed become in a mikveh, is he about to climb out from water; and look, the heavens have themselves opened, and he has seen Hashem's Spirit descend like a dove, and come on him;
and look, a voice from heaven has said: this is my beloved Son, in whom I have a well pleased!
then is Yehoshua led become from the Spirit in the wilderness into, so that the Satan may him tempt.
and fasting forty days and forty nights, is he afterwards hungry become.
and the tempter is come and has to him said: if you (SG) are the Son of the Most High, tell, that the these stones shall become bread!
he but has answered said: it stands written:
then takes him the Satan into the holy city into; and has him stood on the pinnacle of house the holy,
and said to him: if you (SG) are the Son of the Most High, throw yourself down; because it stands written:
has Yehoshua to him said: it stands also written: you (SG) you shall not tempt the L-rd, your G-d.
again takes him the Satan with up a very high mountain, and shows him all kingdoms of the world, and their splendor;
and says to him: all the these will I you (SG) give, if you (SG) you will fall down and yourself worship to me.
then says Yehoshua to him: go away, you (SG) Satan! for it stands written: to the L-rd, your G-d, shall you (SG) yourself worship and only him alone shall you (SG) serve!
then left him the Satan; and look, angels did come and have him served.
and when he has heard, that John is arrested become, is he went away to Galilee;
and has left Natsaret, and is come and has lived in K'far-Nachum, which lies by the sea, in the territory of Zebulun and Naftali;
so that it may fulfilled to be, which it is said become through Yeshayah the prophet, in this way to say:
land of Zebulun and land of Naftali,
the people, who was sat in the darkness,
from then onwards has Yehoshua begun to proclaim, and to say: do repentance; because the kingdom of the heavens has itself come near!
and as he is walking about beside the sea of Galilee, has he seen two brothers, Simon, whom they call him Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net in sea into; because they are was fishermen.
and he said to them: come, follow me after, and I will you (PL) make for fishers of people!
and they have immediately left the nets, and have him followed.
and when he is from there went further, has he seen other two brothers, Jacob son of Zavdai, and John his brother, in the boat with their father Zavdai, mending their nets; and he has them called.
and they have immediately left the boat and the father their, and have him followed.
and he is walk around in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and proclaiming the Good News of the kingdom, and curing every diseases and disease among the people.

and his name has itself spread in all Syria; and they have brought to him all sick, who are was plagued with various diseases and sufferings, demoniacs with evil spirits, and epileptics, and paralytics; and he has them cured;
and there did him follow great crowds of people from Galilee and Decapolis and Jerusalem and Yehudah and from Beyond Yarden.
and seeing the crowds of people, is he went up on the mountain; and when he had self sat down are his disciples came to him.
and he has opened his mouth and them he taught, saying:
blessed are the poor in spirit;
blessed are the mourners;
blessed are those, who regard themselves as small;
blessed are those, who hunger and thirst after righteousness;
blessed are the merciful ones;
blessed are those, who are pure in heart;
blessed are those, who make peace;
blessed are those, who to be persecuted on account of righteousness;
blessed are you (PL), when they do you (PL) on evils, and they persecute you (PL), and they speak out false everything evil about you (PL), on account of me.
rejoice yourselves, and be yourselves very joyful, because your reward is great in heaven; for just in this way have they persecuted the prophets, who were was before you (PL).
you (PL) are the salt of the earth; if however this salt may to lose its taste, with what will it salted to be? it is fit more for nothing, except thrown out and for people trampled to be.
you (PL) are the light of the world. a city, which is situated on a hill, can not remain hidden.
one lights also not on a candle, and puts it under the measuring basket, but on the candlestick; and it gives light (to) everyone in house.
just in this way may your light to shine before people, so that they may see your (PL) deeds good, and give a praise to your Father, who is in heaven.
you (PL) shall not think, that I have come to destroy the Torah or the prophets; I have not come to destroy, but fulfill to do.
because in truth say I (to) you (PL), until the heaven and the earth will pass away, will any one yod, or a kotse of yod of the Torah not null and void to be, until all is happened.

therefore who it will destroy one of the these smallest commands, and will just in this way teach the people, this one will be called least in the kingdom of the heavens; whoever however he will them do and teach, this one will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
because I tell you (PL), that if your righteousness will not exceed the righteousness of the scribes and the Pharisees, will you (PL) never way not enter into the kingdom of the heavens.
you (PL) have heard, that it is said become to the ancients: you (SG) should not to kill; who however the one kills, is liable to the judgment.

I however tell you (PL), that every one, who is angry about his brother, will be liable to the judgment; and who it will say Good for nothing to his brother, will be liable to the Sanhedrin; and who it will say, you (SG) fool, will be liable to the fire of Gehenna.
therefore when you (SG) bring your sacrifice to the altar, and there you remember yourself, that your brother has something against you (SG),
shall you (SG) there leave your sacrifice before the altar, and go before all there, reconcile with your brother, and then come and be offer your sacrifice.

become in agreement with your adversary quickly, while you (SG) are still with him on the road; lest will your adversary you give over to the judge, and the judge to the police, and you (SG) you will thrown to be in prison into.
truly tell I you (SG), you (SG) you will from there never way not come out, until you (SG) pay not the last penny!
you (PL) have heard, that it is said become: you shall not commit adultery!
I however tell you (PL), that every one, who looks at a woman, she to desire, has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

and if your right eye misleads you to the stumbling, take it out, and throw it away from you (SG); because it profits yourself you (SG), that one of your body parts may lost go, and not your whole body may thrown to be in Gehenna into.

and if your right hand misleads you to the stumbling, cut it up, and throw it away from you (SG); because it profits yourselves you (SG), that one of your body parts may lost go, and not your whole body may go in Gehenna into.
and it is said become: who it separates self from his wife, will he her give a divorce certicate.

I but tell you (PL), that every one, who separates self from his wife, except on account of a case of fornication, makes he her adultery to do. and who it has marry with a divorcee, this one is doing adultery.
again have you (PL) heard, that it is said become to the ancients: you shall not swear falsely, you shall however repay your oaths to the L-rd (G-d).
I however tell you (PL), swear entirely not; not by the heaven, because it is Hashem's throne of glory.
not by the earth, because it is a footstool for His feet; not by Jerusalem, because this is the city of the great king.
you shall also not swear by your head, because you (SG) can not any single hair white or black make.
but let your word be; yes, yes; no, no! and what is more than the these is from the evil (one).
you (PL) have heard, that it is said become: an eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth;
I however tell you (PL): you (PL) shall yourselves not resist the evil (one); but when someone slaps you on your right cheek, bend him also the other to.
and the one, who wants self judge with you (SG) and take away your shirt, let him also the over cloak.
and who it compels you to go a mile, go with him two.
give to the one, who asks from you (SG), and from the one, who wants from you (SG) (to) borrow, turn yourself not away.
you (PL) have heard, that it is said become: you (SG) you shall love have your neighbor, and hate your enemy;
I however tell you (PL): have love your (PL) enemies, and pray for those, who persecute you (PL);
so that you (PL) shall be children of your Father, who is in heaven. because He allows his sun to shine on evil and on good, and allows it to rain on righteous and on unrighteous.
because if you (PL) will love have those, who have you (PL) love, what for a reward have you (PL)? (question) do then the tax collector not the same?
and if you (PL) give up peace (greeting) only your (PL) brothers alone, what do you (PL) here more? (question) do then the nations (of the world) not also the same?
therefore shall you (PL) be perfect, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
give attention, that you (PL) shall not do your alms charity before others, so as by them seen to be; and if not, have you (PL) not any reward by your Father, who is in heaven.

therefore when you (SG) you do a generosity of grace, let not to trumpet out before you (SG), as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, so that praised to be from people. truly say I you (PL), they have already their reward.
you (SG) however when you (SG) you do a generosity of grace shall your left hand not know, what the right one does,
in order that your generosities of grace shall remain secret; and your Father, who sees in secrecy, will you (SG) repay.

and when you (PL) do prayer, shall you (PL) not do as the hypocrites, because they have love prayer to do when they stand in the synagogues and on the corners of the streets, so that themselves to be seen before people. truly tell I you (PL), they have already their reward.
you (SG) but, when you (SG) you do prayer, go into in your inner room, and shut the door, and make prayer to your Father, who is hidden, and your Father, who sees in secret, will you (SG) repay.
and prayer doing, shall you (PL) not babble like the nations (of the world); because they think, that through a many words their, will they heard become.
therefore be not like as them! because Hashem, your Father, knows what you (PL) need, before you (PL) ask him.
therefore shall you (PL) in this way prayer do:
may your kingdom come.
our daily bread give us today.
and forgive us our debts,
and bring us not to any temptation,
because if you (PL) forgive the people their errors, will your heavenly Father you (PL) also forgive.
when however you (PL) forgive the people not, will your Father you (PL) also not forgive your (PL) transgressions.

and when you (PL) fast, shall you (PL) not be as the hypocrites, with a sour face; because they make bitter their faces, so that themselves to show before people, that they fast. in truth tell I you (PL), they have already their reward.
you (SG) however, when you (SG) fast, anoint you (SG) the head with oil, and wash you (SG) up the face;
so that you shall not seen become by people, that you (SG) fast, only for your Father, who is concealed; and your Father, who sees in secrecy, will you (SG) render payment.
gathers you (PL) not one any treasures on the earth, where moth and rust corrupt, and where thieves dig under and steal away.
but gathers you (PL) one treasures in heaven, where not the moth not the rust corrupt, and where thieves dig not under and steal not away.
because where your treasure is, there will also your heart be.
the light of the body is the eye.

if therefore your eye is healthy, will your entire body be light. when however your eye is evil, will your entire body be dark. therefore if the light, which is in you (SG), is dark, how great is the darkness!
anyone can not serve two masters; because either he will the one hatred have, and love have the other, or he will himself hold by one, and the other despise. you (PL) can not serve Hashem and money.

therefore say I you (PL): worry not for your lives, what you (PL) shall eat, or what you (PL) shall drink; and also not for your body, what you (PL) shall put on. (question) is then not the life more than the food, and the body more than the clothing?
look at the birds of sky, that they sow not, and reap not, and gather also not in barns inside; and your heavenly Father feeds them. (question) are you (PL) then not much more worth than they?
and who of you (PL) worrying, can add a cubit to his stature?
and why worry you (PL) yourselves about a clothing? teach yourselves off from the lilies of field, how they grow; they work not and spin not;
I say (to) you (PL) however, that Solomon with his whole glory is not was in this way dressed, as one of the these.

and if Hashem puts clothes in this way on the grass of field, which today is it here, and tomorrow is it thrown in furnace into, will he then not much more you (PL) (clothe), you (PL) small believers?
therefore shall you (PL) not worry, so to say: what will we eat, or what will we drink, or with what will we ourselves clothe?
because the nations (of the world) seek this all; yes, your heavenly Father knows, that you (PL) need yourselves in these all.
seek however to the first of all his kingdom, and his righteousness; and the all will you (PL) given to be.
worry then not about tomorrow; because the tomorrow's day will worry for itself alone. the day has enough its own evil.
judge not, in order that you (PL) shall not judged to be.
because with what for a judgment you (PL) sentence (a verdict), will you (PL) judged to be, and with which measure of you (PL) measure, will you (PL) measured to be.
and why do you see the splinter in your brother's eye, but the beam, which is in your eye, you notice not?
or how you can say to your brother: let me remove the splinter from your eye; and look, the beam is in your eye?
you (SG) hypocrite, throw to the first out the log from your eye; and then will you see clearly to take out the splinter from your brother's eye.
give not the holy to the dogs, and throw not your (PL) pearls before the swine, in case will they them trample with their feet, and returning themselves you (PL) tear apart.
ask, and it will you (PL) given to be; seek, and you (PL) will find; knock on, and it will you (PL) opened become!
because everyone, who asks, receives; and the, who seeks, finds; and the one, who knocks on, (it) will opened become.
or which man among you (PL) is it, who, if his son shall him ask bread, will he him give a stone?
or if he shall ask a fish, will he then him give a snake?
if therefore you (PL), being evil, know to give good gifts to your (PL) children, how more will your Father, who is in heaven, give good (things) to the (ones), who ask him?
therefore all, which you (PL) want, that the people should you (PL) do, do also that way for them; because that very thing is the law and the prophets.
go in through the narrow gate; because spacious is the gate, and broad the way, which leads to corruption, and a many are there, who go in through that same one.
how tight is however that gate, and narrow the way, which leads to the life, and few are those, who find it.
beware for the false prophets, who come to you (PL) in clothing of sheep, inside however are they devouring wolves.
from their fruit shall you (PL) them recognize. (question) gather they then grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?
in this way bears every good tree good fruit; the bad (corrupt) tree however yields out bad fruit.
a good tree can not bear any bad fruit, and a bad (corrupt) tree not bear any good fruit.
every tree, which gives not out any good fruit, becomes chopped down, and thrown in fire into.
therefore shall you (PL) them recognize from their fruit.
not every one, who says to me, L-rd, L-rd, will enter in kingdom of heaven, but the one, who does the will of my Father, who is in heaven.
a many will say to me in that day: L-rd, L-rd, did have we then not in your name prophecies said, and in your name cast out evil spirits, and in your name done a many wonders?
and then will I confess before them: I have you (PL) never not known; go from me, you (PL), who do wickedness.
therefore every one, who hears the these words my, and does them, will be compared to a man a wise, who has built his house on the rock.
and the downpour has fallen, and the water floods are come, and the winds have blown, and have struck against that house; and it is not fell; because it was founded on the rock.
and every one, who hears the these words my, and does them not, will be compared to a man a fool, who has built his house on the sand.
and the pelting rain has fallen, and the water storms are come, and the winds have blown, and have beat upon that house; and it is collapse, and the break down of it was great.
and it is happened, when Yehoshua has finished the these words, have the crowds of people been astounded over his teaching.
because he has them taught as one, who had authority, and not as their scribes.
and when he is come down from mountain, have him followed great crowds of people,
and look, a leper is come and is fell down before him, and has said: L-rd, if you (SG) want, you can me clean make.
and he has stretched out the hand, and has him touched, in this way to say: I do want; be cleansed! and immediately is he clean become of his leprosy.
and Yehoshua says to him: beware you, that you (SG) shall it nobody tell; but go, show you to the kohen, and be offer the sacrifice, that Moses has command, for an witness to they!
and as he is come in to K'far-Nachum, is come to him a (Roman) officer, and has him begged,
and said: L-rd, my servant lies paralyzed in house, and has terrible sufferings.
and he says to him: I will come and him heal.
the (Roman) officer however has answering said: L-rd, I am not worthy, that you (SG) shall come in under my roof, but tell only a word, and my servant will healed to be.

because also I am a man, who stands under the authority, having under me soldiers, and I say to that: go! and he goes; and to an other: come here! and he comes; and to my slaves: do this! and he does it.
and as Yehoshua has this heard, has he self amazed, and has said to the (ones), who have followed: in truth tell I you (PL), among no one in Israel have I such faith not found.
and I tell you (PL): a many will come from east and from west, and will themselves sit down with Abraham, and with Isaac, and with Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
the children however of the kingdom will thrown out to be in the darkness outside; there will be the weeping and the gnashing with the teeth.
and Yehoshua has said to the (Roman) officer: go, will (to) you happened that way, as you (SG) have believed! and the servant was healed become in that hour.
and when Yehoshua has come to Peter in house into, has he seen his mother-in-law lying sick on a fever.
and he has touched her hand, and the fever has her left; and she is stand up again, and has him served.
and when it is become evening, have they brought to him a many demoniacs with evil spirits, and he has cast out the spirits with a word, and all sick cured;
so that it shall fulfilled to be, what it is said become through Isaiah the prophet, so to say: he himself has taken away our diseases, and carried the burden of our pains. (Yeshayah 53, 4)
and as Yehoshua has seen a crowd people around Himself, has he commanded depart to the other side of sea.
and a scribe is come, and has to him said: Rebbe, I will you (SG) follow, where you (SG) will just go.
and Yehoshua said to him: the foxes have holes, and the birds of heaven—nests; the Son of Man however has not, where the head to lay down.
and an other of the disciples has to him said: L-rd, give me permission before all to go away and bury to do my father.
Yehoshua however said to him: follow you (SG) me after; and let the dead bury do their dead (ones).
and he is got into in the boat, and his disciples have him followed.
and look, it is become a greater windstorm on the sea, that the boat is almost covered become of the waves; he however is sleep.
and they are come to him, and have him roused, in this way to say: L-rd, save; we come die!
and he says to them: why are you (PL) so frightened, you (PL) small believers? then is he stand up again, and has rebuked the winds and the sea; and it is become a great quietness.
and the people have themselves amazed, and have said: what is this for a man, that both the winds and the sea obey him?

and when he is come on the other side sea in the land of the Gadarenes, are him met two demoniacs, who are come out of the tombs, very dangerous ones, that no one has not be able pass by through that way.
and look, they have a shout done, so to say: what have we with you (SG), you (SG) Son of the Most High? did you come here us to torment before the time?
and from a distance from them were themselves feeding a great herd of swine.
and the evil spirits have him begged, so to say: if you (SG) are casting us out, send us into in the herd of swine!

and he has to them said: go! and they are gone out, and are went away in the swine into; and look, the whole herd has themselves a tear down done of the steep slope in sea into, and are perish in the waters.
the swineherds however are fled, and are enter in city, and have everything reported, and what (it had happened) with the demoniacs.
and look, the whole city is went out meet Yehoshua; and seeing him, have they him begged, that he shall going away from their domain.

while he has this to them spoken, look, a ruler has come, and is fell down before him, and has said: my daughter is but what died; but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.

they however are went out, and have him famous made over that entire land.

the Pharisees however have said: through the ruler of the evil spirits casts he out the evil spirits!
and Yehoshua was walking about all cities of and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and proclaiming the good News of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness.
and when he has seen the crowds of people, had he on them great compassion had, because they are was languishing and neglected, like sheep, who have not any shepherd.

ask then the L-rd of the harvest, that he shall send out laborers into his harvest!

the these twelve has Yehoshua sent, and has them given directive, so to say:
but go rather to the lost sheep of the house Israel.
go, call out and say: the kingdom of heaven is near!

and into whatever city or village you (PL) come into, search out who it has the worth in you (PL); and there shall you (PL) stay until you (PL) go away.

look, I send you (PL) like sheep among wolves. be then wise as the snakes, and without falseness as the doves.
beware however before the people! because they will you (PL) turn over to the Sanhedrin, and in their synagogues will they you (PL) flog with whips;
even before rulers and kings will they you (PL) lead on account of me, for a witness to them and to the nations (of the world).

because it will you (PL) given to be in that hour, what you (PL) shall speak; because not you (PL) are that, who speaks, but the Spirit of your Father is it, who speaks through you (PL).
and a brother will give over a brother to the death, and a father his child, and children will standing up again against the parents and will them kill.
and you (PL) will be hated by (to) everyone on account of my name. who however he will endure until to the end, this one will saved to be.
and when they persecute you (PL) in the this one city, run in the another into. because in truth tell I you (PL): you (PL) will not to go through the cities of Israel, until the Son of Man will come.
a disciple is not higher than his teacher, and a slave not above his master.
it is enough for the disciple, that he shall be like his teacher, and the slave like his master. if the owner of the house have they called Baal-zibbul, how much more his sons of house!
therefore shall you (PL) yourselves not have fear before them! because it is there is no any hidden thing, that will not revealed become; and no concealed thing, which will not made known become.
what I tell you (PL) in the darkness, that shall you (PL) speak in the light, and what is being (to) you (PL) whispered in ear into, that shall you (PL) call out on the rooftops.

sell they then not two birds for one penny? and yet falls not any one of them to the earth without your Father.
with you (PL) however are even the hairs of head all counted.
therefore shall you (PL) not fear have; you (PL) are worth more than a many birds.
whoever then it will me confess do before the people, will I the one also confess do before my Father, who is in heaven.
who however it will me deny before the people, will I the one also deny before my Father, who is in heaven.
you (PL) should not think, that I am come, so as to bring peace on the earth. I am not come to bring peace, but a sword.
because I am come to separate a person from his father, and a daughter from her mother, and a daughter-in-law from her mother-in-law,
and a man's enemies will be his own sons of house.
who it has love father or mother more than me, this one is me not worthy; and who it has love son or daughter more than me, this one is me not worthy.
and who it takes not his tree, and follows me after, is me not worthy.
who it finds his life, this one will it lose; and who it loses his life for my sake, this one will it find.
the one, who welcomes you (PL) on, welcomes me on; and the one, who welcomes me on, welcomes on the. the One Who has me sent.

and said to him: you are this One, who shall come, or have we to wait on an other?

and blessed is the one, who will not stumble in Me!

this is he, concerning whom it stands written:

who it has ears, this one should hear!
to whom however shall I compare the this very generation? it is like to children, who sit in the marketplace and call out to their companions,

who it is not with me, this one is against me; and the one, who gathers not one with me, scatters.

so that it shall fulfilled become, what is said become through the prophet, so to say:

the Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather from his kingdom of all stumbling blocks and those, who do wickedness,

then will the righteous shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. who it has ears, this one shall hear.

have you (PL) this all understood? say they to him: yes!

because Herod has that John captive taken, and him bound, and put in prison, on account of Herodias, the wife of his brother Philip.
because John has to him said: you (SG) allowed her not to have.
and he has him wanted to kill, and has self afraid before the crowd, because they had him held for a prophet.

therefore did he promise with an oath, her to give, what she would request.

say they to him: we have here nothing except five loaves bread, and two fish.
and he has said: bring them here to we.

and all have eaten, and are filled become, and they have picked up, what is left over of the broken pieces, twelve baskets full.
