and he has immediately compel the disciples step in in the boat, and to go across before him on the other side of sea, until he will dismiss the crowds of people.
and when he has had sent away the crowds of, is he went up on the mountain, so that alone prayer to do; and when it is become evening, is he there was all alone.
the boat however is already was a many miles from the land, hard tossed of the waves; because the wind was against.
and in the fourth watch of the night is he come to them, walking on the sea.
and as the disciples have him caught sight of walking on the sea, have they themselves terrified, and said: it is an apparition! and have shouted out of fear.
Yehoshua however has immediately to them spoken, so to say: be comforted! I am it; has not any fear!
Peter however has answering to him said: L-rd, if you (SG) are it, command me come to you (SG) on the water!
and he has said: come! and Peter is went down from boat, and is walking on the water, and come to Yehoshua.
and than he has seen the strong wind, has he self terrified, and beginning self to drown, has he a shout done, so to say: L-rd, save me!
and Yehoshua has immediately stretched out his hand, has him seize, and says to him: you (SG) small believer, why you have doubt?
and when they are step in in boat, has the wind cease.
and the (ones), who are was in boat, have themselves worship to him, and said: you (SG) are in truth Hashem's Son!
and they are cross over, and are come to the land Gennesaret.
and as the people of that place of have him recognized, have they sent in that whole region around, and brought to him all sick;
and have him begged, that they should only touch the fringe of his clothing; and all, who have touched, are totally healthy become.
then come to Yehoshua Pharisees and scribes from Jerusalem, so to say:
why are your disciples break on the tradition of the elders? because they wash themselves not the hands, when they to eat bread.
he however has answering to them said: why are you (PL) also violating Hashem's command on account of your tradition?
because Hashem has said: you (SG) you shall give honor your father and your mother! and: whoever it is curses father or mother, this one should killed to be.
and you (PL) say: who it will say to the father or to the mother: this is a sacrifice, which you (SG) would from me be able partake be,
this one is more not obligated to give honor his father or his mother. and you (PL) have cancelled Hashem's word through your tradition.
you (PL) hypocrites! well has Isaiah on you (PL) prophecies said, in this way to say:
the these people give me up honor with the lips;
in vain is their reverence for me,
and he has called to crowd people, and to them said: hear, and understand!
not that, which goes into in mouth, make the people impure; but that, which comes out of mouth, the these makes impure the person.
then are the disciples come, and said to him: know, that the Pharisees have stumbled on hearing that word?
he however has answering said: every plant, which my heavenly Father has not planted, will uprooted to be.
let them go! they are the blind guide of the blind. and when a blind man leads a blind man, will both fall into in pit into.
and Peter has answering said to him: explain us out the parable!
he however has said: are you (PL) also yet without understanding?
(question) see you (PL) then not one, that everything, which goes into in mouth, lowers down in stomach, and becomes pitched on out in house sewer into?
the things however which come out of mouth come out from heart out; and they make the person impure.
because from heart come out evil thoughts, murder, adultery, fornication, theft, false witness saying, blasphemies.
the these things are it, which are defiling the people; however to eat with unwashed hands makes the person not impure.
and Yehoshua has went out from there, and is went away in the regions of Tyre and Sidon.
and look, a Canaanite woman is come out from those borders, and has shouted, so to say: L-rd, Son of David, have mercy you on me! my daughter is bitter plagued from a evil spirit!
he however has her not answered any word. and his disciples are went (come) over and have him asked, so to say: send her away; because she is crying out us after!
he however has answering said: I am not sent been except to the lost sheep of the house Israel.
she is however come, and fell down before him, and said: L-rd, help me!
and he has answering said: it is not fair to take away the bread from the children and it to throw before the dogs!
and she has said: yes, L-rd; because even the dogs to eat from the broken pieces, which fall down of their Master's table.
then has Yehoshua answering to her said: woman, your faith is great; let (to) you to happen just as you (SG) will! and her daughter is healed become from that hour on.
and Yehoshua is went away from there, and is come to the sea of Galilee; and is went up on the mountain, and self there sat down.
and are come to him great crowds of people, who did have with themselves lame, the blind, mute, lame, and a many others; and have them throw down themselves before his feet, and he did them healed;
so that the crowd has themselves amazed, seeing, that the mute speak, the lame are whole, and the lame walk around, and the blind see; and they have offer up a praise to the G-d of Israel.

and Yehoshua has to self called his disciples, and said: I am inwardly moved over the crowd people, because they are already three days with me and have not what to eat; and I want not them send away fasting, lest will they faint on the way.
and the disciples say to him: from where shall we take in the desert so much bread, even to satisfy such a crowd people?
and Yehoshua says to them: how much loaves bread have you (PL)? and they have said: seven, and some small little fish.
and he did order the crowd themselves sit down on the ground;
and took the seven loaves bread and the fish; had made a blessing and them broke up, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the crowds of people.
and all have eaten, and are filled become; and what is left over from the broken pieces has they picked up, seven large baskets.
and those, who have eaten, are was four thousand men, besides women and children.
and he did send away the crowds, and is step into in boat, and come to the borders of Magadan.
and the Pharisees and Sadducees are come, in order that him test, and have asked, that he shall them to show an sign from heaven.
he however has answering to them said: in evening say you (PL); it will be fair weather, because the sky turning red self?
and in the morning: today will be storming, because the sky turning red self and is gloomy. the appearance of sky understand you (PL) to differentiate; but the signs of the time can you (PL) not!
a evil and adulterous generation demands a sign; and any sign will it not given to be, except the sign of Jonah. and he has them left, and is went away.
and the disciples are came over on the other side of sea and have forgotten take along bread.
and Yehoshua has to them said: give attention and beware before yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
and they have it reasoned among themselves, and said: this is because we have not take along any bread.
and when Yehoshua has self find out, has he said: o you (PL) small believers, what speaks you (PL) among yourselves, because you (PL) have not any bread?
understand you (PL) yet not, and remember you (PL) not the (pass (time) with) five bread of the five thousand, and how many baskets you (PL) have picked up?
also not the seven bread for the four thousand, and how much great (Rebbe's leftovers) baskets you (PL) have picked up?
how comes it, that you (PL) understand not, that I have not spoken to you (PL) of bread? beware you (PL) however before yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
then have they understand that he has not said, they should themselves beware before yeast of bread, but before the casuistic hairsplitting of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
and when Yehoshua is come in the regions of Caesarea of Philippi, has he asked his disciples, so to say: who, says the people, that the Son of Man is?
and they have said: some (say) John of the (Yarden) mikveh; others however, Eliyahu; yet others Yirmeyah, or one of the prophets.
says he to them: and who, say you (PL), that I am?
has Simon Peter answering said: you (SG) are the Moshiach, the Son of the living G-d!
and Yehoshua has answering to him said: that blessed are you (SG), Simon Bar Yonah; because flesh and blood has this you (SG) not revealed, but my Father, who is in heaven!
and I tell you (SG) also: you (SG) are Peter, and on the this rock will I build my kehile; and the gates of Sheol deepest will it not defeat.

and you (SG) will I give the keys of the kingdom of heaven; and what you (SG) you will forbid on the earth, that will be forbidden in heaven; and what you (SG) you will permit be on the earth, that will be permitted in heaven.
then has he ordered his disciples, that they should nobody tell, that he is the Moshiach.

from then onwards has Yehoshua the Moshiach begun to show his disciples, that he must go to Jerusalem, and to suffer a many from the elders and chief kohenim and scribes, and killed to be, and the third day stand up again.
and Peter has him taken on a side, and has begun to shout on him, so to say: now you, L-rd! the these shall you (SG) not to happen!

he however has self turn around and said to Peter: away from Me, Satan, you (SG) are a stumbling block for me; because you (SG) you have not in mind that, which belongs to Hashem, only that, which belongs to man!
then has Yehoshua said to his disciples! if someone wants me follow, let he himself alone deny, and take his tree, and me follow!
because who the one wants save do his life, this one will it to lose; who however it loses his life on account of me, this one will it find.
because what will it help a people, if he shall gain the whole world, and to lose his life? or what can a man give redeem his life?
because the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then will he repay every one according to his deeds.
in truth tell I you (PL), that some of the (ones), who stand here, will not sample the taste of death, until they will see the Son of Man come in his kingdom of.
and in six days around takes Yehoshua with himself Peter, and Jacob, and his brother John, and leads them alone up on a high mountain.
and he is transfigured become before them, and his face did shine like the sun, and his clothing are become white as the light.
and look, Moses and Eliyahu have themselves appear to them, speaking with him.
and Peter has answering said to Yehoshua: L-rd, it is good for us here to be! if you (SG) want, will I here make three tents; one for you (SG), and one for Moses, and one for Eliyahu.
and while he was still speaking, look, a bright cloud has them overshadow; and look, a voice out of the cloud has said: this is my beloved Son, in whom I have a well pleased; him shall you (PL) hear!
and as the disciples have it heard, are they fell down on their faces, and have themselves very afraid.
and Yehoshua is go over and has them touched and said: stand up, and have not any fear!
and when they have lift up their eyes, have they nobody seen, except Yehoshua alone.
and while they are went down from mountain, has Yehoshua them ordered, so to say: tell anyone not of the vision, until the Son of Man is stand up again from the dead.
and the disciples have him asked, so to say: and why say the scribes, that Eliyahu must to the first come?
he however has answering said: Eliyahu comes actually, and will all restore;
but I tell you (PL), that Eliyahu is already come, and they have him not recognized, only did with him, what they have wanted. just in this way will also the Son of Man have to suffering from them.
then did the disciples understand, that he has spoken to them about John of the (Yarden) mikveh.
and when they are come to the crowd people, is come to him a man, who is knelt down before him on the knee,
and said: L-rd, have mercy on you on my son; because he is a epileptic, and suffers hard; because often falls he in fire into, and often in water into.
and I have him brought to your disciples, and they have him not be able heal.
and Yehoshua has answering said: o faithless and perverse generation! how long shall I be with you (PL)? how long shall I you (PL) tolerate? bring him here to me!
and Yehoshua has rebuked on him, and the evil Spirit is from him out, and the boy is healthy become from that hour without.
then are the disciples went (come) over to Yehoshua, when they are was with him alone, and have said: why are we not was able him to cast out?

and he says to them: on account of your lack of faith! because in truth tell I you (PL): if you (PL) would have faith as a mustard seed, would you (PL) have said to the this mountain: lift you up from here to there! and it would itself picked up, and any thing would not have been impossible for you (PL).
(the this one kind however goes not out except through prayer and fasting.)
and while they are walking about in Galilee, has Yehoshua to them said: the Son of Man will turned over become in hands of men;
and they will him kill, and the third day will he standing up again. and they have become very grieved.
and when they are come to K'far-Nachum, are the (Temple tax) collector of the half shekel come to Peter, and said: your Rebbe pay not the half shekel?

says he: yes! and when he is come in in house, is Yehoshua him met coming, saying: what you think, Simon? the kings of the earth, of whom take they taxes or tribute? from their children, or from strangers?
and when he has said: of strangers, has Yehoshua to him said: thus are the children free!

but so that we should not be any stumbling block for them, go to the sea, and throw in a fishing rod, and take the first fish, which will come up; and when you (SG) will open its mouth, will you find a silver coin (a stater); take it, and give it for me and for you (SG).
in that hour are the disciples come to Yehoshua, and said: who is in the truth the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
and he has called to self a child, and has it stood in their midst,
and said: in truth tell I you (PL): if you (PL) will yourselves not turn back (home), and become like the children, will you (PL) never way not enter in the kingdom of heaven!
therefore who it will self alone lower like the these child, this one is the greatest in kingdom of heaven.
and who it will receive one child such in my name, this one takes Me on.

who however it will mislead unto stumbling ones of the these small ones, who believe in Me, is better for him would it be, that a great millstone would hanged become on his neck, and he would drown become in the depth of sea.
woe to the world because of these stumbling blocks! because temptations must come; but woe is to that person, through whom the stumbling block comes!

and if your hand or your foot misleads you to the stumbling, chop it off, and throw it away from you (SG)! it is better for you (SG) to enter in the life lame or limping, than to have both hands or both feet and thrown to be in the eternal fire into.

and if your eye misleads you to the stumbling, rip it out and throw it away from you (SG)! it is better for you (SG) to enter in the life with one eye, than to have two eyes and thrown to be in the Gehenna of fire.
give attention, that you (PL) shall not despise do even one of the these little ones! because I tell you (PL), that their angels in heaven see always the face of my Father, who is in heaven.
(because the Son of Man is come, so as to save that, which is lost gone.)
what think you (PL)? when a certain man has hundred sheep, and one of them will get lost, (question) will he then not leave the nine and ninety on the mountains, and go search for the stray one?
and when it happens, that he finds it, in truth tell I you (PL), he rejoices more with it, than with the nine and ninety, who are not gone astray become.
just in this way is it also not the will of your Father, who is in heaven, that one of the these little ones shall lost go.
when your brother will sin (against you (SG)), shall you (SG) go, and him admonish only between you (SG) and him alone.

will he you hear, you have won your brother. if however he will not hear, shall you (SG) take with you (SG) yet one or two, so that from the mouth of two witnesses or three shall every thing confirmed become.
and if he will them not hear, tell it to the kehile. when however he will the kehile also not hear, shall he be for you (SG) as a gentile and the tax collector.
in truth tell I you (PL), what you (PL) will forbid on the earth, that will be forbidden in heaven, and what you (PL) will permit be on the earth, that will be permitted in heaven.
further tell I you (PL), if two of you (PL) will agree be on the earth concerning which it is thing, on what they want ask, will it them done to be of my Father, who is in heaven.
because where two or three are gathered in my name, there am I among them.
then is Peter go over to him, and said; L-rd, how many times, when my brother sins against me, must I him forgive be? (question) until to the seventh time?
says Yehoshua to him: I tell you (SG) not, until to the seventh time; but, until to the seventieth time seven times!
therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened to a king, who wanted settle a account with his servant.
and as he has begun to calculate, did they bring before him one, who has owed was ten thousand talents (i.e. 60,000,000 denarii).
and because he has not had (the means) to pay, has his L-rd ordered, that should him sell with his wife and children and all, that he had, and it shall paid become.
then is the servant fell down and has self paid homage to him, so to say: have patience with me, and I will you (SG) all pay!
and the L-rd of that servant has self compassion on him, and did him let go, and him forgiven the debt.
when however that servant is went out, did he find one of his co-servants, who is him owing was hundred denarii; and he did him seize, and did him choke, and said: pay, what you (SG) are owing!
then is his co-servant fall down before his feet, and did him beg, so to say: have patience with me, and I will you (SG) pay!
he however did not want, but is went away and has him thrown in prison, until he will have paid, what he is owing was.
therefore when his co-servants had seen, what here is happened, have they self strong distress become, and are come and report their L-rd all, that has occurred.
then did his L-rd him called to self, and says to him: you (SG) wicked servant! that entire debt have I you (SG) forgiven, because you (SG) you have me asked;
did you then not also ought mercy to have on your co-servant, as I did on you (SG) mercy had?
and his L-rd is furious become, and had him handed over to the tormentors, until he will pay all, which he does him owe.
exactly thus will also my heavenly Father do to you (PL), when you (PL) will not forgive do every one the brother his from your (PL) hearts.
­and it is happened, when Yehoshua has finished the these words, has he Himself get up and is went away from Galilee, and is come in the boundary of Yehudah, on the other side of Yarden.
and great crowds of people have him followed, and he has them there healed.
and Pharisees are come to him, have him putting to test, and said: (question) permitted one self divorce with the wife on account of every reason?
he however has answering said: have you (PL) then not read, that the Creator has in beginning them created male and female,
and said: therefore will a man leave the father and the mother, and himself united with his wife; and the two will become one flesh? thus are they now longer not any two, but one flesh.
therefore what Hashem has united was, this shall any man not separate.
say they to him: and why has Moses ordered to her to give a divorce certicate, and her send away?
says he to them: Moses has you (PL) permission to divorce your (PL) wives, because the hardness of your heart; from beginning is it however not that way was.

and I tell you (PL): who it divorces self with his wife, except on account of fornication, and has marry with an another, this one is committing adultery; and who it has marry with a divorcee, this one is committing adultery.
say the disciples to him: if the thing is in this way among husband and wife, is good not to marry.
he however has to them said: not all can receive the these word, only those, to whom it was given.

because are there eunuchs, who are in this way born become from their mothers body; and are there eunuchs, who are castrate become of people; and are there eunuchs, who have self alone castrate was on account of the kingdom of heaven. who it can it receive, this one shall it receive!
then has they brought children to him, that he shall lay the hands on them, and say a prayer; the disciples however have rebuked on them.
Yehoshua however has said: allow the children come to Me, and hinder them not; because to such belongs the kingdom of heaven.
and he has laid the hands on them, and is went away from there.
and look, one is come to him, and said: Rebbe, what for a good shall I do, so that I shall have eternal life?
and he has to him said: why you ask me about the good? only one is the good one! if however you (SG) want go in in the life, observe the commands!
says he to him: which? and Yehoshua has said: you shall not to kill, you shall not commit adultery, you shall not steal, you shall not say false witness,
you shall give honor the Father and the mother, and: you (SG) you shall love have your neighbor as you alone!
says to him the young man: this all have I kept; what lack I still?
has Yehoshua to him said: if you (SG) want be perfected, go, sell your property, and give it to poor people, and you (SG) you will have a treasure in heaven; and come, follow Me after.
as however the young man has heard the this word, is he went away a sad person; because he has had a great possessions.
and Yehoshua has said to his disciples: in truth tell I you (PL): it is difficult for an rich go in in the kingdom of heaven.
and again tell I you (PL): a camel can easier go in through the eye of a needle, than a rich man in the kingdom of Hashem!
and when the disciples have this heard, are they strong amazed become, and have said: who then can save to be?
and Yehoshua has on them looked and said to them: with man is the these impossible; with Hashem however is all possible.
then has Peter answering to him said: look, we have all deserted, and you (SG) followed; what will we have therefore?

and Yehoshua has to them said: in truth tell I you (PL), that you (PL), who have me followed, will in the new world, when the Son of Man will sit on his throne of glory, also sit on twelve thrones and judge the twelve tribes of Israel.
and every one, who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or children or fields on account of my name, will a many times more received, and inherit the eternal life.
but a many first will be last, and last—first.
because the kingdom of heaven is like to a man, an owner of the house, who is went out very early to hire workers for his vineyard.
and after that as he had agreed was with the laborers for a denarius for the day, has he them sent in his vineyard into.
and he is went out around the third hour, and has seen others standing in the marketplace idle;
and has to those said: go you (PL) also in vineyard into, and what is right, will I you (PL) give!
and they are went and he is again went out around the sixth and ninth hour, and has this same thing done.
and around the eleventh hour is he went out, and has found others standing and said to them: why stand you (PL) here idle the entire day?
say they to him: because no one has us not hired: says he to them: go you (PL) also in vineyard into.
and when it is become evening, says the L-rd of the vineyard to his foreman: call the laborers, and pay out the wages, beginning from the last until to the first.
and are come the (ones), who are hired become around the eleventh hour, and have received each one one denarius.
and when the first are come, have they thought, that they will received more; and they themselves have also received each one one denarius.
and when they have it taken, have they murmured at the owner of the house,
so to say: the these last (ones) have worked only one hour, and you (SG) you have them equally placed on our account, who have (with zechus merit) carried the burden and heat of the day.
he however has answering to one of them said: my friend, I do you (SG) not any wrong. have you then not agreed with me for one denarius?
take this that is yours, and go; I will however give the this last one as much as you (SG).
may I then not do with my own, what I want? or is your eye evil, because I am good?
just in this way will the last be first, and the first—last.
and when Yehoshua has in the process at going up to Jerusalem, has he taken the twelve alone on a side, and on the road to them said:
look, we are going up to Jerusalem; and the Son of Man will turned over to be to the chief kohenim and scribes; and they will him condemn to the death,
and him turn over to the nations (of the world) to mock, and flog, and hanged up on the tree, and the third day will he standing up again.
then is come over to him the mother of Zavdai's children with her sons, has themselves bow, and something they asked from him.
and he has to her said: what do you wish? said she to him: say, that the these both sons my shall sit one on your right side, and one on your left side in your kingdom of.
Yehoshua has however answering said: you (PL) know not, what you (PL) ask! (question) can you (PL) then drink the cup, which I go drink? said they to him: we can!
says he to them: my cup will you (PL) really drink; but to sit on my right side, and on my left side, is not my thing to give; it is only for those, for whom it is prepared become by my Father.
and when the ten have this heard, are they become in anger at the two brothers.
and Yehoshua has them call over, and said: you (PL) know, that the rulers of the nations (of the world) rule over them, and the great people do over them dominate.
in this way shall it not be among you (PL), only whoever among you (PL) it will want his great, this one shall be your servant;
and who it wants among you (PL) his a chief, this one shall be your servant.
likened as the Son of Man is not come served to be, but to serve, and to give his life as a redemption for a many.
and while they are going out from Yericho, has him followed a very large crowd of people.
and look, two blind men are sitting by the road; as they have heard, that Yehoshua is going by, have they a shout done, so to say: L-rd, Son of David, have mercy on you on us!
the crowd however has shouted at them, that they should be silent. and they have further shouted, so to say: L-rd, Son of David, have mercy on you on us!
and Yehoshua has himself stopped, and them called, and said: what wish you (PL), that I should do for you (PL)?
say they to him: that our eyes should opened to be!
and Yehoshua has himself had compassion on them, and touched their eyes, and suddenly are they seeing become, and have him followed.
and when they have themselves come near to Jerusalem, and are come to Beit-Pagey, by the Mount of Olives, has Yehoshua then sent two of his disciples,
and said to them: go into in the village, which lies opposite you (PL), and immediately will you (PL) find a donkey tied up, and a young small donkey with her, untie them on, and bring them to me.
and if someone will you (PL) something say, shall you (PL) say: the L-rd need them has; and he will them immediately send.
and the these is happened, so that it shall fulfilled to be, what it is said become through the prophet, so to say:
says the daughter of Zion:
and the disciples did go, and have done what Yehoshua did them give directive,
and did bring the donkey with the small donkey, and on them did place the clothing; and he did himself sit up on them.
and the most of the crowd did spread out their clothing on the road; and others did break off branches from the trees,
and them spread on the road. and the crowds, who were walking ahead before him, and who have followed, have shouted, so to say:
and when he is entered to Jerusalem, is the whole city stirred up become, and said: who is this the this one?
the crowds however have said: this is the prophet Yehoshua from Natseret, in Galilee.
and Yehoshua is went in in Beis HaMikdash, and did drive out all who did sell and buy in Beis HaMikdash, and overturned the tables of the money changers, and the benches of those, who did sell doves;
and says to them: it stands written: my house will called to be a house (of) prayer! (Yeshayah 56, 7) you (PL) however have it made for a den of robbers. (Yirmeyah 7, 11.)
and are come to him blind men and lame in Beis HaMikdash, and he did them healed.
as however the chief kohenim and the scribes have seen the wonders, which he has done, and the children shout in Beis HaMikdash and say: blessed is the to Ben David, are they furious become,

and have to him said: you (SG) hear, what they say? and Yehoshua says to them: yes! (question) have you (PL) never not read: out the mouth of children and suckling you have prepared praise? (Psalms 8, 3.)
and did them leave, and is gone out beyond the city to Beit-Anyah. and there slept over.
and in the morning, returning self in city into, is he hungry become.

and seeing an single fig tree by the road, and is went over to it, and did nothing find on it except leaves only; and he says to it: it shall more not grow on you (SG) any fruit until on eternity! and the fig tree is soon withered become.
and when the disciples did it see, did they themselves were amazed, and said: how is the fig tree so suddenly wither become!

Yehoshua however has answering to them said: in truth say I you (PL): when you (PL) shall have faith, and not doubt, will you (PL) do not only that with the fig tree, but even if you (PL) will say to the this mountain: pick yourself up and throw yourself in sea into, will it happened.
and all, which you (PL) will ask in prayer, if you (PL) will believe, will you (PL) it received.

and when he is come in house HaMikdash into, are the chief kohenim and the elders of the people went (come) over to him, while he has taught, and have said: with what for a authority do you do the these things? and who has you (SG) given the this authority?
and Yehoshua has answering to them said: I want you (PL) also ask one thing, which if you (PL) will me tell, will I you (PL) also tell with what for a authority I do the these things.

John's mikveh—from where did (it) come? from heaven or from men? and they have this discussed among themselves, so to say: will we say: from heaven, will he say to us: then why did you (PL) him not believe?
will we however say: from men, must we fear have before the crowd? because all hold John for a prophet.
and they have answering said to Yehoshua: we know not! has he also to them said, say I you (PL) also not, with what for a authority I do the these things.
what however think you (PL)? a man has had two children; and he is went over to the first, and said: my child, go work today in vineyard.
and he has answering said: here am I, L-rd! and does not go!
and he is went (come) over to the second (one) and has said the same thing. this one however has said: I will not!

then did he regret had, and has gone. which of the both has done the father's will? say they: the last. says Yehoshua to them: in truth say I you (PL), that the tax collectors and the prostitutes go into ahead before you (PL) in the kingdom of Hashem.

because John is come to you (PL) on the way of righteousness and you (PL) have not believed in him. the tax collectors however and the prostitutes have him indeed believed, and you (PL), although you (PL) did it see, have even later not regret had, so as him to believe.

hear an another parable: it was a man, a owner of the house, who has planted a vineyard, and has it encircled with a fence, and dug a winepress in it, and built a tower, and has it let out to wine gardeners, and does depart.
and when it has self come closer (to) the time of fruit, has he sent his servants to the wine gardeners (to) collect his fruit.
and the wine gardeners have taken his servants, and one they beat up, and an other killed, and a third they stoned.
he has again sent other servants, more than the first; and they have with them done the same.
then has he sent to them his Son, and has said: they will themselves to be ashamed before my Son,
the wine gardeners however, as they have him caught sight of, have said among themselves: this is the heir; come, let us him kill, and take away his inheritance.
and have him taken, and threw outside of vineyard, and killed.
when therefore the L-rd of the vineyard will come, what then will he do to those wine gardeners?
say they to him: he will the ung-dly kill on a terrible way, and the vineyard rent to other wine gardeners, who will him return the fruit in their seasons.
said Yehoshua to them: have you (PL) never not read in the Scriptures?
therefore say I you (PL): the kingdom of Hashem will taken away to be from you (PL), and given to be to a people, who bring forth its fruit.
(and who it falls on the this stone, this one will crushed to be; on whom however it will fall, will it him crush.)
and when the chief kohenim and the Pharisees have heard his parables, have they understood, that he speaks about them.
and have sought him to arrest, and have themselves afraid before the crowds of people, because they has him held for a prophet.
and Yehoshua has answering again to them spoke in parables, so to say:
the kingdom of heaven is compared to a human king, who has made a wedding feast for his son,
and sent his servants call the invited to the wedding; and they did not want come.
has he again sent other servants, so to say: says (to) the invited: look, I have prepared my feast; my oxen and fatted calves are already kosher slaughtered, and all is prepared; come on the wedding!
they however have themselves about this nothing made, only did go, one in his field into, and an another to his business;
and those remaining have seized his servants, they ugly treated and killed.
and the king is furious become; and has sent his armies, and killed those murderers, and their city he did burn down.
then says he to his servants: the wedding is prepared, the (ones) invited however are it not worthy were.
go then here on the streets, where the ways part (fork) themselves, and as many as you (PL) will find, shall you (PL) invite on the wedding.
and those servants did go out on the streets, and have gathered all, whom they have found, both bad and good, and the wedding shall be full become with guests.
but when the king is come in seen the guests, has he caught sight of there a man, who is not was dressed in a wedding garment;
and he says to him: friend, how you are come in here, not having any wedding garment? and he is remain unable to speak.
then has the king said to the servants: bind him hands and feet, and throw him out in the outer darkness! there will be the weeping and gnashing with the teeth.
because a many are called, a few however chosen.
then are the Pharisees go, and have themselves held an counsel, how they should him capture with a word (that he said).

and they send to him their disciples with Herod's people, so to say: Rebbe, we know, that you (SG) are truthful, and that you (SG) teach in truth the way of Hashem, and shows deference not after anyone; because you (SG) are not partial any people.
tell then us, what you think: permitted one give the emperor tax, or not?
Yehoshua has however understood their malice, and has said: why putting to test you (PL) me out, hypocrites?
show me the coin of tax! and they have him brought a denarius.
and he said to them: whose is the image and the inscription?
say they; the emperor's. says he then to them: give then back the Caesar, what is the Caesar's; and to Hashem, what is belonging to Hashem!
and when they have this heard, were they themselves amazed, have him left, and are went away.
in that day are come to him Sadducees, who say, that there is no any resurrection of the dead ones, and have him asked,
so to say: Rebbe, Moses has said: when someone will die, not having any children, shall his brother do levirate marriage his wife, and raise up seeds for his brother.
and among us are was seven brothers. and the first has married and is died, and because he has not had any seeds, has he leave his wife to his brother.
likewise also the next and the third, until to the seventh.
lastly, after all, is the wife died.
therefore, at resurrection of the dead ones, whose wife of the seven will she be? because all did her after all have.
Yehoshua however has answering to them said: you (PL) wrong, because you (PL) know neither the scriptures (the Holy), and also not the power of Hashem.
because in resurrection of the dead ones not one have marriage, not one makes marriage, but one is like angels in heaven.
and concerning resurrection of the dead ones, have you (PL) then not read, what there is said become to you (PL) from Hashem, so to say:
I am the G-d of Abraham, and the G-d of Isaac, and the G-d of Jacob? he is not the G-d of the dead ones, but of the living ones.
and as the crowds of people have this heard, were they astounded over his teaching.
and when the Pharisees have heard, that he has the Sadducees stopped up the mouth, have they themselves gathered;
and one of them, a scholar, has him put to the test and asked:
Rebbe, which commandment is the greatest in the Torah?
and he has to him said: you (SG) you shall love have the L-rd your G-d from your whole heart, and with your whole soul, and with your whole understanding. (Deuteronomy 6, 5.)
the is the greatest and the first commandment.
an other, which is like to this one, is: you (SG) should love have your neighbor, as you yourself. (Leviticus 19, 15.)
on the these two commands hang the whole Torah, and the prophets.
and while the Pharisees have themselves gathered, has Yehoshua them stood a question,
so to say: what think you (PL) about the Moshiach? whose son is he? say they to him David's.
says he to them: how then calls him David through the Spirit (the Holy) L-rd, when he says:
the L-rd has said to my L-rd:
and when David calls him L-rd, how then is he his son?
and no one has him not be able to answer any word. and it have themselves now no one also more not dare from that day onwards him something to ask.
then has Yehoshua spoken to the crowds of people and to his disciples,
so to say: the scribes and the Pharisees have themselves sat down on Moses' seat.
therefore all, what they will you (PL) say, shall you (PL) do and observe; do however not according to their deeds; because they say, and do not.
they bind heavy burdens and put them on man's shoulders; themselves however the will they the these even with the finger not touch.
and all their deeds do they, so that of people seen to be, because they make wide their tefillin, and long the tzitziyot,
and have love the seats at the head (of honor) on feasts, and the first seats in synagogue,
and the peace greetings on the marketplaces, and from people called to be Rebbe!
you (PL) however shall yourselves not call Rebbe, because one is your Rebbe, and you (PL) all are brothers.
and call not anyone on the earth your Father; because one is your Father, who is in heaven.
you (PL) shall yourselves also not call guides; because one is your guide, the Moshiach.
the greatest among you (PL) shall his your servant.
and who it will himself alone to raise up, this one will humbled to be; and who it will self alone lower, this one will raised up be.

woe is however to you (PL), Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! that (since) you (PL) lock up the kingdom of heaven for the people. because you (PL) go not inside, and those entering allow you (PL) not go in.

(woe is to you (PL), Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! that you (PL) swallow one the houses of the widows, and for an pretext daven you (PL) long. therefore will you (PL) received a greater judgment.)

woe is to you (PL), Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! that you (PL) travel around over sea and land, in order that to make a ger (proselyte); and when he becomes one at last, make you (PL) him to be a son of Gehenna twice more than you (PL) are yourself.
woe is to you (PL), the blind leaders, who say: whoever (does) it swear by the Heikhal, is it nothing; however who (does) it swear by the gold of temple, this one is liable.
you (PL) fools and blind men; because what is greater, the gold or the Heikhal, which makes sacred the gold?
and: who it swears by the altar, this is nothing; who however (does) it swear by the sacrifice, which lies thereon, this one is liable.
you (PL) blind men! because what is greater, the sacrifice or the altar, who makes sacred the sacrifice?
therefore who it swears by the altar, this one swears there and by all, which is on it.
and who it swears by the Heikhal, this one swears there, and by the, which dwells inside.
and who it swears by the heaven, this one swears by Hashem's throne of the glory and by that, which (is) seated thereon.

woe is to you (PL), Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! that you (PL) give back tithe of the mint and the dill and the cumin, and ignored the more difficult things of the Torah: the judgment and the mercy and the faith/faithfulness! the these things have you (PL) required to do, and those not neglecting.
you (PL) the blind guide, who filter out the gnat, and swallow down the camel.
woe is to you (PL), Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! that you (PL) make clean the outside of the goblet and the bowl, of inside however are they full with robbery and not self-control.
you (SG) blind man pharisee, cleanse before all the inside of the goblet, so that also the outside shall to be clean.

woe is to you (PL), Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! that you (PL) are like to chalk white washed graves, which from the outside they look beautiful, from inside however are they full with bones of the dead, and every impurity.
just so appears you (PL) yourselves out from toward as righteous (ones) for the people, from inside however are you (PL) full with hypocrisy and wickedness.
woe is to you (PL), Scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! that you (PL) build on the tombs of the prophets, and decorate the gravestones of the righteous,
and say: if we would lived in the days of our parents, would we ourselves not have participated with them in the blood of the prophets.
so are you (PL) witness to self alone, that you (PL) are children of the prophets murderers.
and you (PL) make full the measure of your (PL) parents!
you (PL) snakes! brood of vipers! how will you (PL) escape from the judgment of Gehenna?

therefore, look, I send to you (PL) prophets and wise men, and scribes; a part of them will you (PL) kill and let hanged up on the tree; and a part of them will you (PL) beat up with scourges in your (PL) synagogues, and persecute from city to city;

so that it shall come on you (PL) the entire righteous blood, which is shed been on the earth, from the blood of Hevel the righteous until to the blood of Zecharyah son of Berechiah, whom you (PL) did kill between the Heikhal and the altar.
in truth say I you (PL), this all will come on the this very generation.

Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which kills the prophets, and stones those, who are sent to you (SG)! how many times have I wanted gather your children, like a hen gathers together her chickens under the wings, and you (PL) has not wanted.
look, your house will (to) you (PL) left to be desolate.
because I tell you (PL): from now onwards will you (PL) me more not see, until you (PL) will say:
and Yehoshua is went out of Beis HaMikdash, and is went away; and his disciples are went (come) over to him, so that him to show the buildings of Beis HaMikdash.
he however has answering to them said: you (PL) see this all? in truth tell I you (PL), it will here not be left to be a stone on a stone, which will not thrown down to be!

and when he is sat on the Mount of Olives, are his disciples come to him, while they are was alone, and have said: tell us, when will this to happen, and what will be the sign of your coming, and of the end of the world?
and Yehoshua has answering to them said: see, that no one shall you (PL) not mislead!
because a many will come in my name, so to say: I am the Moshiach; and mislead a many.
and you (PL) will hear of wars and rumors of wars; give attention, frightened self (be) not; because this must happen, but it is yet not the end.
because a people will self rise up against a people, and a kingdom against a kingdom; and it will be hunger famines and earthquakes on various places.
the all however is the beginning of the woes.
then will they you (PL) they will hand over to affliction, and they will you (PL) kill; and you (PL) will be hated of all peoples on account of my name.
and then will a many stumble, and betray one the other, and themselves hate one the other.
and there will stand up many false prophets, and mislead a many.
and by that which is unrighteousness will self increase, will the love of a many self cool off.
who however is holds out until to end, this one will saved to be.
and the these good News of the kingdom will proclaimed become in the entire inhabited world, as a witness to all peoples, and then will come the end.
therefore when you (PL) see the abomination of the desolation, which was spoken having become by Daniel the prophet, stand in the place holy—let the reader understand! (Daniel 12, 11.)—
then let those, who are in Yehudah, run away to the mountains;
this one, who is on the roof, should not descend to take something from his house;
and this one, who is in field, let not return back, to take his cloak.
however woe is to the (one) pregnant one and to the nursing ones in those days!
and do prayer, that your escape shall not happen in winter, and not Sabbath.
because it will then be a great trouble, whose equal is not become from the beginning of the world until now,
and will also more not be. and if those days would not shortened become, would any flesh (and blood) not saved become; but on account of the chosen will those days indeed shortened become.
when someone will you (PL) then say: look, here is the Moshiach, or: here! shall you (PL) it not believe.
because it will stand up false Moshiachs, and false prophets, and will give great signs and wonders, even to mislead, if possible, even the elect ones.
look, I have it you (PL) foretold.
when therefore they will you (PL) say: look, he is in the wilderness; shall you (PL) not go out; look, (in innermost) rooms; believe it not.
because just as the lightning comes out of east, and shine until west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
but where the death body is there will themselves gather the eagles.
and soon after the tribulation of those days, will the sun darkened become, and the moon will not give you (PL) light, and the stars will fall from heaven, and the powers of heaven will shaken to be.

and then will self appear the sign of the Son of Man in heaven, and then will all families of the earth lament, and will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with great power and glory. (Daniel 7, 13, 14.)
and He will send His angels with a great trumpet, and they will gather His chosen from the four winds, from one end heaven unto to the other end heaven.
and from the fig tree learn self the parable: when its branch becomes already juicy/ripe, and brings forth leaves, know you (PL), that summer is near.
so also you (PL), when you (PL) see this all, shall (you) know, that it is near at the door.
in truth tell I you (PL), the these generation will not pass away, until this all will to happen;
the heaven and the earth will pass away, my words however will never way not pass away,
but concerning that day and hour know no one not, even not the angels in heaven, also the Son not, except the Father alone.
because so as it was in days of Noah, so will it be at the coming of the Son of Man,
because as in those days before flood did they eat and drink, wedding had and wedding made, until to the day, when Noah is went in in the ark,
and have nothing known until the flood is come, and everyone carried away; so will also be at the coming of the Son of Man.
then will two be in field; one gets taken along, and one left behind.
two women will grind at the mill; one gets taken along, and one left behind.
therefore watch, because you (PL) know not, which day your L-rd comes.
this however shall you (PL) know, that if the owner of the house would known in which watch the thief comes, would he held watch, and not allows breaking under his house.
therefore shall you (PL) also be ready! because the Son of Man comes in a hour, when you (PL) think not.
who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge over his household, that he shall them give the food in the right time?
blessed is that servant, who, when his master comes, finds he him so do.
in truth tell I you (PL), he will him will put over all his possessions.
if however that evil servant will say in his heart: my master delays himself;
and will begin to beat up his co-servants, and to eat and drink with the drunkards;
so will the master of that servant come in a day, when he expects him not, and in a hour, which he knows not,
and will him cut up in pieces, and put his share with the hypocrites. there will be the weeping and gnashing with the teeth.
then will this kingdom of heaven be compared to ten young bridesmaids, who have taken their lamps, and are gone to meet the bridegroom.
and five of them are was foolish ones, and five wise ones.
because the foolish ones have taken the lamps, and not taken along with themselves any oil.
the wise ones however have taken oil in their vessels, together with their lamps.
and while the bridegroom has self delayed, have all dozed and are fall asleep.
around midnight (miten-nach) however is become a shout: look, the bridegroom comes! go him meet!
then have themselves those all young bridesmaids seized up (awake), and have brought in order their lamps.
and the foolish ones have said to the wise ones: give us of your oil; because our lamps extinquishing themselves out.
and the wise ones have answered, and said: for any case not! lest/in case will not enough for us and for you (PL)! go rather to the sellers, and buy (for) yourselves.
and while they are went away to buy, is the bridegroom come; and those, who are was ready, are entered with him on the wedding, and the door is shut become.
and later come also the remaining young bridesmaids, and say: L-rd, L-rd, open us up!
he however has answering said: in truth tell I you (PL), I know you (PL) not!
watch then; because you (PL) know not the day, and also not the hour.
because just like a man before departing, did call together his servants, and them handed over his possessions;
and (to) one did he give five talents, the other two (talents), and the third one (talent); everyone according to his own strength; and is soon went away.
and the one, who did received the five talents, went and did trade with them, and made another five (talents).
likewise the one, who did received the two talents, did make another two.
the one however, who did received the one (talent), went and did dig in the earth, and hid his the L-rd's money.
and after a long time comes the master of those servants, and makes a accounting with them.
and it is come the one, who had received the five talents, and had brought other five talents, and said: L-rd, you (SG) you have me handed over five talents; look, I have made another five talents.
had his master said to him: blessed! you (SG) good and faithful servant! you be were faithful over a few things, I will you sit in charge over a many; go in to your lord's joy!
is come also the one, who has received the two talents and has said: Master, you (SG) have me handed over two talents; look, I have made another two talents.
has his master to him said: blessed! you (SG) good and faithful servant! you be were faithful over a few things, I will you put in charge over a many; go in to your the L-rd's joy!

and it is come also the one, who has received the one talent. and has said: L-rd, I know you, that you (SG) are a hard man; you (SG) reap, where you (SG) you have not sown. and gather, where you (SG) you have not scattered;
and because I have fear had, am I go and have hidden your talent in the earth. here you have what is yours!
and his master did answering to him said: you (SG) wicked and lazy servant! you have known, that I reap, where I have not sown and gather, where I have not scattered;
should you therefore ought placed my money with the bankers, and at my coming would I taken up what is mine with interest.
take therefore of him (take) away the talent, and give it the one, who has the ten talents!
because every one, who has, will given to be, and he will have a abundance; from the one however, who has not, will from him taken away to be even the, what even what he does have.
and the worthless servant throw out in the outer darkness. there will be the weeping and gnashing with the teeth.
when however the Son of Man will come in his glory, and all angels with him, will he then sit on his throne of glory;
and before him will gathered to be all peoples, and he will them separate one from the other, just as a shepherd separates up the sheep from the goats.
and will stand the sheep on his right side, the goats however on the left side.
then will the king say to the on his right side: come here, you (PL) blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom, which is prepared become for your sake since the world is created become!
because I was hungry, and you (PL) have Me given to eat; I was thirsty, and you (PL) have Me given to drink; I was a stranger, and you (PL) have Me taken in;
a naked, and you (PL) have Me clothed; I am was sick, and you (PL) have self took care on Me; I have sat in prison, and you (PL) are come to Me.
then will the righteous him answer, so to say: L-rd, when have we you seen hungry, and have you fed, or thirsty and have you (SG) given to drink?
when have we you seen an stranger and you taken in, or naked and have you clothed?
when have we you seen a sick or in prison and are come to you (SG)?
and the king will answering say to them: in truth tell I you (PL), on how much you (PL) have it done to one of the these my brothers, the smallest, have you (PL) it done to Me!
then will he also say to the (one) on the left side: go went away from Me, you (PL) accursed, in the eternal fire into, which is prepared become before devil and his angels!
because I was hungry, and you (PL) have Me not given to eat; I was thirsty, and you (PL) have Me not given to drink:
an stranger am I was, and you (PL) have Me not taken in; naked, and you (PL) have Me not clothed; sick and in prison, and you (PL) have self not took care on Me,
then will also they to answer, so to say: L-rd, when have we you seen hungry or thirsty or an stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and have you not served?
then will he them to answer, so to say: on how much you (PL) have it not done to one of the these smallest, have you (PL) it also not done to Me!
and the these will going away to eternal punishment; the righteous however—to the eternal life.
and it is happened, when Yehoshua has finished all the these words, has he said to his disciples:
you (PL) know, that in two days around is Pesach, and the Son of Man becomes handed over for to hang up on a tree to become.
then have themselves gathered the chief kohenim, and the elders of the people, in the courtyard of the kohen gadol, who was named Caiapha;
and they have self conferred, so as to arrest Yehoshua with cunning, and him to kill.
but, have they said: not Yom Tov, so that it shall not become any riot among the people.
and while Yehoshua was in Beit-Anyah in Simon the Leper's house,
is come over to him a woman, who did have an alabaster bottle with very expensive ointment, and that did she poured out on his head, when he was sitting at the table.
when however the disciples have it seen, are they become angry, and said: why the this one waste?
because the these has one could (for) much value sold, and it give to poor people.
but Yehoshua has it notice, and has to them said: why make you (PL) grief of soul the woman? she did after all Me done a good!
because the poor people have you (PL) always with you (PL), Me however have you (PL) not always!
because pouring out the this ointment on my body, did she it do for my burial.
in truth tell I you (PL): where ever the this Good News will preached become in the whole world, will they also say, what she has done, her in remembrance!
then went one of the twelve, who was named Yehudah Ish Kriot, to the chief kohenim,
and has said: what will you (PL) me give, when I will him give over to you? and they have him weigh thirty pieces of silver.
and from then on did he seek a good opportunity, in order that he shall him betray.
and the first day of Feast of Unleavened Bread are the disciples went (come) over to Yehoshua, so to say: where you want should we prepare for you (SG) to eat the sacrifice Pesach?
and he has said: go in the city into to so and so, and say to him: the Rebbe says: my time is near; at your (place) will I make Pesach with my disciples.
and the disciples have done, as Yehoshua had them ordered; and prepared the Korban Pesach.
and when it is become evening, did he Himself sat down to the table with the twelve disciples.
and while they were eating, has he said; in truth tell I you (PL), that one of you (PL) will Me betray!
and they turned very grieved, and have begun, one after the other, to say to him: L-rd, am I the (one)?
and he has answering said: the one, who dips one the hand with Me in the bowl, the this one will Me betray.

the Son of Man go actually according to as it stands written about him; woe is however to that man, through whom the Son of Man gets betray! it were good for that man, if he would nothing born become.
and Yehudah, who did him betray, did (in) answering said: Rebbe, am I that? says he to him: you (SG) you have it said!
and while they were eating, has Yehoshua taken bread, and has made a bracha, has it broken, and given to the disciples, and said: take, eat! this is my body.
and he has taken a cup, made a bracha, and gave to them, saying: drink all from it!
because this is my blood of the new covenant, which being shed for many to the (medium) of forgiveness of sin.
I tell you (PL) however, I will more not drink from now on of the fruit from the vine, until to that day, when I will this drink with you (PL) new in the kingdom of my Father.
and they have end singing Hallel, and are go out to the Mount of Olives.

then says Yehoshua to them: you (PL) all will stumble become in Me in the this one night; because it stands written: I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will scattered to be. (Zechariah 13, 7.)
but after my standing up again, will I go ahead before you (PL) to Galilee.
Peter however has answering to him said: even when all will stumble to be in you (SG), will I me never not stumble!
has Yehoshua to him said: in truth tell I you (SG), that in the this one night, before a cock will a crow do, will you Me three times deny!
says Peter to him: and if I shall must die with you (SG), will I you never way not deny! likewise have also all disciples said.
then go Yehoshua with them on an place of, which called Gat-Shmanim, and says to the disciples: sit yourself here down, until I will go there and prayer do.
and he did taken along Peter and Zavdai's two sons, and did begin to mourn and to be grieved.
then says he to them: my soul is deep grieved, unto to the death! remains here, and watch with Me!
and went a little ahead, and is fall down on his face, has pray do and said: my Father if it is possible, shall going away from Me the this one goblet; yet not as I want, but as you (SG)!
and he goes to to the disciples, and finds them asleep, and says to Peter: so, you (PL) have not be able watch with Me one hour?
keep watch and do prayer, so that you (PL) shall not come to any temptation! the spirit is actually willing, the flesh however is weak.
