and others are those, who are sown among thorns; they are the ones who have heard the word;
and the worry of the world and the deception of riches, and the lusts after other things penetrate in and choke the word, and it remains without fruit.
and those are the ones who are sown been on the good earth; who hear that word, and accept it without, and bring fruit, one thirtyfold, and one sixtyfold, and one hundredfold.
and he has to them said: (question) comes then the light, so that placed to be under a measuring basket, or under bed? no, but so that it shall placed to be on the lampstand.
because any thing is not hidden, except so that revealed to become; and any thing is not hidden been, which will not widely known become.
if someone has ears to hear, shall he hear!
and he has to them said: give attention, what you (PL) hear! with what for a measure you (PL) measure, will you (PL) measured to be, and it will you (PL) more given to be a supplement.
because who it has, that one will given to be; and who it has not, of that one will taken away to be even that, which he has yes.
and he has said: thus is the kingdom of Hashem, as a man would throw the seeds on the earth,
and goes self sleep and stands up, by night and by day, and the seeds sprout out and grow up, without his knowing how.
from self alone brings the earth forth fruit; to the first the grass, then the stalk, after that full wheat in the stalk.
when however the fruit allows it, sends he immediately the sickle there, because the harvest time has already came.
and he has said: how shall we compare the kingdom of Hashem, or in what for a parable shall we it place?
it is like a mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, although it is the smallest of all seeds,
yet when it is sown, grows it up and becomes greater than all garden plants, and gives out great branches, that under its shade can the birds of heaven dwell.
and with a many such parables did he to them speak the word, according to as the way they are were able to hear;
and without a parable has he to them not spoke; and is he was with his disciples alone, has he them everything explained.
and that day, when it is become evening, has he to them said: let us cross over on the other side of sea.
and they have let the crowd people go, and did him take along, so as he was, in the boat; and yet other boats are was with him.
and it arose a great windstorm, and the waves have self toss on the boat, so that the boat has self already had almost filled.
and he himself was in the back part, sleeping on the cushion; and they wake him up and say to him: Rebbe, it bothers (care) you nothing, that we come die?
and he is stand up again, has rebuked the wind and said to the sea: be silent, be quiet! and the wind did cease, and it is become a great quietness.
and he has to them said: why are you (PL) so frightened? like, you (PL) have still all not any faith?
and they have self afraid with a great fear, and have said one to the other: who is he after all, that also the wind also the sea obeys him?
and they are come on the other side sea, in the land of the Gerasenes,
and when he is step out out the boat, is him immediately met coming from the graves out a man with an unclean spirit,
who has had his dwelling in the graves, and no one has him by now more not be able tie up, even not with any chain;
because a many times has they him bound with shackles and with chains, and he did the chains tear off and the shackles break, and no one has him not be able overcome.
and always, day and night, is he was among the graves and on the hillside, shouting and beating self with stones.
and as he has caught sight of Yehoshua from a distance, is he run and has self bowed before him;
and has a scream done with a loud voice, and said: what have I with you (SG), Yehoshua, you (SG) son of the Most High? I adjure you by Hashem, you (SG) you shall me not to torment!
because he has to him said: you (SG) unclean spirit, go out of the man!
and he has him asked: what for a name you have? and he has to him said: my name is Legion, because we are a many.
and he has him much begged, that he shall them not send out of the country.
and there at the hillside has self grazing a great herd swine.
and they have him begged, so to say: send us to the swine, so that we should go in in them!

and he has them given permission. and the unclean spirits are go out, and are go into the swine; and the herd did themselves a tear done from the steep cliff in sea into, about two thousand, and were drowned become in sea.
and the (ones) who have them grazing did run away, and have it report in the city, and on the country. and they is come to see what it is occur.
and they come to Yehoshua, and see the demoniac, who has had the Legion, sitting dressed and with a clear understanding; and they have self afraid.
and those, who did it see, have them report how it is happened with the demoniac, and about the swine.
and they have begun him to ask, that he shall go away from their borders.
and when he is step in in the boat, did him the one, who was possessed begged, that he shall with him remain.
and he has him not permitted, but says to him: go home to the your own, and relate them what kind a great things the L-rd has you (SG) done, and how he has self on you (SG) mercy on was!
and he is went away, and has begun call out in Decapolis all, that Yehoshua has for him done; and all have self amazed.
and when Yehoshua has self again sailed over in the boat on the other side, has themselves by him gathered a great crowd of people; and he was by the sea.
and it comes one of the Gaboyem of the synagogue, Yair has he called, and seeing him, falls he down before his feet,
and begs him very much, so to say: my young daughter holds beside losing soul; come lay on your hands upon her, so that she shall saved to be, and live!
and he has go with him, and a great crowd people has him followed, and him pressed in on.
and a woman, who has suffered of a blood flow twelve years long,
and has very much suffered from a many doctors, and spent all that she did have, and it did her nothing helped, but it is her even worse become,
having heard about Yehoshua, is she come among the crowd people of behind, and has touch his garment.
because she did self think: if I will touch only his clothing, will I helped to be!
and immediately did self wither the source of her blood; and she did feel in her body, that she is healed become of the affliction.
and Yehoshua, immediately as he has feel in self that the power is from him went out, did self turned around among the crowd people, and said: who has touched my clothing?
and his disciples have to him said: you (SG) you see the crowd throng you, and you say: who has me touched?
and he did self look around to see her, who has this very thing done.
the woman however, fearing self and trembling, because she did knew what it is with her happened, is come and is fell down before him, and has him said the entire truth.
and he has to her said: daughter, your faith has you (SG) helped; go in peace, and be well from your affliction!
while he has still speaking, comes they of the Gabe's house, so to say: your daughter has died; why are you bothering still the Rebbe?
Yehoshua however has not put any heed on the word which is spoken become, only has said to the Gabe: fear you not, believe only!
and did anyone not permit go with (him), except Peter, and James, and John James' brother.
and they come to the Gabe's house; and he sees a commotion, and they weep and wail very many.
and going inside says he to them: why (are) making commotion you (PL) and weep? the child is after all not died, it sleeps only.

and they have self laughed scornfully at him. he however, still these as he has everyone drive out, takes he the Father of the child and the mother, and the who are was with him, and go into where the child was.
and he has taken the child with the hand, and has to her said: Tabatha kumi! which translated is this: little girl (I tell you (SG)) stand up!
and this little girl is immediately stand up again, and is walked around; because she is already old was twelve years. and they are immediately astonished become with a great amazement.
and he has them very (strictly) informed, that no one shall self of it not find out; and has ordered they shall her give to eat.
and he is of there go away, and is come in his hometown into; and his disciples have him follow.

and when it is come Sabbath, has he begin to teach in the synagogue; and a many, when they have him heard, have astounded, and said: from where comes to him such (things)? and what is this kind of a wisdom, which is him given been? and such wonders happened by his hands!
(question) is he then not the carpenter, Miryams son, the brother of James and Yosi and Yehudah and Simon? and (question) are then not his sisters here with us? and they have stumbled in him.
and Yehoshua has to them said: any prophet is not without honor except in his fatherland and among his relatives and in his own house.
and he has there not be able do any wonders, except that he has lay the hands on a few sick ones, and them healed.
and he has self amazed over their unbelief.
and he did call to self the twelve, and did begin them send out two by (two), and them gave power over the unclean spirits;
and he did them order, that they should not to take along any thing on the way, but only a staff—not any bread, not any purse, not any money in belt;
but sandals should they (on) themselves tie, and not put on any two shirts.
and did to them say: wherever you (PL) will go in in a house, shall you (PL) there remain until you (PL) will depart from that place of.

and whatever place of it will you (PL) not receive, and they will you (PL) not want hear, shall you (PL) at the going away from there shake off the dust from under your (PL) feet, as an witness to them.
and they are gone out, and did proclaim, that one should repentance do,
and did cast out a many evil spirits, and anointed a many sick with oil, and them healed.
and the king Herod did hear about that, (because his name became known) and did say: John of the (Yarden) mikveh is stand up again from the dead, and therefore work the powers in him!
others however have said, that he is Eliyahu. and others have said, that he is a prophet like one of the prophets.
and when Herod has this heard, has he said: John, whom I have chopped off the head, he is again stood up.
because Herod himself had sent and permitted capture John, and did him bind in prison on account of Herodias, the wife of Philip his brother, because he did with her marriage had.
because John has said to Herod: you (SG) allowed not have your brother's wife!
and Herodias did him hate got, and him wanted kill, and has not be able;
because Herod has self afraid before John, knowing that he is an man righteous and holy; and did him defend. and when he did him hear, is he was in great dilemma, and yet has he him gladly heard.
and when it is come a convenient day, while Herod had on his birthday made a feast for his important people, and the high officers, and the most prominent people of Galilee,

is the daughter of Herodias herself come in and did dance, and she is well pleased Herod and his guests. and the king did say to the girl: ask of me what you (SG) want only, and I will it you (SG) give!
and he did her swear: what you (SG) you will ask, will I you (SG) give, up to a half of my kingdom.
and she has gone out, and did say to her mother: what shall I ask? and she did say: John of the (Yarden) mikveh's head!
and she did immediately go in quickly to the king, and did him ask, so to say: I demand, that you (SG) you shall me now give head of John of the (Yarden) mikveh on a plate!
and the king is grieved become, only on account of the oaths and the guests did he her not want reject.
and the king did immediately send a bodyguard, and did him order to bring his head; and he did go away and did him chop off the head in prison,
and brought his head on a plate, and has him given the girl; and the girl has him given to her mother.
and when his disciples did it hear, did they come and did take his body, and him put in a tomb into.
and the Shlichim have self gathered with Yehoshua; and him reported all, which they have done, and what they had taught.
and he did to them said: come you (PL) alone on an solitary place of, and rests self a little up! because a many were come and go, so that they did even not have any time to eat.
and they did depart in the boat to an solitary place of alone.
and one has them seen departing, and a many did they recognize, and are come there running on foot from all cities of ahead of before them.

and when Yehoshua did step down, has he seen a great crowd (of) people, and has had on them great compassion, because they are was as sheep, who have not any shepherd; and he did begin them a many to teach.
and when it is already become a late hour, did his disciples come over to him, and did say: this is a desert-like place of, and the hour is already late;
let them up (go), so that they shall go in the surrounding region and villages, and themselves buy something to eat.
he however has answering to them said: give you (PL) them to eat! and they did to him say: should we go and buy bread for two hundred denarii, and them give to eat?
he however has to them said: how much bread have you (PL)? go and see. and finding out self, did they say: five, and two fish.
and he did them order, that all should self sit down in a chavrusa group on the green grass.
and they did themselves sat down in lines, by hundreds, and by fifties.

and he did take the five bread and the two fish, did look up to the heaven, and made a blessing, and broke the breads; and did them give to the disciples, so that they should it put out before them; also the two fish did he divide among all.
and all have eaten and are filled become.
and they have picked up from the broken pieces twelve baskets full, and from the fish.
and those, who have eaten the breads, are was five thousand men.
and immediately has he compel his disciples step in in the boat, and to go across ahead on the another side to Beit-Tzaidah, until he will dismiss the crowd people.
and after that when he has self bid farewell with them, is he went away to the mountain prayer to do.
and when it is become evening, is the boat was in the midst sea, and he alone on the land.
and seeing how they struggled self with the oars, because the wind was against them, is he come to them, around the fourth watch of the night, walking on the sea, and has them wanted pass by;
but when they have him seen walking on the sea, have they thought, that it is a ghost, and have a scream did;
because all did him see, and have self terrified. he however did immediately speak with them, and to them said: be comforted; I am he;
fear self not! and he is step in by them in the boat, and the wind has self calm down. and they are in themselves very astounded become, over every thing;
because they have not understood about the breads, because their heart was hard (like stone).
and sailing over self to the land, are they come to Gennesaret, and did anchor.
and when they did step out of boat, has they him immediately recognized,
and they did rush about in that whole region, and they did begin carry the sick on the beds, where they did hear, that he is found.

and wherever he is gone in, in villages, or in towns, or on the land, has they put the sick on the marketplaces, and they did him beg, that they could but touch the hem/tzitzit of his garment; and all, who did him touch, were helped become.
and it have self gathered to him the Pharisees, and some of the scribes, who are come from Jerusalem;
and they have seen, that some of his disciples eat bread with unclean hands, that means without netilas yadayim;
because the Pharisees and all Jews, if they wash self not the hands until to the elbow, to eat they not, because they keep the tradition of the elders;

and when they come from marketplace, to eat they not, without themselves to wash; and a many other things are there, which they have taken over to keep, immersions of drinking vessels, and pots, and copper pots.
and the Pharisees and the scribes have him asked; why lead/live the halakhah self your disciples not on according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unclean hands?
he however did to them say; well did Yeshayah prophecies say about you (PL), hypocrites, as it stands written:
and in vain worship they Me, because they teach commands,
you (PL) abandon Hashem's commandment, and keep the tradition of men.
and did to them say: fine make you (PL) null and void Hashem's command, so that you (PL) shall keep your tradition.
because Moses did say: you (SG) you shall give honor your father and your mother, and the one, who curses father or mother, shall put to death to be. (Exodus 20, 12; 21, 17.)
you (PL) however say: if a man will say to the father or to the mother: sacrifice, that means a (exempt) gift to Hashem, shall be that which you (SG) need (as support) from me enjoyed to be;
allow you (PL) him now nothing more do for the father or for the mother;
you (PL) make negated Hashem's word by your tradition, which you (PL) have handed on; and a many such things do you (PL).
and did again call the crowd (of) people to himself, and to them said: hear Me all (of you) to, and understand!
there is not any thing from outside of the people, which (when) going inside into him can him impure make; only that which comes out from the people is it, which is defiling the people.
if someone has ears to the hear, shall he hear!
and when he is from the crowd people come in in house into, did his disciples him ask about the parable.
and he says to they, thus, also are you (PL) without understanding? (question) understand you (PL) then not, that all, that goes into in the people from outside, can him not defile?
because it goes not into in (his) heart, but into stomach, and it goes out in house (of) the (toilet) seat into. so around did he declare all foods clean.
and has said: what it comes out of the person, that is the person's defiling.
because from inside, out the heart of the person, come out the evil thoughts, fornication, theft, murder,
adultery, money greed, evil doing, deceit, debauchery, a evil eye, desecrating the name, conceit, unconcerned foolishness;
all the these evil things come out from inside, and make the person unclean.

and he has self picked up, and is from there went away to the borders of Tyre and Sidon. and when he is entered in a house, has he wanted, that no one shall it not know; and was not be able remain hidden.
but immediately did a woman about him heard, whose her young daughter did have an unclean spirit, and she is come and is fall down by his feet.
the woman is however was a Greek, a Syro-Phoenician according to nationality, and did him beg, that he shall cast out the evil spirit from her daughter.
and he has to her said: let first the children filled to be; because it is not fair to take the bread from the children and it cast before the dogs!
she however did answer and says to him: yes, L-rd; even the little dogs under table to eat of the broken pieces of the children!
and he did say to her: on account of that very word go you (SG); the evil spirit is already out of your daughter.
and she is went away to self home, and has found the child lying on the bed, and the evil spirit is already was gone out.
and he is again went out from the borders of Tyre, and went through Tzidon to the sea of Galilee, in the midst of the borders of the Ten Cities (Decapolis).
and they did bring carried in to him one, who was deaf and did stammer; and they has him begged, that he shall lay on him the hand.
and he has him taken away from the crowd people on a side, did lay his finger in his ears into, and did spit and touched his tongue;
and looking up to the heaven, did he give a sigh, and says to him; Ephphatha! that means open yourself up!
and his ears have self open up, and immediately has self the band/ribbon of his tongue loose up made, and he did correctly speak.
and he did them order that they should it nobody tell; however what more he did them order, all more did they this spread.
and they are was astonished from astonishment, and have said: he has everything well done; even the deaf makes he to hear, and the mute speak!
in those days, when there is again was a great crowd people, and they have not had what to eat, did he call to self the disciples, and says to they:
it does Me suffer about the crowd people, because already three days are they with Me remain, and have not what to eat;
and if I shall them allow go home fasting, will they languish on the way; because a some of them are come from distance.
and his disciples have him answered: from where will one here in the wilderness be able feed the these with bread?
and he has them asked: how many breads have you (PL)? have they said: seven.

and he has ordered the crowd people self sit on the ground; and has taken the seven breads, made a blessing, did them broke, and gave to his disciples, that they shall them distribute; and they did them distribute (among) the crowd people.
and they did have some small little fish; and when he has made a blessing, has he told (them) should also the these distribute.
and they have eaten, and did filled become; and have picked up, from the remaining broken pieces, seven baskets.
and there are was an about four thousand; and he did them send away.
and immediately is he step into in the boat together with his disciples, and is come in the regions of Dalmanutha.
and the Pharisees are go out, and did begin hold debates with him, seeking from him a sign from heaven, so that him to test.
and he did deeply sigh in his spirit, and said: why seeks the these generation a sign? in truth say I (to) you (PL): no sign will not given to be the this generation.
and (he) has them left, and is again step in in the boat, and is cross over on the other side.
and they have forgotten take along bread; and other than one loaf have they not had more with self in the boat.
and he has them warned, so to say: give attention, beware self before yeast of the Pharisees and before yeast of Herod!
and they did this discussed one with the other: this is because have not any bread.

and Yehoshua did this notice, and to them said: why have you (PL) (such) thoughts, since you (PL) have not any bread? (question) comprehend you (PL) still all not and are not understanding? is your heart still all hardened?
you (PL) have eyes and see not, and ears and hear not? and (question) remember you (PL) not,
when I did break the five breads for the five thousand, how much baskets full with broken pieces you (PL) did gather up? say they to him: twelve!
and when the seven (breads) for the four thousand, how many large baskets full with broken pieces you (PL) did gather up? and they say: seven!
and he has to them said: (question) are you (PL) still all not understanding?
and they did come to Beit-Tzaidah. and they did bring to him a blind man, and him begged, that he shall him touch.
and he did take the blind man by the hand, and him led out outside the village; did him spit on on the eyes, and laid on the hands on him, and him asked, (question) he see something.
and he has a glance done and said: I see the people; that like trees see I them walking!
after that has he again did place the hands on his eyes; and he did sharply look, and is healed become, and did everything see clearly even from a distance.
and he did him send away home, and said: in the village shall you (SG) even not go in!

and Yehoshua did went out, and his disciples, in the villages into from Caesarea of Philipos (Caesarea Philippi); and on the way did he ask his disciples, saying to them: who say the people, that I am?
and they did him answer, so to say: John of the (Yarden) mikveh; and others, Eliyahu; others however, that one of the prophets.
and he did them ask: you (PL) however, who say you (PL), that I am? answering said Peter to him: you (SG) are the Moshiach!
and he has them strictly inform, that they should anyone not tell about him.

and (he) did them begin to teach, that the Son of Man must to suffer a many, and rejected to be by the elders, and by the chief kohenim, and by the scribes, and killed to be, and in three days later again stand up.
and he did this word speak openly, not secretly. and Peter did him take on a side, and begin scream (rebuke) at him.

he however did self turn around, and looked at his disciples, and did rebuke at Peter, and says: go away, behind Me, Satan! because you (SG) have not in mind that, which is concerning Hashem, but that, which is concerning men!
and did call over to self the crowd people together with his disciples, and to them said: if someone wants Me to follow, let he self alone deny, and let him take his tree. and Me follow.
because who it wants save his soul/life, will it to lose; who however it will to lose his life because of me and the Good News, that (one) will it to save.
because what gains a man by wining the whole world, and by losing his soul/life?
because what for an ransom money shall a man give for his soul?

because who it will self to be ashamed with Me and with My words in the this adulterous and sinful generation, will the Son of Man self also to be ashamed with him, when he will come in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
and he did to them said: in truth tell I you (PL), there are there some, who stand here, who will not sample the taste of death, until they will see the kingdom of Hashem come with power.
and in six days later takes Yehoshua with self Peter, and James, and John, and lead them up on a high mountain one themselves; and he did self transfigured before them;
and his clothing did become dazzling, very white, as any fuller (of fabric) on the earth can not so white make.
and Eliyahu (the prophet) did himself to them appear together with Moshe (Rebbeinu), and they did speak with Yehoshua.
and answering says Peter to Yehoshua: Rebbe, it is good for us here to be; and let us make three tents: for you (SG) one, and for Moses one, and for Eliyahu one;
because he did not know, what he should answer; because they have self very afraid.
and a cloud is come and did them overshadow; and out the cloud is come a voice: the this one is my beloved son, him shall you (PL) listen!
and suddenly, looking around themselves, did they more nobody see, except Yehoshua alone with them.
and when they did go down from the mountain, did he them order, that they should anyone not tell, what they had seen, except when the Son of Man will be stand up again from the dead.
and they did hide that word, and have self asked one the other, what it means the standing up from the dead.
and did him ask, so to say: the scribes say, that Eliyahu must come to the first. (Malachi 4, 5-6.)

and he did to them say: Eliyahu comes actually at first, and puts everything back (restored); and how stands written about the Son of Man that he will a many to suffer and to nothing made become? (Yeshayah 53, 3.)
I tell you (PL) however, that Eliyahu is also already come, and they have with him done, what they have wanted, just as it stands written about him.
and coming to the disciples, have they seen a great crowd people around they, and scribes hold with them a dispute.
and immediately when the crowd people did him caught sight of, are they in awe become, and are him run toward and him give greeted welcome.
and he did them ask: over what hold you (PL) with them a dispute?
and one out of the crowd did him answer: Rebbe, I have brought to you (SG) my son, who has a mute spirit;

and wherever he seizes him without, tears/rips he him, and he foams at the mouth, and gnashes with the teeth, and becomes dried out (rigid); and I have already told your disciples, that they shall it cast out; and they have not been able to.
he however answering says to them: o, faithless generation! how long shall I yet be with you (PL)? until when shall I you (PL) tolerate? bring him here to Me!

and they have him brought to him; and as soon as he did him caught sight of, did the spirit him immediately a tear/rip did; and he is fall down on the earth, did self roll around, foaming at the mouth,
and he did ask his father: how long is already since the these is happened to him? and he did say: from childhood without;
and often did he him throw in fire into and in water into, so that he shall him kill; but if you (SG) have in any way able, help us, and have mercy you on us!
Yehoshua however did to him say: if you (SG) in any way able? all is possible for the one, who believes.
immediately did the father of the boy a shout did, and said: I believe; help my unbelief!

and when Yehoshua did see, that a crowd people were running themselves together, did he rebuke the unclean spirit, saying to him: you (SG) mute and deaf spirit, I order you (SG): go from him out, and you shall more not go in into him!
and he did a scream do, and did him very much rip/tear, and did go out (from him); and he did become as death, that a majority did say, that he is died!
Yehoshua however did him take by the hand, and him picked up; and he did himself stand up.
and when he did go in in the house, did his disciples, quite alone, him ask: why are we not were able him to cast out?
and he did to them say: the this one kind (evil spirit) can never way not go out, except through prayer and fasting.
and they did from there go away, and did go through Galilee; and he did not want, that anyone shall it know.

because he had taught his disciples, and to them said: the Son of Man will handed over to be into the hands of men, and they will him kill; and being killed, will he in three days later again stand up.
they however did not understood that word, and were self afraid him to ask.
and they did come to K'far-Nachum; and being in the house, did he them ask: about what were you (PL) self dispute were on the way?
they however were silent; because on the way did they hold a dispute one with the other, who it is the greatest.
and he has self sat down, and did call the twelve; and says to them: if one wants his the first, shall he be the last of all, and everyone's servant.
and did take a child, and it set down in their midst; and he did it take in his arms, and to them said:
who it will receive one of such children in my name, that (one) takes Me on; and who it takes Me on, that (one) welcomes not on Me, but the One, who did Me send.
John did to him say; Rebbe, we did see one casting out evil spirits in your Name; and we have this him forbid, because he follows us not after.
Yehoshua however did say: you (PL) shall him not forbid! because there is not there any man, who will do a miracles in my name, and who will quickly be able to speak evil on Me.
because who it is not against us, that (one) is for us.
because who it will you (PL) give to drink a small cup water, for my sake, because you (PL) belong to the Moshiach, in truth tell I you (PL), that (one) will never way not to lose his reward.

and who it will mislead to the stumbling one of the these small ones, who believe would it be much better for him if a large millstone would buried on his neck, and he would thrown become in sea into.

and if your hand misleads you to the stumbling, cut it off! it is better for you (SG) to enter into life into a cripple, than to have your both hands and to go in Gehenna into—in the fire, which extinquished itself not out, where their (grave) worm dies not, and the fire is not extinquished. (Yeshayah 66, 24.)

and if your foot misleads you towards temptation, chop it off! it is better for you (SG) to enter into life lame, than to have your both feet and thrown to be in Gehenna, where their (grave) worm dies not, and the fire is not extinquished.
and if your eye misleads you to the stumbling, take it out! it is better for you (SG) to go in in Hashem's kingdom with one eye, than to have two eyes and thrown to be into Gehenna into,
where their (grave) worm dies not, and the fire is not extinquished.
because every one must salted to be with fire.
this salt is good; if however the salt becomes unsalty, with what will you (PL) it season? have salt in yourself, and live in peace one with the other.
and he is stand up again from there, and is come to the borders of Yehudah and of Beyond Yarden; and again have crowds of people themselves gathered by him; and as usual, did he them again teach.
and Pharisees are come over to him, and have him asked, if a man permitted self divorce with the wife; testing him.
he however has answering said to them: what did you (PL) Moses command?
and they have said: Moses did permit (you PL) to write a book of divorce (divorce certicate) and her send away. (Deuteronomy 24, 1)
Yehoshua however did to them say: on account of the hardness of your heart did he you (PL) write the these command;
from beginning of the creation however has Hashem them created male and female. (Genesis 1, 27.)
therefore will a man leave his father and the mother, and self unite with his wife,
and the two will be one flesh (Genesis 2, 24); thus are they more not two, but one flesh.
therefore what Hashem has paired together was, that shall no man not separate!
and in the house did the disciples him again ask about the this one thing.
and he did to them say: who it divorces self with his wife, and has wedding with an another, is he committing adultery against her;
and if she divorces self with her husband, and has wedding with an other, does she adultery.
and they did to him bring small children, so that he shall them touch; the disciples however did rebuke on them.
and when Yehoshua did this see, did it him resent, and he did to them said: allow the small children come to Me; forbid it them not; because for their kind is the kingdom of Hashem!
in truth say I you (PL): who it will not receive the kingdom of Hashem as a young child, that (one) will never way not enter therein!
and did them take on his arms, and blessed (them), placing the hands upon they.
and while he is went out on the way, is him one run forward (toward), and is fell down before him on the knee, and did him ask: Rebbe good one, what shall I do, so that I shall inherit eternal life?
and Yehoshua did to him say: why call Me good? no one is not good, except Hashem alone!

the commandments you know: you (SG) shall not murder! you (SG) shall not commit adultery! you (SG) shall not steal! you (SG) shall not false witness say! you (SG) shall not rob! you (SG) shall give honor (to) your father and your mother! (Exodus 20, 12-16.)
and he did to him say: Rebbe, all the these have I observed from my youth without.

and Yehoshua did on him a glance do and him love got, and said to him: one thing lack you (SG); go, sell all, what you (SG) you have, and give it to the poor people, and you (SG) you will have an treasure in heaven; and come, and follow Me after!
he however is sad become over the word, and is went away a sad person, because he did have a large possessions.
and Yehoshua has self look around, and says to his disciples: o, how hard it is for the (ones), who have riches to enter into the kingdom of Hashem!

and the disciples are amazed become over his words. Yehoshua however again answering has to them said: children, o, how difficult it is for the, who have confidence in money, to enter in the kingdom of Hashem!
it is easier for a camel to go through the hole of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of Hashem.
and they are further astounded become, and did among themselves speak: and who then can saved to be?
Yehoshua did a look do on them and says: with people is it impossible, but not with Hashem; because everything is possible with Hashem.
Peter did begin to speak to him: look, we have everything left, and have you (SG) followed!

has Yehoshua said: in truth say I you (PL): it is not there no one, which has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or mother, or father, or children, or fields, on account of me, and on account of the News Good,
who will not receive hundred times as much now in the this one time, houses, and brothers, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and fields, with persecutions; and in the coming world eternal life.
however a many first (ones) will be last (ones); and the last first.

and they are were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Yehoshua did go ahead before them; and they were astounded; and those, who had followed, have self fearful. and he did again take the twelve to self, and did begin to speak to them about the things, which will come on him:

look, are going we up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will turned over to be to the chief kohenim and the scribes; and they will him condemn to the death, and him give over to the nations (of the world);
and they will mock of him, and spit on him, and will him flog, and kill; and in three days around will he again standing up again.
and James and John, Zavdai's sons, are went (come) over to him, and did to him say: Rebbe, we request, that you (SG) you shall for us do, what we will you ask!
and he did to them say: what request you (PL), that I shall do for your sake?
and they have to him said: give us, that we should sit, one on your right side, and one on your left side, in your glory!
Yehoshua however has to them said: you (PL) know not what you (PL) ask! (question) can you (PL) then drink the goblet, which I drink? or immersed to be with the mikveh, with which I am immersed?
and they have said to him: we can! Yehoshua however has to them said: the goblet, which I drink, will you (PL) drink; and with the mikveh, with which I am immersed, will you (PL) immersed to be;
but to sit on my right side or left side is not mine to give, but (it is for the) for whom it is prepared been.
and when the ten did this hear, did they begin to be in anger on James and John.
and Yehoshua did them call to self, and says to them; you (PL) know, that those, who counted to rule over the nations, oppress them; and their great ones dominate over them.
with you (PL) however is it not so; but who it will want become a gadol among you (PL), will he be your servant;
and who it will want be among you (PL) the first, will he be everyone's servant.
because even the Son of Man is not come served to be, but to serve, and to give his life as an ransom for many.
and they come to Yericho. and when he is went out from Yericho, with his disciples and an visible crowd people, is Timai's son, Bar-Timai, a blind man beggar, sat by the road.
and on hearing, that it is Yehoshua of Natseret, did he begin to shout, and say: Son of David, Yehoshua, have mercy on me!
and a many did rebuke on him, so that he shall be silent; he however did even much more shout: Son of David, have mercy on me!
and Yehoshua has self stood still, and said: call him. and they call the blind man, and said to him: be comforted; stand up, he calls you!
and he has thrown away his garment, and self stood up on the feet, and is come to Yehoshua.
and Yehoshua has answering to him said: what you want, that I shall you (SG) do? and the blind man did to him say: Rabboni, that I shall sighted become!
and Yehoshua did to him say: go; your faith has you (SG) helped! and immediately was he sighted become, and did him follow on the road. (Yeshayah 42, 6-7)
and when they get closer self to Jerusalem, to Beit-Pagey and Beit-Anyah, beside the Mount of Olives, sends he two of his disciples,

and says to them: go in the village into, which is opposite you (PL); and as soon as you (PL) will come in there, will you (PL) find a young small donkey tied up, on which no man is never not sat; untie it, and bring it.
and if someone will to you (PL) say: why do you (PL) this? shall you (PL) say: the L-rd has it need, and sends it soon back here.
and they are go away, and have found a young small donkey tied up by a door outside at the cross road; and they untie it.
and some, who are there standing, have to them said: what do you (PL), untying this small donkey?
and they did to them say just as Yehoshua has commanded; and they have them allowed.
and they bring the young small donkey to Yehoshua, and place on it their cloaks; and he has self thereon sit on.
and a many have spread out their garments on the road; and others have spread out branches, which they have cut off on the fields.
and those, who are walking ahead, and those, who did follow, have shouted: Hosanna! praised is the (one), who comes in the Name of the L-rd! (blessed which comes in the Name of Hashem)
blessed is this kingdom of our father David, who comes! Hosanna in highest! (Psalms 118, 26)

and he is entered to Jerusalem in Beis HaMikdash into; and after the as he has self on all look around, because it is already was a late evening hour, is he went out to Beit-Anyah together with the twelve.
and in the morning, when they are gone out from Beit-Anyah, is he become hungry.

and seeing from a distance a fig tree, which has had leaves, is he go there, perhaps will he something find on it; and when he is come over to it, has he nothing found except leaves; because it is not was the season for figs.
and he has answering said to it: it shall no longer until on eternal anyone not to eat from you (SG) any fruit! and his disciples have it heard.

and they come to Jerusalem. and he is entered in House the Holy. and has begun to cast out those, who have sell and buy in house the Holy, and overturned the tables of the money changers, and the benches of the sellers of doves.
and he did not allow, that anyone shall carry through a vessel through the House the Holy.

and he did them teach, and did to them say: (question) stands then not written: my house shall called to be a house prayer for all nations? (Yeshayah 56, 7) you (PL) however have it made for a robbers den! (Yirmeyah 7, 11.)
and the chief kohenim and the scribes have this heard. and they did seek how him to destroy; because they did fear have before him, because the whole crowd people were astounded over his teaching.
and when it is become evening, is he went out outside the city.
and when they did pass by in the morning, have they seen the fig tree wither until to the roots.
and Peter has self remembered and says to him: Rebbe, look, the fig tree, which you (SG) you have cursed, is withered become!
and Yehoshua has answering to them said: have faith in Hashem!

in truth tell I you (PL): who it will say to the this mountain: lift you up and throw yourself into sea into! and will not be doubtful in his heart, but will believe, that what he says will happened, will it (thus) be for him.
therefore say I you (PL): all, on which you (PL) will prayer do and ask, believe, that you (PL) have it received, and it will (thus) be to you (PL).

and when you (PL) has self standing and are praying, shall you (PL) forgive be, if you (PL) have something against for whom; so that also your Father in heaven shall you (PL) forgive his your (PL) transgressions.
if however you (PL) will not forgive his, will your Father in heaven you (PL) also not forgive your (PL) transgressions.
and they come again to Jerusalem. and while he is walking about in House the Holy, come to him the chief kohenim, and the scribes, and the elders;
and say to him: with what for a authority do you do the these things? or who has you (SG) given the this authority, so that you (SG) you shall do the these things?
and Yehoshua has to them said: I will you (PL) ask one question, and answer Me, and I will you (PL) say, with which authority I do the these things.
(question) is the mikveh of John was from heaven, or from people? answer Me!
and they have it reasoned among self, so to say: will we say: from heaven, will he say: then why has you (PL) him not believed?
will we however say: from man?—have they fear had before crowd; because all have held, that John is really was a prophet.
and answering say they to Yehoshua: we know not! and Yehoshua says to them; tell I you (PL) also not, with what for a authority I do the these things!

and he has begun to speak to them in parables. a man has planted a vineyard, and it encircled with a fence, and has dug a winepress, and built a tower, and has it leased to wine gardeners, and is went away.
and to the right time has he sent a servant to the wine gardeners, that he shall received of the wine gardeners of the fruit from the vineyard.
and they have him taken, and have him beat up, and sent away with nothing.
and he has again to them sent an other servant; and that one have they beat up the head, and disgraced.
after an other has he sent; and that one have they killed; and a many others; a part of them have they beat up, and a part—killed.
still one did he have, a beloved son; him has he sent last to them, so to say: they will self to be ashamed before my son!
those wine gardeners however have among themselves said: this is the heir; comes, let us him kill, and the inheritance will be ours!
and they have taken, and him killed, and have him thrown out of vineyard.
well, what will the L-rd of the vineyard do? he will come and kill the wine gardeners, and the vineyard will he give to others.
(question) have you (PL) then not read the this verse:
from the L-rd (Hashem) is this happened,
and they have sought him to arrest; and have fear had before the crowd people; because it was known, that he has said the parable on them; and they have him left, and are went away.
and they send to him some of the Pharisees and of Herod's people, so that they should him trap with a word.

and when they are come, say they to him: Rebbe, we know, that you (SG) are truthful, and show deference not on anyone; because you (SG) look not on the face of people, but in truth teach the derech of Hashem. (question) (is it) permitted one give tax to the emperor, or not? should we give or not give?
he has however known of their hypocrisy, and has to them said: why putting to test you (PL) Me out? bring Me a denarius, so that I shall it see.
and they have brought. and he says to them: whose is this very image and the title? and they have to him said: the Caesar's!
and Yehoshua has to them said: give then up the Caesar the, which is the Caesar's, and to Hashem the, what is Hashem's! and they have self astonished on him.
and there come to him Sadducees, which say, that it is there is not any resurrection of the dead ones; and have him asked, so to say:
Rebbe, Moses has us written, that if anyone's brother will die, and leave a wife, and not leave any child, so shall his brother take the woman, and raise up seeds to his brother. (Deuteronomy 25, 5.)
there are were seven brothers. and the first has taken a wife, and is died and has not left any seeds;
and the second has her taken, and is died, not leaving any seeds; and the third also thus;
and the seven have not left any seeds. last after all is also the woman died.
in the resurrection of the dead ones, when they will standing up again, whose wife of them will she be? because all seven have her after all had for a wife.
did Yehoshua to them say: (question) wandering around (lost) you (PL) then not therefore, because you (PL) know not the scriptures (the Holy), and also not the power of Hashem?
because when they will rise of the dead, will they not wedding have, not they will them wedding make; but they are as the angels in heaven.

and concerning the dead, that they will standing up again, (question) have you (PL) then not read in the book of (law of) Moses, by the bush, as Hashem has to him spoken, so to say: I am the G-d of Abraham, and the G-d of Isaac, and the G-d of Jacob? (Exodus 3, 7.)
he is not the G-d of the dead, but of the living ones: you (PL) wandering around (lost) very much.
and it is come over one of the scribes, having self listened to their debate, because he has known, that he has them well answered, has he him asked! what is the first commandment of all?
Yehoshua has answered: the first is: Hear Israel Hashem our G-d Hashem echad;
and you (SG) you shall love have the L-rd your G-d with your whole heart, and with your whole soul, and with your whole understanding, and with your whole power. (Deuteronomy 6, 4-5.)
the second (command) is: you (SG) you shall love have your neighbor as you yourself. (Leviticus 19, 18) not other command greater than the these is not there.
and the scribe has to him said: good, Rebbe! you (SG) you have truthfully spoken, that Hashem is one; and it is not there any another except him;

and him love to have with the whole heart, and with the whole understanding, and with the whole power, and love to have the neighbor as self alone, is a many more as all burnt offerings and sacrifices.
and Yehoshua did see, that he has sensible answered, did he to him say: you (SG) are not distant from the kingdom of Hashem! and no one has more not self dare to him to pose questions.
and Yehoshua has answering said, while he has taught in the House the Holy: how say the scribes, that the Moshiach is David's son?
David (the king) himself has after all said through the Spirit the Holy:
David himself calls him L-rd, and from where is he his son? and the great crowd (of) people did self eagerly to listen to him.
and in his teaching has he said: beware before the scribes, who have love to go aroune in prayer shawls, and that should they greet on the marketplaces,
and the prominent first seats in the synagogues, and places at the head (of honor) on the feasts;
they who swallow the houses of widows, and pray pretentiously long: they will received a greater judgment.
and he did self sat down opposite the treasure box, and self observed as the crowd people throw into money in the treasure boxes into; and a many rich people have thrown much.
and it is come a poor widow, and did put in two small coins, this is one quadrans, (the smallest roman coin.)
and he did call over his disciples, and to them said: in truth say I you (PL): the this poor widow did more thrown in than all, who did throw in in the treasure box into;
because all had throw in from their abundance; she however did from her need throw in all, which she has had—her whole livelihood.
and when he is went out from the House the Holy, says one of his disciples to him: Rebbe, look, what for a stones and kind of buildings!
and Yehoshua has to him said: you (SG) you see the these great buildings? it will not left to be any stone upon a stone, which will not broken become!
and while he is sat on the Mount of Olives, opposite the House the Holy, did Peter and James and John and Andrew him ask, when they are was alone:
tell us, when will that be? and what is the sign, when this all must fulfilled become?
and Yehoshua did begin say to them: give attention, that no one shall you (PL) not mislead.
a many will come in my name, and say: I am he, and will a many mislead.
and when you (PL) will hear about wars and rumors of wars, shall you (PL) self not be alarmed; this must to happen; but it is yet not the end.
because a nation will rise against a nation, and kingdom against kingdom; there will be earthquakes here and there; there will be famines; the these are the beginning of the woes.

you (PL) however give attention on self alone! one will you (PL) give over to the Sanhedrin; and one will you (PL) give lashes in the synagogues; and you (PL) will placed to be before governors and kings on account of me, for a witness to them.
and among all nations must to the first the good News announced to be.

and when they will you (PL) lead and turn (you) over, shall you (PL) self not make any worry beforehand, what you (PL) shall speak, but who it will you (PL) given to be in that hour, that speaks. because not you (PL) are it, who speaks, but the Spirit the Holy.
and a brother will betray a brother to the death, and a father a child; and children will rise up against parents, and will them kill.
and you (PL) will be hated by everyone on account of my name; who however it will endure until to the end, that (one) will saved to be.
and when you (PL) will see the abomination of the desolation stone where it must not—shall the reader understand (Daniel 12, 11)—then should those, who are in Yehudah, flee to the mountains;
who it is on the roof, the shall not descend, and not go in, something take of his house out;
and who it is in field, let not return back to take his garment.
however woe is to the pregnant and nursing ones in those days!
be however pray, that it shall not to happen in winter.
because those days will be a tribulation, such what become the equal is not happened since the beginning of the creation, which Hashem has created, until the present time, and it will more not be.
and if the L-rd would not shortened the days, would no flesh (and blood) not saved become; but on account of the elect ones, whom he has chosen, has he shortened the days. (Daniel 12, 1.)
and if someone will you (PL) then say: look here is the Moshiach! look, there! shall you (PL) it not believe;
because it will arise false Moshiachs and false prophets, and will do signs and wonders, so that to mislead, if possible, the elect ones.
you (PL) however give attention; look, I have you (PL) all ahead foretold!
but in those days, after that tribulation, will the sun darkened to be, and the moon will not give its light, (Yeshayah 13, 10.)
and the stars will fall from heaven, and the powers in heaven will shaken become. (Yeshayah 34, 4.)
and then will one see the Son of Man come in the clouds with great power and glory. (Daniel 7, 13-14)
and then will he send the angels, and gather his chosen from the four winds, from end (of the) earth unto end heaven.
and learn this parable of the fig tree; when its branch is already juicy/ripe, and brings forth the leaves, know you (PL), that summer is near.
so also you (PL), when you (PL) will see the these things happening, shall you (PL) know, that it is near with the doors.
in truth tell I you (PL): the these generation will not pass away, until all the these things will happened.
the heaven and the earth will pass away, however my words will not pass away.
but about that day or hour knows no one not, not even the angels in heaven, not the Son (of the Most High), only the Father.
give attention, sleep not and do prayer! because you (PL) know not when the time is.
as a man, travelling, did leave his house, and gave power to his servant, each one his work, and the doorkeeper did he order, that he shall watch.
therefore watch, because you (PL) know not when the owner of the house comes, (question) in evening, or middle of the night, or when the cock crows, or in the morning;
lest will he suddenly come, and you (PL) find sleeping.
and what I tell you (PL), say I (to) everyone: watch!
and in two days around was Pesach and Feast of unleavened bread; and the chief kohenim and scribes were seeking how him to arrest with craftiness,
and him to kill. for they have said: not day good, lest will become a riot among people!

and while he was in Beit-Anyah in the house of Simon the leper, sitting at the table, is come a woman with an alabaster bottle full with real costly spike-nard; and she did break the alabaster bottle, and pour out on his head.
are however were some, who became furious among themselves, (so to say:) why is the these waste of the ointment made become?
because one could sell the this ointment for more than three hundred denarii, and it give to the poor people. and they have self scolded on her.
Yehoshua however has said: leave her alone! why cause you (PL) her grief of soul? she has Me done a good thing.
because the poor people have you (PL) always with yourselves, and when you (PL) want, can you (PL) they do good; Me however have you (PL) not always.
what she has be able, that did she do; she has beforehand anointed my body to the burial.
and in truth tell I you (PL): wherever the Good News will announced to be in the whole world, will also reported to be, who she has done, in memory of her.
and Yehudah man from Kriot, one of the twelve, is went away to the chief kohenim, so that him to give over to them.
and when they did it hear, did they rejoice, and him promised to give money. and he did seek a convenient opportunity, him to betray.

and the first day of Feast of unleavened bread, when they has ritually slaughtered the sacrifice Pesach, say to him his disciples: where you want, should we go and prepare, so that you (SG) you shall to eat the sacrifice Pesach?
and he sends two of his disciples, and says to them: go in the city into, and it will you (PL) meet a man, carrying a jar with water; him shall you (PL) follow;
and where ever he will go in, shall you (PL) say to the owner of the house: the Rebbe says: where is my guest room, in which I shall to eat this sacrifice Pesach with my disciples?
and he will you (PL) to show a large upper room, furnished with pillows for head of seder table, prepared; and there shall you (PL) prepare for us.
and the disciples are went out, and are come in the city into, and have found so as he has them told; and they did prepare the sacrifice Pesach.
and when it is become evening, comes he with the twelve.
and while they have self recline and eat, did Yehoshua say: in truth say I you (PL): one of you (PL) will Me betray, the one, who eats with Me! (Psalms 41, 9.)
did they begin grieved to become, and to say to him one after other: surely not I?
he however did to them say: one of the twelve, the (one), who dips together with Me in the bowl.

the Son of Man goes actually according to as it stands written about him; woe is however to that one man, through whom the Son of Man becomes betray! it would be good for that man, if he would not born become!
and while they have eaten, did he take bread, made a blessing, did it break, and gave to them, and said: takes; this these is my body.
and he has taken a goblet, did make a blessing, and gave to them; and they did all drink thereof.
and he did to them say: this these is my blood of the new covenant, which is shed for many.
in truth tell I you (PL): I will not more drink of the fruit from the vine, until to that day, when I will it drink new in the kingdom of Hashem.
and when they did finish singing Hallel, are they went out to the Mount of Olives.
and Yehoshua said to them: all will you (PL) stumbled to be; because it stands written: I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will scattered to be. (Zechariah 13, 7.)
but after my standing up again, will I you (PL) go ahead to Galilee.
Peter however has to him said: even if all will stumbled to be, will I yet not.
and Yehoshua says to him: in truth tell I you (SG): today, in the this very night, before the cock will twice crow, will you Me three times deny!
he however did yet zealously speak: if I shall must die together with you (SG), will I you never way not deny. and likewise have also all said.
and they come to a yard, which has called Gat-Shmanim; and he says to his disciples: sit self here down, until I will have prayer done.
and he takes Peter with self and James and John, and has begun to shake and tremble.
and he says to them: my soul is very grieved, unto to the death; remain here, and watch!
and he went a little farther, and is fell down on the earth, and was davening, that, if possible, the hour shall him pass (from).
and has said: Abba, Father, all is possible for you (SG); take from Me away the this goblet! yet not what I want, but what you (SG) want.
and he comes, and finds them asleep, and says to Peter: Simon, you (SG) sleep? are not able be one hour (at) watch to remain?
watch and do prayer, so that you (PL) shall not come to any temptation; the spirit is actually willing, this flesh is however weak!
and he is again went away, and prayer done, saying the same words.
and when he is return, has he them (once) again found asleep, because their eyes are was heavy; and they have not known what him to answer.
and he comes to the third times, and says to them: sleep further, and rest self up! it is enough; it is come the hour; look, the Son of Man is being handed over to sinners in the hands into.
stand up, let us go; look, My betrayer is already near!
