because he has commanded the unclean spirit come out of from the man; because a many times has it him already seized, and they has him bound with chains and shackles and held under guard; and he used tear apart this, with which he was bound and is driven become by the evil spirit in the wilderness into.
and Yehoshua has him asked: what is the name your? and he has said: Legion! because a many evil spirits are into in him.
and they have him begged, that he shall them not command to go in abyss into.
and there was a great herd swine feeding self on the hill, and they have him begged, that he shall them let to enter in them. and he has it them (granted) permission.
and the evil spirits are went out of the man and are into in the swine; and the herd has self a tear down done from the slope rock in sea into and is drown become.
as however the swineherds have seen, what it has strike/affect, are they run away and have it reported in the city and in the villages.

and they are went out see, what it has happened and are come to Yehoshua, and have found the man, from whom the evil spirits are (gone) out, clothed and with the clear thoughts (right mind) and he is sat at Yeshua's feet; and they have self afraid.
the (ones) however, who have it seen, have to them reported, how the demoniac is helped become.

and the whole crowd people of the region of the Gerasenes have him begged, that he shall going away from them; because it has them seized a great fear. and he is step in in a boat and has self went (to return) back.
the man however, from whom the evil spirits are (gone) out, has him begged, that he shall remain with him; he however has him sent away, so to say:
turn you back homeward and relate, what Hashem has you (SG) done, and he is went away and has known made over the whole city all, what Yehoshua has for him done.
and when Yehoshua has self returned, has the crowd of people him welcomed, because all were waiting on him.
and look, it is come a man with the name Yair, a Gabe of the synagogue is he was; and is fell down before Yeshua's feet and has him begged, that he shall go in in his house.
because he has had an one only daughter not quite twelve years old, and she had held near death. and while he is go there have the crowds of people self pressed around him.
and a woman, who has had a blood flow already twelve years long, which has spent her all possessions on physicians, and has from anyone not be able healed to be,
is come of behind, has touched the hem/tzitzit of his garment, and suddenly has the flow of her blood self stopped.
and Yehoshua has said: who has me touched? and when all have denied, has Peter said: L-rd, the crowds of throng self around you (SG) and push you after all.
Yehoshua however has said: someone has me touched; because I know, that a power is from me went out!

and as the woman has seen, that it is not remain hidden, is she trembling come and fell down before him and has reported before entire people, for which reason she has him touched, and how she is suddenly healed become.
and he has to her said: daughter, the faith your has you (SG) helped; go in peace!
while he has still spoken, is someone come from the Gabe's house, so to say: your daughter is already died; trouble more not the Rebbe.
and that Yehoshua has it heard, has he answered to him: have not any fear; believe only and she will saved to be!
and when he is come in in house, has he anyone not allowed with him except Peter and John and James and the father of the child and the mother.
and all have weep and wail over her; he however has said: weep not, she is not died, she sleeps only.
and they have self laughed of him, because they have known, that she is yes died.
he however has her taken with the hand and has called, so to say: child, stand up!
and her spirit has self returned, and in an eye blink is she stand up again; and he has commanded, they shall her give to eat.
and her parents are astounded become; he however has them announced, nobody to say, what it is happened.
and he has called together the twelve, and has them given power and authority over all evil spirits and to heal diseases.
and has them sent to proclaim the kingdom of Hashem and healed to make the sick.
and has to them said: take nothing with on the way—not any staff, not any leather pouch, not any bread, not any money, you (PL) shall also not have any two tunics.
and in which no (matter) is house you (PL) will come in, remain there, and from there shall you (PL) go further.
and where they will you (PL) not receive, go out from that city, shall you (PL) shake off the dust from your (PL) feet for an witness against them.
and they are went away, and are go over the villages, have announced the good News and healed everywhere.
and Herod the Tetrarch has heard all, what it is happened; and has self troubled, on account of that which some have said, that John is stand up again from the dead;
some however (have said), that Eliyahu has self appeared; and others—that one of the old prophets is raised up.
Herod however has said: the John have I chopped off the head; who however is the this one, about whom I hear such things? and he has sought him to see.
and when the Shlichim have self returned, have they him reported all, what they have done. and he has them taken to self (yechidus) and is went away in a city into, which was called Beit-Tzaidah.

the crowds however have self find out, and have him followed, and he has them welcomed, and spoken to them about the kingdom of Hashem, and the (ones), who have self had need in a healing, has he healed.

the day however has self already begun to decline; and the twelve are come over, and have said to him: let (send away) up the crowd (of) people, so that they should going away in the neighboring villages and fields to spend the night and to find food; because we are here in a solitary place of.
he however has to them said: give you (PL) them to eat! have they said: we have no longer than five breads and two fish; unless we should go and buy food for the this entire people.
because are was not quite five thousand men. he however has said to his disciples: make them self sit in groups, more less to fifty.
and they have so done and have (to) everyone sit down.
and he has taken the five breads and the two fish, has he looked up to the heaven, made a blessing and has them broken and given to the disciples to put out before the crowd people.
and they have eaten and are all filled become; and they has picked up, of the broken pieces (Rebbe's leftovers), which are left over, twelve baskets (full).
and it is happened while he has prayer done one alone, and the disciples are was with him, has he them asked, so to say: who, say the people, that I am?
and they have answering said: John of the (Yarden) mikveh; others however (say) Eliyahu; and others, that one of the old prophets is stand up again.
has he to them said: and who, says you (PL), that I am? Peter has answering said: the Moshiach of Hashem!
and he has them strictly forbidden, the these anyone to tell,
and has said; the Son of Man must a many to suffer and rejected to be of the elders and chief kohenim and scribes and killed to be and the third day stand up/arise.
and he has to (to) everyone said: who it wants me follow, this one shall self alone deny and take his tree on self day out day one and me follow.
because who it wants save his soul, this one will it to lose; who however it will to lose his soul for my sake, this one will it save.
because what profits it a man, that he shall gain the whole world, and to lose or hurt self alone?

because who it (is) ashamed self with me and with the words my, with the this will the Son of Man self to be ashamed, when he will come in his glory and (in the glory) of the Father and of the holy angels.
and in truth tell I you (PL); some of the (ones), who stand here, will not sample the taste of death, until they will see the kingdom of Hashem.
and it is happened about eight day after the these words, that he has taken Peter and John and James and is climb up on the mountain prayer to do.
and while he has pray, has the appearance of his face self transfigured and his clothing did become dazzling white.
and look, two men have spoken with him, which are was Moses and Eliyahu;
they have self shown in glory and have spoken about his departure (histalkus), what he was about to fulfill be in Jerusalem.
Peter however and the (ones), who are was with him, are weighed down in a heavy sleep; and (when) fully awake self, have they seen his glory and the two men, who are standing with him.

and it is happened, when they are went away from him, has Peter said to Yehoshua; L-rd, it is good for us here to be; and let us make three booths: one for you (SG), one for Moses and one for Eliyahu, not knowing, what he speaks.
and while he has spoken, is come a cloud and has them overshadow; and they have fear got as they are come in in the cloud into.
and it is come out a voice of the cloud, so to say: the this one is my son, the chosen one, him shall you (PL) listen!
and while the voice is heard become, has Yehoshua self found all alone. and they were silent and in those days have they anyone nothing report of the things, which they have seen.
and it is happened the next day, when they are come down from the mountain, is him met coming a great crowd people.
and look, a man from the crowd people has a shout done, so to say: Rebbe, I beg you, look you over on my son, because he is my son of only;
and look, a spirit takes hold him onwards, and suddenly is crying out he and tears him, that he foams before mouth, and go scarcely went away from him and bruise him,
and I have already begged your disciples, that they should him cast out, and they were not been able.
and Yehoshua has answering said: o faithless and perverse generation! until when will I be with you (PL) and you (PL) endure be! bring here the son yours!
and while he is still was on the way to him, has the evil spirit him a tear done and convulsed. Yehoshua however has rebuked on the unclean spirit, and healed the boy and him give to his father.
and all are astounded become over Hashem's immense power.
let the these words penetrate in your (PL) ears into: because the Son of Man will handed over to be in the hands of men.
they however have not understood the these word and it was hidden from them, so that they shall not know the meaning of it; and they have fear had him to question about the this word.
and it is them gone up a argument: who of them it shall be the greatest.
and when Yehoshua has seen the mind of their heart, has he taken a child and it stood beside self,

and has to them said: who it will receive the this child in my name, the one welcomes me on; and who it will me receive, this one welcomes on the One, who has me sent; because who it is the least among you (PL) all, the this one is great!
and John has answering said: L-rd, we have seen one, who has in your name cast out evil spirits, and we have it him forbid, because he follow not after on our account.
Yehoshua however has to him said: you (PL) shall not forbid! because who it is not against you (PL), this one is for you (PL).
and it is happened, when the days are completed become, that he shall taken up to be (his going up to Heaven), has he firmly decided turn his face to go to Jerusalem,
and sent Shlichim ahead for self; and they are went away and are entered in a village of the Samaritans, so that to ready for him.
and they have him not welcomed, because his face was directed to go to Jerusalem.
and seeing this, have the disciples, James and John, said: L-rd, (question) you want, that we should say, it shall come down fire from heaven and them burn? (Kings 2nd 1.)
he however has self turn around and rebuked on them;
and they are gone in an another village into.
and while they are gone on the way, has someone said to him: I will you (SG) follow where you (SG) you will ever go.
and Yehoshua has to him said: the foxes have holes and the birds of heaven nests; the Son of Man however has not where the head to lay down.
and to an other has he said: follow me after! this one however has said: allow me to the first to go away and bury to do the father mine.
has he to him said: let the dead bury their dead; you (SG) however go, and speak up the kingdom of Hashem!
and after an another has said: I will you (SG) follow, L-rd, but allow me before all self to say goodbye with the (ones), who are in my house.
Yehoshua however has to him said: no one, who puts the hand on the plow and glance on that, what is behind self, fit not for the kingdom of Hashem!
and after this has the L-rd appointed even seventy others and them sent in pairs ahead before self in every city and place of, where he himself has about to come.
and has to them said: the harvest is great, the laborers however are few; implore then the L-rd of the harvest, that he shall send laborers to his harvest!
go! look, I send you (PL) as sheep among wolves.
carry not any leather pouch, not any hand bag, not any shoes; and give anyone not up peace (greeting) on the road.
where however you (PL) will enter in a house, shall you (PL) to the first say: peace to the this house!
and if there is here a son of peace, will your peace rest on him; if however not, will it self return to you (PL).
and in the same house shall you (PL) remain, eat and drink what they have; because the laborer is worthy his wages. go not from house to house.
and in which it is city you (PL) come into, and they take you (PL) on (welcome), shall you (PL) to eat what they lay before you (PL) down;
and you (PL) shall heal the sick in the same (city), and say to them: the kingdom of Hashem has self come near to you (PL)!
where however you (PL) will come in into a city, and they will you (PL) not welcome, shall you (PL) go out on its streets and say:
even the dust, what has self from your city clung to our feet, wipe we off against you (PL); yet shall you (PL) know the these, that the kingdom of Hashem has self come near.
I tell you (PL), that for Sodom will it be more bearable in that day than for that city.

woe is to you (SG), Chorazin! woe is to you (SG), Beit-Tzaidah! because if in Tyre and Sidon would happened the wonders, which are happened in you (PL), would they already long sat in sackcloth and in ashes and repentance done.
yet will for Tyre and Sidon be more bearable in the judgment, than for you (PL).
and you (SG) K'far-Nachum, until to the heaven will you be lifted high? until to the Sheol deepest will you descend!
who it hears you (PL), this one hears me, and who it rejects you (PL), this one rejects me; who however it rejects me, this one rejects Him, who has me sent.
and the seventy have self returned with joy, so to say: L-rd, even the evil spirits are subject to us in your name!
he however has to them said: I have seen the Satan fall, as a lightning from heaven.
look, I have you (PL) given the power to tread on snakes and scorpions and over every power of the enemy; and it will you (PL) nothing hurt.
yet shall you (PL) self not rejoice with the this, that the spirits are you (PL) subject; but rejoice self, because your (PL) names are written in in heaven!

and in the same hour has he rejoice in the Spirit the Holy and said: I praise you, Father, L-rd of heaven and earth, because you (SG) you have hidden the these things from the wise ones and intelligent ones, and you have them revealed to small children; yes, Father, because so is it was pleasing before you (SG).

all is me handed over become by my Father; and no one knows not, who the Son is, except the Father; and who the Father is, (knows no one not) except the Son, and the one, to whom the Son wants it reveal.
and turning around self to the disciples has he said to them alone: blessed are the eyes, which see, what you (PL) see;
because I tell you (PL), that a many prophets and kings have desire to see, what you (PL) see, and have it not seen; and to hear, what you (PL) hear, and have it not heard.
and look, a certain master of Torah has self stand up and him tested, in this way to say: Rebbe, what shall I do, so as to inherit eternal life?
and he has to him said: what stands written in the Torah? how you read (it)?

has he answering said: you (SG) you shall love have the L-rd, your G-d, with the entire heart yours and with your whole soul and with your whole strength and with your entire mind, and your neighbor as you alone! (Deuteronomy 6, 5; Leviticus 19, 18.)
has he to him said: you (SG) you have rightly answered; do the these, and you (SG) you will live.
he however, wanting self alone to justify, has said to Yehoshua: and who is my neighbor?

has Yehoshua answering said: a certain man is went down from Jerusalem to Yericho and is fell in among robbers; and they have him unclothed and him covered with bloody beating and did go away leaving him a half dead.
and act of coincidence is a kohen went down on that road; and as he has him seen, is he across on the other side and went away.
and also so a Levi, coming to the place of and seeing him, is across on the other side and went away.
a certain Samaritan however, on the way, is come there to him, and as he has him caught sight of, has he self had compassion
and is went and has him bandaged the wounds his and pouring oil and wine; and him put up on his own beast and brought him to in an inn into and him cared for.
and the next day has he take out two denarii and them given the owner inn and said: look you after on him! and what you (SG) you will give more, will I you (SG) pay when I will me return.
who of the these three, you think, was a neighbor to him, who is fell into among the robbers?
and he has said: the one, who has done grace with him! and Yehoshua has to him said: go, and do also so!
and while they are farther go, is he come in into a certain village; and a woman with the name Martha has him welcomed in her house into.
and she has had a sister, who was named Mary, who has self also sat down at the L-rd's feet and self to listen to his word.

Martha however has self very occupied over a much serving; and she has come over and said: L-rd, it matters to you not that my sister has me left one alone to serving? tell then her, that she shall me assist.
and the L-rd has her answering said: Martha, Martha, you (SG) anxious you and bothered you about a many things;
however but something, one thing is needed; and Mary has chosen the good share, which will from her not taken away to be!
and it is happened, while he has pray on a certain place of; and that he did finish, has one of the disciples his said to him: L-rd, teach us prayer to do, so as John has also taught his disciples!
and he has to them said: when you (PL) do prayer, shall you (PL) say: Father, holy shall to be your Name. shall your kingdom come.
give us every day our daily bread!
and forgive us our sin, because we ourselves are also forgive every one, who is us in debt. and bring us not to any temptation.
and he has to them said: who of you (PL) will have a friend, and he will go to him in middle of the night (i.e. midnight) and say to him: friend, lend me three loaves bread,
because a friend mine is come from on the way to me, and I have not what put down before him;
and that one inside answering will say: be me not impose on; the door is already closed, and my children are with me in bed; I can not stand up again and you (SG) give!
I tell you (PL); if he will not stand up again and him give, because he is his friend, yet on account of his impertinent “in your face” ness will he rise up and him give, as much how he needs.
and I tell you (PL): ask, and it will you (PL) given to be, seek, and you (PL) will find; knock on, and it will you (PL) open to be!
because every one, who asks, receives; and who it seeks, finds; and the one, who knock on, will open to be.
and which of you (PL), who is a father, the son will ask bread, (question) will he him then give a stone? or fish, (question) will he then him give a snake instead fish?
or if he will ask an egg, (question) will he then him give an scorpion?
therefore, if you (PL), being evil, know to give good gifts to your (PL) children, on one how many and how many will the Father of heaven give the Spirit the Holy to the (one), who ask him!
and he has cast out a evil spirit, which was silent. and it is happened, when the evil spirit is went out, did the mute (man) speak; and the crowds of were amazed.
some however of them have said: through the Baal-zibbul, the ruler of the evil spirits, casts he out the evil spirits.
and others, testing him, have from him asked a sign from heaven.
he however, because he has known of their thoughts, has to them said: every kingdom, which is divided against self alone, becomes laid waste; and a house falls (divided) on a house.
and even the Satan, if he is divided against self alone, how will his kingdom have an existence? because you (PL) say, through the Baal-zibbul drive I out the evil spirits.
and if I drive out the evil spirits through the Baal-zibbul, through whom drive your (PL) children them out? therefore will they be your (PL) judges.
if however I drive out the evil spirits with the finger of Hashem, so is the kingdom of Hashem already come to you (PL)!
when the strong man, duly armed, guards his courtyard, remains his possessions in security;
when however a stronger than him comes and overcomes him, will he take away his weapons, on which he has self depend, and will divide his spoils.
who it is not with me, this one is against me; and who it gathers not one with me, this one scatters.

when the unclean spirit go out of the man, go he through over places, where it is any water there is not, seeking rest; and because he finds not, says he: I will me return to the house mine, of where I am (gone) out.
and he comes and finds it swept and decorated.
then go he and takes with seven other worse spirits than he is himself, and they go into and dwell there, and the end of that man is worse than the beginning.

and it is happened, while he has that spoken, has a certain woman of the crowd of people uplifted her voice and said to him: that blessed is the womb, who has you carried, and the breasts, which you (SG) you have sucked!
he however has said: yes, blessed is the (one), who hears Hashem's word, and keep it up!
as however crowds of people have pressed to him, has he begun to say: the these generation is a evil generation! it asked a sign; and any sign will it not given to be except the sign of Jonah.
because just as Jonah is become a sign for the men of Nineveh, so will the Son of Man be for the this generation. (Jonah 1, 17.)

the Queen of South will standing up again in the judgment with the people of the this generation and will them condemn; for she is come from the far reaches of the earth, to hear Solomon's wisdom and look, here is found a greater than Solomon! (Kings 1st 10, 1-13.)
men of Nineveh will rise in the judgment with the this generation and will it condemn; because they have repentance done on Jonah's call; and look, here is found a greater than Jonah. (Jonah 3)
no one lights not on any light and puts it by a hidden place, also not under a measuring basket, but on a lampstand, so that the (ones), who come in, should see the glow shine.
the light of the body is the eye your. when your eye is healthy, is also your whole body light; if however it is evil, is also the whole body your darkness.
give then attention, that the light in you (SG) shall not be any darkness!
if therefore your whole body is light, that he has not any darkness part, will he be wholly light, as when the light irradiates you with its shine.
and while he has spoken, has a Pharisee him invite, that he shall dine there. and he is go in and has self reclines to the table.
and the Pharisee has self astonished, seeing, that he has self not to first washed before to eat.
and the L-rd has said to him: now make you (PL), Pharisees, clean the goblet and the bowl of the outside, the inside however in you (PL) is full with dish and wickedness.
fools which you (PL) are! (question) has then not this One, who has made the outside, also made the inside?
give but alms charity of the things, which are inside, and look, all things are pure for you (PL)!

but woe is to you (PL) Pharisees, because you (PL) give up tithe out of mint and rue and of every herbs, and are disregard the judgment and the love of Hashem; the these have you (PL) ought do and those also not neglect.
woe is to you (PL) Pharisees, because you (PL) have love to sit at the head in synagogue and that they shall you (PL) give greeting on the marketplaces.
woe is to you (PL), that you (PL) are like (unclean) graves, which they recognized not; and the people, who go around on them, know it not!
and one of the Baalei Torah has answering said to him: Rebbe, when you (SG) say the these things, you insult us also!

he however has said: woe is also to you (PL), Baalei HaTorah; because you (PL) burden the people with heavy burdens, which was able they scarcely bear/carry, and you (PL) yourself touch even not on the burdens with one of your (PL) finger.
woe is to you (PL), because you (PL) build the tombs of the prophets, who your (PL) fathers have them killed.
Thus how are you (PL) witness and you (PL) have a pleasure in the deeds of the fathers your (PL); because they have them killed, you (PL) however build the tombs.
on account of that has also the wisdom of Hashem said: I will send to them prophets and Shlichim, and a part of them will they kill and persecute;
so that the blood of all prophets, which is shed become since the world's creation, shall demanded to be of the this generation,
of the blood of Hevel until to the blood of Zecharyah, who did perish between the altar and the House (HaMikdash); yes, I tell you (PL), it will demanded to be of the this generation,
woe to you (PL), Baalei HaTorah, because you (PL) has taken away the key of knowledge; yourself are you (PL) not entered, and the (ones), who have wanted go in, have you (PL) prevented!
and when he is went out from there, did the scribes and the Pharisees begin to stand up to him and him to stand questions over several matters with bitterness;
lying in wait on him, to catch something out of his mouth.

meanwhile has self gathered a crowd of thousands people, so that they have self treading one the other, has he begun to the first to say to his disciples: beware for the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
and it is there is not any veiled thing, what will not unveiled to be, and any secret thing, which will not known made to be.
therefore, all which you (PL) have spoken in the darkness, will heard to be in the light; and what you (PL) have said on the ear in innermost rooms, that will proclaimed to be on the rooftops.
I tell you (PL) however, my friend: have not any fear before the (one), who kill the body and after that are not able something more to do.

I will you (PL) however to show before whom you (PL) shall fear have: have fear before him, who after kill, has he the power throw in in Gehenna into; yes, I tell you (PL), before the this shall you (PL) fear have!
(question) sell they then not five birds for two assarion (pennies)? and any one of them is not forgotten before Hashem.
but even the hair of your head are all counted. have not any fear! you (PL) are worth more than a many birds.
I tell you (PL) however: every one, who will self acknowledge to me before men, will also the Son of Man self acknowledge to him before the angels of Hashem;
the one however, who denies me before men, will denied to be before the angels of Hashem.
and every one, who will say a word against the Son of Man will it him forgiven to be; who however it blasphemes the Spirit the Holy, that one will not forgiven to be.
and when they leads you (PL) before the synagogues and before the rulers and before the authorities, shall you (PL) not worry, how or with what you (PL) shall self defend or what you (PL) shall say;
because the Spirit the Holy will you (PL) teach in the same hour, what you (PL) ought to say.
and someone out the crowd people has to him said: Rebbe, tell the brother mine, that he shall self to share with me with the inheritance!
he however has to him said: man, who has me appointed for a judge or arbitrator over you (PL)?
he has however to them said: give attention and beware self for every money avarice! because the life of a man consists not in the abundance of his possessions.
and has them told a parable, so to say: a certain rich man's land has brought a good harvest;
and he has self thought was, saying: what shall I do, as I have not place where to gather my fruit?
and has said: the these will I do: I will tear down my granaries and build larger and will there gather the whole grain increase and the possessions my;
and I will say to my soul: soul my, you have a many good things lying on many years; have rest, eat, drink and let you (SG) be merry!
Hashem however has to him said: you (SG) fool, in the this one night will your soul of you (SG) demanded to be; and for whom will it be, (for) which you (SG) you have reserved?
just so goes it the one, who gathers treasures for self and is not rich in Hashem.
and he has said to his disciples: on account of the tell I you (PL): worry not for your life, what you (PL) will to eat; also not for your body, what you (PL) will self clothe with.
because the life is more than the food and the body—than the garment.
consider the ravens! that not they sow, not they reap, they have not any storeroom, not any barn, and Hashem nourishes them yet; how much more are you (PL) worth than the birds?
and who of you (PL) with his worry can add a cubit to his stature?
therefore, if you (PL) are not even able to do the smallest, why worry you (PL) self for the remaining things?
consider the lilies! how not they spin, not they weave; and I tell you (PL), even Solomon in his whole glory is not was clothed as one of the these.
and if Hashem clothes thus the grass in the field, which today is it and tomorrow becomes it thrown in furnace into, how much more you (PL), you (PL) small believers!
and seek not after what you (PL) will to eat and what you (PL) will drink and stir up self not about (it).

if I tell witness about me alone, is my witness say not truth.

honor of men take I not on.

all, which the Father gives me, will come to me; and that one, who comes to me, will I never way not cast out outside.
because I did come down from heaven, not so that I shall do my will, but the will of him, who had me sent.

not that anyone has seen the Father, except the one, who is from Hashem; the this one did see the Father.

I am the bread of life.
your (PL) parents did eat manna in the wilderness, and did die.

take they and lead to the Pharisees that one, who is previously was blind.

therefore did also the Pharisees him again ask, how he did seeing become. and he did to them say: he did lay clay on my eyes, and I did me wash, and I see.
did some of the Pharisees say: the this one man is not of Hashem, because he keeps not up Sabbath. and other did say: how can a man, a sinner, do such signs? and it is become a dispute among them.
and again did they say to the blind man: what you say about him, that he did you (SG) open your eyes? he however did say: he is a prophet.
the Judaeans did therefore not believe about him, that he was blind, and is sighted become, until they did call the parents of the seeing used to be,
and they asked, so to say: (question) is the this one your son, who you (PL) say, that he is born become blind? how then sees he now?
did his parents answer and say: we know, that the this one is our son, and that he was born become blind;
how however he sees now, know we not; or who it has him opened his eyes, know we not; ask him, he is an adult/of age, he will speak for self alone.

this did his parents say, because they did fear had before the Judaeans: because the Judaeans had already had agreed, that when someone will him acknowledge for the Moshiach, shall he put become in excommunicated from shul into.
therefore did his parents say: he is a adult, ask him.
they have therefore to the second (one) time called the man, who was blind, and said to him: render glory to Hashem; we know, that the this one man is a sinner.
has that one answered: (question) he is sinful know I not; one thing know I yes, that I was blind and now see I.
they have therefore said to him: what has he you (SG) done? how has he opened your eyes?
did he them answer: I have after all you (PL) already told, and you (PL) has self not to listen; why want you (PL) again to hear? (question) want you (PL) also to be his disciples?
and they have him reviled, and said; you (SG) are that one's disciple, we however are Moses' disciples.
we know, that Hashem has spoken to Moses; however concerning the this, know we not, from where he is.
did the man answer and said to them: look in the this lies here the remarkable, that you (PL) know not from where he is, and he has me opened my eyes.
we know, that Hashem hears not any sinners; but if someone is a fearer of heaven and does His will, the this hears he indeed.
from forever on is it not heard become, that someone shall have opened the eyes of a blind born.
if the this one would not was of Hashem, would he nothing be able do.
did they answer and said to him: you (SG) are wholly born become in sin, and you (SG) teach us? and did him throw out/expelled outside.
Yehoshua has heard, that they have him thrown out; and finding him, did he say: (question) do you believe in the Son of Man?
that one did answer and said; and who is the one, L-rd, that I shall believe in him?
did Yehoshua say to him: you (SG) have him seen, and the (one), who speaks with you (SG), is the one.
and he has said: L-rd, I believe! and has self bowed to him.
and Yehoshua did say: unto judgment am I come in the world into, so that the (ones), who see not, should see, and the (ones) seeing should become blind.
and some of the Pharisees, who are was with him, did this hear, and did say to him: (question) are we also blind?
did Yehoshua to them say: if you (PL) would have been blind, would you (PL) not have any sin; now however say you (PL): we see; therefore remains your sin.
in truth, in truth tell I you (PL); the one, who comes not in through the door into the yard of the sheep, but climbs inside through somewhere else, that one is a thief and a robber.
the one however who comes inside through the door, is the shepherd of the sheep.
for him opens the guard; and the sheep hear his voice, and he calls his sheep by name, and leads them out.
and when he has taken out all his own, goes he ahead before them, and the sheep follow him after, because they know his voice.
a stranger however will they never way not follow, but will run away from him, because they know not the voice of strangers.
the this parable did Yehoshua say to them; however they did not understand, what that is, which he did to them speak.
Yehoshua did therefore again to them say: in truth, in truth say I you (PL): I am the door of the sheep.
all, who did come before me, are thieves and robbers; however the sheep did they not hear.
I am the door; who it will go in through me, that (one) will saved to be; and will go in and go out, and find pasture.
the thief comes not except so as to steal and kill and to destroy; I am come, so that they should have life, and that they should have a abundance.
I am the good shepherd; the good shepherd is self chastise soul/life for the sheep.
the hireling, and the one, who is not any shepherd, to whom it belong not the sheep, sees the wolf coming, and abandons the sheep, and runs away; and the wolf devours and scatters them;
he runs away, because he is a hireling, and it matters to him not about the sheep.
I am the good shepherd, and I know the my own, and the my own know me,
as the Father knows me, and I know the Father; and my life lay I down for the sheep.
and other sheep have I, who are not of the this yard; them must I also lead, and they will hear my voice; and it will become one flock, one shepherd.
therefore does the Father me love, because I lay down my life, so that I shall it again take.
anyone takes it not away from me, rather from we alone lay I it down. I have authority it to lay down, and have authority it again to take. the these command have I received from my Father.
again is become a dispute among the Judaeans on account of the these words.
and a many of them did say: he has an evil spirit, and is off of mind; why listen you (PL) to him?
others did say: these are not the words of a demoniac with an evil spirit. (question) can then a evil spirit open the eyes of the blind?
it is then was Chanukah in Jerusalem; it was winter,
and Yehoshua was walking in the House HaMikdash in Portico of Solomon up and down.
and the Judaeans did him surround, and did say to him: until when you want to stretch our soul? if you (SG) are the Moshiach, tell us openly.
did Yehoshua them answer: I have you (PL) already told, and you (PL) believe not; the deeds, which I do in my Father's Name, they say witness about me.
but you (PL) believe not, because you (PL) are not of my sheep.
my sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me after;
and I give them eternal life: and they will never not lost become, and anyone will them not snatch from my hands.
my Father, who did them to me give, is greater than all; and no one can them not snatch from my Father's hand.
I and the Father are we one.
did the Judaeans again pick up stones, so that him to stone.
Yehoshua did them answer: a many deeds good did I (to) you (PL) show from the Father; on account of which of the these deeds, are stoning you (PL) me?
did the Judaeans him answer: for deeds good stone we you not, but for blasphemy to Hashem, and because you (SG), being a man, make yourself for Elokim.
did Yehoshua them answer: (question) stands then not written in your Torah:
if he did them call g-ds, to whom Hashem's word has come—and the writing can not null and void become—
says you (PL) about him, whom the Father did sanctify, and sent in the world into: you (SG) blaspheme; because I did say: I am the Son of the Most High?
if I do not the works of my Father, shall you (PL) me not believe.
if however I do indeed, even when you (PL) want me not to believe, believe the works, so that you (PL) shall know and understand, that the Father is in me, and I am in the Father.
therefore did they again sought him to arrest, and he is go out of their hand.
and he did again go away to other side of Yarden, to the place of, where John used to the first immersing do in the mikveh, and is there remain.
and a many did come to him, and did say: John did actually not do any sign, but all, that John did say about the this (Yehoshua), is true.
and a many did there believe in him.
and there is one lying sick, El'azar of Beit-Anyah, the village of Mary and her sister Marta.
and the Mary is the one was, who had anointed the L-rd with precious ointment, and him wipe off his feet with her hair, whose brother El'azar is lie sick.
the sisters did therefore send to him, so to say: L-rd, look, he whom you (SG) do love, lies sick.
and when Yehoshua did this hear, did he say: the this sickness is not to the death, but to the glory of Hashem, so that the Son of the Most High shall glorified to be through you (PL).
and Yehoshua did love have Marta and her sister and El'azar.
and when he did hear, that he lies sick, did he then yet (longer) remain two days in the place, where he was.
then has he first say to the disciples: let us again go to Yehudah.
say the disciples to him: Rebbe, now did the Judaeans you seek to stone, and you (SG) go again there there?
did Yehoshua answer: (question) has then not the day twelve hours? who it walk around in the day, that (one) stumbles not, because he sees the light of the this world.
whoever however it walk around by night, this one stumbles, because the light is not in him.
this did he speak, and after that says he to them: El'azar, our friend is asleep become; but I go, so that him to wake up from sleep.
the disciples have therefore said to him: if he has fall asleep, will he healed to become.

and I rejoice myself on account of you (PL), that I had there not been, so that you (PL) shall believe; but let us go to him.

and Beit-Anyah was near to Jerusalem, an about fifteen acres of field distant;

and Martha did say to Yehoshua: L-rd, if you (SG) would here have been, would my brother not have died.
and even now know I, that all, which you (SG) will only ask by Hashem, will Hashem you (SG) give.
said Yehoshua to her: your brother will stand up again.
says Martha to him: I know, that he will rise up in the resurrection in the last day.
did Yehoshua say to her: I am the resurrection and the life; who the one believes in me, even when he has already died, will he live,
and every one, who lives and believes in me, will in eternity not die. (question) do you believe the these?
says she to him: yes, L-rd, I believe, that you (SG) are the Moshiach, the Son of the Most High, who shall come in the world into.
and having this said, did she go away, and did call her sister quietly, and said to her: the Rebbe is here and calls you.
and when that one did this hear, did she quickly stand up, and come to him.
and Yehoshua is yet not gone in in village into, but is still was in the place, where Martha had him met.

and the Judaeans, who were with her was in the house, and did her console, seeing, that Mary did herself quickly got up and did go out, have her followed, thinking, that she goes to the tomb, in order that there to weep.
and as Mary is come there, where Yehoshua was, and did him see, did she fall down before his feet, and did to him say: if you (SG) would here been, would the brother mine not died.
and as Yehoshua did her see weep and the Judaeans, who are come together with her, also weep, did he a sigh done in his spirit, and self grieved was,
and said: where did you (PL) him lay? say they to him: L-rd, come and see.
Yehoshua has shed a tear.
the Judaeans did therefore say: look see, how he did him love have!
some however of them did say: (question) could he, who had opened the eyes of the blind man, then not be able make, that also this (El'azar) shall not die?
and again a sigh doing in self alone, comes Yehoshua to the tomb. and it was a cave, and a stone was laid at it.
says Yehoshua: take away the stone. says Marta, the sister of the son of deceased, to him: L-rd, he smells already, because he lies already four days.
says Yehoshua to her; (question) have I you (SG) then not said, that if you (SG) will believe, will you see the glory of Hashem?
and they did take away the stone. and Yehoshua did lift up the eyes (toward heaven) up and said: Father, I thank you (SG), that you (SG) have me heard.
and I did know, that you (SG) hear me always; but on account of the crowd, which stands around, did I this say, so that they should believe, that you (SG) you have me sent.
and having this said, did he a shout do with a loud voice: El'azar, come out.
and this dead one did come out, and his hands and feet are was wrapped with burial shrouds; and his face was bandaged with a kerchief. says Yehoshua to them: untie him on, and let him go.
and a many of the Judaeans, who had come to Mary, seeing what he had done, did believe in him.
some however of them did go away to the Pharisees, and did them tell, what Yehoshua has done.
the chief kohenim and the Pharisees did therefore bring together the Sanhedrin, and said: what shall we do? because the this one man does a many signs!
if we will him so permit, will all believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away our land and nation.
but one of them, Caiapha, being kohen gadol in that year, did to them say: you (PL) know nothing,
and consider even not, that it is good for you (PL), that one man shall die for the people, and the entire nation shall not lost go.
the these however did he from self alone not say, but because he was kohen gadol in that year, did he say prophecies, that Yehoshua will die for the people (Yeshayah 53, 8.);
and not only for the people alone, but so that also the scattered children of Hashem shall he gather together.
and from that day on did they decided, him to kill.

Yehoshua is therefore more not walking about publicly among the Judaeans, but is departed from there to the region near of the wilderness, in a city, which was called it Ephrayim, and is there remain with the disciples.
and it was near for the Jewish Pesach, and a many did go up to Jerusalem from the countryside for Pesach, in order to themselves to purify.

and Mary did take a pound pure, costly spikenard, and anoint (with) the feet of Yehoshua, and wipe off his feet with her hair; and the house has self fill up with the fragrance of the spikenard/perfume.
however Yehudah man from Kriot, one of his disciples, the (one), who was him should betray, did say:
why has they not sold the this spikenard for three hundred denarii and given (this money) to poor people?
and the these did he say, not because he did himself care about the poor people; but because he was a thief, and had the purse and used to embezzle, what they has put in.
Yehoshua did therefore say: leave her alone, for (the) day of my burial has she it been keeping.
because the poor people have you (PL) always with yourselves, me however have you (PL) not always.

fear you not, you (SG) daughter of Zion,

this did his disciples at the first not understand; but when Yehoshua is already was glorified, did they themselves then remember, that it had been written about him, and that this has they done to him.
and the crowd people, who was with him, when he did El'azar call out from the tomb, and him rouse from the dead, did witness say about him.
on account of that actually did the crowd him go to meet, because they had heard, that he had done the these sign (miracle).
therefore did the Pharisees say one to the other: you (PL) see, that you (PL) prevail nothing; look, the whole world runs him already after!
and there are was some Greeks among the (ones), who did go up on foot were, in order to self to worship (at) the Yom Tov;

comes Philip and says this to Andrew; comes Andrew with Philip and says this to Yehoshua;

in truth, in truth say I you (PL): if the grain wheat falls in the earth into and dies not, remains it alone; if however it dies yes, brings it a many fruits.

the these did he say, alluding to his, with what for a death he goes die.

and he had blind made their eyes,

the one, who casts me aside and accepts not on my words, has already his judge; the word, which I have spoken, that will him condemn in the last day.
because I have of me alone not spoken; but he, who has me sent, the Father himself, has me given a command, what I shall say, and what I shall speak.
and I know, that his command is eternal life. therefore what I speak, speak I so, as the Father has to me spoken.

and before the Yom Tov Pesach, in this way as Yehoshua did know, that his hour is come, so that he shall depart from the this world to the Father, having loved his own, who are in the world, did he them love had until the end.
and while the feast in evening, after the as the Satan had already had put in heart of Yehudah son of Simon man from Kriot, that he shall him betray,
(Yehoshua) knowing, that the Father did him everything give over in the hands into, and that he did come from Hashem and goes to Hashem,
did he get up from the table, and did put away the garments, and taking a towel, did he himself gird around.
after that did he pour water in the basin and began to wash the disciples' feet and wipe them with the towel, with which he was gird around.
so comes he to Simon Peter. says he to him: L-rd, you (SG) you shall me wash the feet?

therefore if I, the L-rd and Rebbe, have you (PL) washed your (PL) feet, are you (PL) also obligated to wash one the other the feet.
because I have you (PL) given an example, so that, as I have done to you (PL), so shall you (PL) also do.
in truth, in truth say I you (PL); a servant is not greater than his lord, also is a messenger not greater than the one, who did him send.
if you (PL) know that, blessed are you (PL), if you (PL) do it.
not about you (PL) all speak I; because I know whom I have chosen; but so that the verse shall fulfilled become:
already now tell I it (to) you (PL), before it occurs, so that when it will to happen, shall you (PL) believe, that I am He.
in truth, in truth tell I you (PL): who it accepts on the one, whom I send, that (one) accepts me on; and who it accepts me on, that (one) accepts on Him, who did me send.
this saying, did Yehoshua self troubled in His spirit, and did witness said, and spoke: in truth, in truth say I you (PL): one of you (PL) will me betray.
the disciples did therefore look one on the other, doubtful about whom he was saying this.
and one of his disciples, whom Yehoshua did (particularly) love had, was leaning on Yeshua's chest.
did Simon Peter motion to the this one, and to him said: tell who it is, about whom he speaks.
inclining himself in this way to Yeshua's chest, says that one to him: L-rd, who is it?
Yehoshua did answer: that one is it, for whom I will dip the morsel and him give. and dipping the morsel, takes he and gives it to Yehudah son of Simon man from Kriot.
and after the morsel is the Satan then enter in him. Yehoshua did therefore to him say: what you (SG) do, do quickly.
and anyone around that table did not understand, why he had that said to him.
because some did think, because Yehudah did have the purse, says Yehoshua to him: buy one, what we need for Yom Tov; or that he shall something give to the poor people.
and as he did take the morsel, is he immediately went out; and it was night.
and when he did go out, did Yehoshua say: now is the Son of Man glorified, and Hashem is glorified in him;
and if Hashem is glorified in him, will Hashem him glorify in self alone, and soon will he him glorify.
children, yet a short time am I with you (PL). you (PL) will me seek, and as I have said to the Judaeans: where I go, can you (PL) not come, so tell I also you (PL) now.
a new commandment give I you (PL), that you (PL) shall love have one the other; as I did you (PL) love had, so shall you (PL) also love have one (for) the other.
through the this will all recognize, that you (PL) are my disciples, if you (PL) will have love one for the other.
says Simon Peter to him: L-rd, where go you? did Yehoshua answer: where I go, can you me now not follow, later however will you me follow.
says Peter to him: L-rd, why can I you (SG) now not follow? my life will I lay down for your sake.
answers Yehoshua: your life will you lay down for my sake? in truth, in truth say I (to) you (sg): before yet the cock will crow, will you me three times deny!
shall your heart self (be) not troubled; you (PL) believe in Hashem, believe also in me.
in my Father's house is here a many dwellings; would it not so be, would I it you (PL) have told; because I go (to) prepare an place for you (PL).
and when I go and prepare for an place for you (PL), will I again come, and you (PL) take to me, so that where I am, shall you (PL) also be.
and where I go, know you (PL), and you (PL) know the way.
says Toma to him: L-rd, we know not where you (SG) go; and how can we know the way?
says to him Yehoshua: I am the way (Hashem) and the truth and the life; anyone comes not to the Father, except through me.
if you (PL) would me have known, would you (PL) also have known my Father; and from now on know you (PL) Him and have Him seen.
says Philip to him: L-rd, show us the Father, and it will be enough for us.
says Yehoshua to him: such long time am I now with you (PL), and you (SG) know me not, Philip? who it has me seen, that (one) did see the Father; and how you say: show us the Father?
(question) do you believe then not, that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? the words that I speak to you (PL), speak I not from me myself; but the Father, who dwells in me, does His works.
believe me, that I am in the Father and the Father in me; and if not, believe on account of the works themselves.
in truth, in truth tell I you (PL): the one, who believes in me, the works that I do, will he also do; and greater than the these will he do, because I go to the Father.
and what you (PL) will only ask in my name, will I the these do, so that the Father shall glorified become in the Son.
if you (PL) will me something ask in my name, will I it do.
if you (PL) have (for) me love, shall you (PL) keep my commandments!
and I will ask the Father, and he will you (PL) give an other advocate, so that he shall be with you (PL) on eternity;
the Spirit of truth, whom the world can him not receive, because it sees him not and knows him not; you (PL) know him indeed, because he remains with you (PL) and will be in you (PL).
I will you (PL) not abandon like orphans; I will come to you (PL).
yet a little while and the world sees me more not, you (PL) however see me; because I live, will you (PL) live also.
in that day will you (PL) know, that I am in my Father, and you (PL) are in me, and I am in you (PL).

who the one has my commandments and keeps them, that (one) is it, who does me love; and that (one), who has me love, will be beloved by my Father, and I will him love have, and will myself reveal to him.
says to him Yehudah, not the man from Kriot: L-rd, what has happened, that you (SG) you will Yourself reveal to us and not to the world?
did Yehoshua answer and said to him: if anyone does me love, will he keep my word; and my Father will him love have; and we will come to him and make a dwelling (for us) with him.
who it does me not love, that (one) keeps not my words; and the word, which you (PL) hear, is not mine, rather from the Father, who has me sent.

remain in me, and I in you (PL), as the branch can not bring forth any fruits of itself alone, if she remains not on the vine, so (can) you (PL) not, if you (PL) remain not in me.

anyone has not any greater love than the these, that he shall lay down his life for his friends.
you (PL) are my friends, if you (PL) do, what I command you (PL).

not you (PL) did me choose, but I have you (PL) chosen, and you (PL) appointed, that you (PL) shall go and bring fruits, and that your (PL) fruits shall remain; so that what you (PL) will ask the Father in my name, shall he you (PL) give.
this command I you (PL), so that you (PL) shall love have one the other.
if the world hates you (PL), know you (PL), that it has me, before all, hated before you (PL).

remember this word, which I have you (PL) spoken: a servant is not greater than his master. if they did me persecute, will they you (PL) also persecute; if they had held/kept my word, will they also yours hold/keep.
however this all will they you (PL) do on account of my name, because they know not Him, who has me sent.
if I would not have come and spoken to them, would they not have had any sin; now however have they not any excuse for their sin.
who it does me hate, that (one) has also hatred for Father mine.
if I had not done among them the works, which any another has not done, would they not have had any sin; now however have they seen (the these) and have me yet hated and the Father mine.
but (this occurs), so that it shall fulfilled to be the word, which stands written in their Torah:
when however the Advocate will come, whom I will send to you (PL) from my Father, the Spirit of truth, Who comes forth from the Father, will He witness say about me;
and you (PL) will also witness say, because you (PL) are have been with me from beginning on.
this have I to you (PL) spoken, so that you (PL) shall not stumble (tempted) to be.
they will you (PL) put in cheirem (ban) into; yes, it comes on an hour, that every one, who will you (PL) kill, will think, he serves Hashem with that.
and this will they do, because they did not know the Father, and not me.

and this have I spoken to you (PL), so that when the hour will come, shall you (PL) yourselves remind therein, that I have it you (PL) said. in the beginning however have I this (to) you (PL) not said, because I was with you (PL).

but because I have this spoken to you (PL), did sorrow fill your heart.

and when he will come, will he convince the world about sin and about righteousness and about judgment:
about sin, because they did not believe in me;
and about righteousness, because I go to the Father, and you (PL) will me more not see;
and about judgment, because the prince of the this one world is judged become.
yet a many have I you (PL) to say, but you (PL) can it now not bear.

yet when he will come, the Spirit of truth, will he you (PL) lead in the whole truth into; because he will not speak of self alone, but everything, which he hears, will he speak; and he will you (PL) proclaim that, which must first come.
he will me glorify, because he will receive from that, which is mine and will it you (PL) explain.
all, that the Father has, is mine; therefore did I say, that He takes of that, which is mine, and will it you (PL) proclaim.
yet a little while, and you (PL) see me more not; and again a little while, and you (PL) will me yes see.

some of his disciples have therefore said one to the other: what is the these, what he tells us: a little while, and you (PL) see me not; and again a little while, and you (PL) will me yes see? and: because I go to the Father?
therefore have they said: what is the these, which he says: a little while? we understand not, what he speaks.

Yehoshua has noticed, that they want him ask, and he did to them say: you (PL) ask self after, one of other, about the this thing, which I have said: a little while, and you (PL) see me not, and again a little while, and you (PL) will me see?
in truth, in truth tell I you (PL): you (PL) will weep and lament, however the world will self rejoice; you (PL) will be grieved, but your sorrow will become a celebration.

a woman, when she go to child, is grieved, because her hour is come; when however she has delivered this child, remembers she more not the anguish, on account of the joy, that a person is born become in the world into.
so have you (PL) also now grief; I will you (PL) however again see, and your heart will self rejoice, and the joy your (PL) will anyone not take away from you (PL).
and in that day will you (PL) me nothing more ask. in truth, in truth tell I you (PL): what you (PL) will but ask the Father will he to you give in my name.
until now have you (PL) nothing asked in my name; ask, and you (PL) will received, so that your joy shall become full.
the these things have I spoken to you (PL) in parables; there comes on a hour, when I will more not speak to you (PL) in parables, but (to) you (PL) proclaim openly about the Father.
in that day will you (PL) ask in my name; and I tell you (PL) not, that I will ask the Father for your sake;
because the Father Himself has you (PL) loved, because you (PL) have me loved, and believe, that I am come forth from Hashem.
I am come out from the Father, and am come in the world into; again depart I the world, and go to the Father.
says his disciples: look, now speak you (SG) openly, and say not any parable.
now know we, that you (SG) know all, and need not, that anyone shall you question; through this believe we, that you (SG) did come forth from Hashem.
did Yehoshua them answer: now believe you (PL)?

look, there comes a hour, and is already came, that you (PL) shall scattered to be, every one to the his, and me will you (PL) abandon one alone; and I am (yet) not one alone, because the Father is with me.
this have I spoken to you (PL), so that in me shall you (PL) have peace. in the world have you (PL) troubles; but be comforted; I have overcome did the world.
this has Yehoshua spoken; and lifting up his eyes to the heaven, did he say; Father, it is come the hour; glorify your Son, so that the Son shall you glorify;
as you (SG) have him given power over every flesh (and blood), so that he shall give eternal life to everyone, who you (SG) have him given.
and this is the eternal life, that they shall you know, the only true G-d, and Yehoshua the Moshiach, whom you (SG) you have sent.
I have you glorified on the earth, I have completed the work, which you (SG) you have me given to do.
and now, Father, glorify you (SG) me, with the glorification, which I did have beside you (SG), before the world is (created) become.
I have revealed your Name to the men, which you (SG) have me given out of the world; yours are they were, and you (SG) did them me give; and they did keep your word.
now know they, that all, which you (SG) have me given, is from you (SG);
because the words, which you (SG) have me given, have I them given; and they did them accept, and in truth recognized, that I am come forth from you (SG); and did believe, that you (SG) did me send.
I ask you for their sake; I ask not for the world, but for those, whom you (SG) have me given, because they are yours;
and all, which is mine, is yours, and yours is mine; and I am glorified in them.
and I am more not in the world, and they are in the world, and I come to you (SG). holy Father, protect them in your Name, which you (SG) have me given, so that they should be one, just as we!

while I was with them, did I them protect in your Name, which you (SG) did me give; and did watch (over them), and anyone of them is not lost gone, except the son of destruction (lost one son), so that the verse shall fulfilled to be.
now however go I to you (SG); and this say I in the world, so that they should have my joy perfected in themselves.
I have them given your word; and the world does them hate, because they are not of the world, exactly as I am not of the world.
I ask not, that you (SG) shall them remove out of the world, but that you (SG) shall them keep from evil.
they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
sanctify them in the truth; your word is truth.
as you (SG) did me send in the world into, so have I them sent in the world into.
and for their sake sanctify I myself, so that they should be sanctified in the truth.
and not only for the these alone ask I, but also for those, who will believe in me through their word,
so that all should be one; as you (SG), Father, in me, and I in you (SG), that also they should be in us; so that the world shall believe, that you (SG) you have me sent.
and the glory, which you (SG) have me given, have I them given, so that they should be one just as we are one.

I in them, and you (SG) in me, so that they shall become perfected into one, so that the world shall know, that you (SG) have me sent, and did them love have, just as that way as you (SG) did me love have.

righteous Father, the world did you not know, I however did you yes know; and the these know, that you (SG) you have me sent;
and I did to them known made your Name, and will Him known make, so that the love, with which you (SG) have me loved had, shall be in them, and I in them.
having this said, did Yehoshua go out together with his disciples over the river Kidron, where it was a garden, in which he did go in with his disciples.
and also Yehudah, who did him betray, did know this place, because a many times did Yehoshua self there come together with the disciples his.
and Yehudah did take the cohort (soldiers) and officers of the chief kohenim and Pharisees, and did come there with torches and lamps and weapon sons.
and Yehoshua did know everything, that will come upon him; and did go out and did to them say: whom seek you (PL)?
did they him answer: Yehoshua of Natseret! says he to them: I am the one! and Yehudah, who has him betrayed, was standing with them.
and as Yehoshua did to them say: I am the one! did they go backwards and have fallen to the ground.
and he did them again ask: whom seek you (PL)? and they did say: Yehoshua of Natseret!

so that it shall fulfilled become this word, which he had said: those, who you (SG) have me given, of them have I any one not lost.
and Simon Peter, having a sword, did it draw out, and struck the kohen gadol's servant and him chopped off the right ear. and the servant has named Malchus.

and the cohort (soldiers) with the officer and the officers of the Judaeans did seize Yehoshua and him bound (akedah),

and it was Caiapha, who has advised the Judaeans, that it is good (that) one man shall die for the people.

and the handmaiden, the door keeper, has said to Peter: (question) you are then not also of the disciples of the this man? says he: I am not.
and the slaves and the servants were standing and did themselves warm at a fire, which they had made from coals, because it was cold; and Peter is also was with them, standing and warming himself.

what are you asking me? ask the (ones) who heard what I have to them spoken; look, they know, what I did say.

says Yehoshua to her: woman, why do you weep? whom do you seek? and supposing, that he is the gardeners, says she to him: L-rd, if you (SG) you have him carried away, tell we, where you (SG) you have him laid, and I will him take away.

whomever you (PL) will forgive be the sins, will it them be forgiven become; whomever you (PL) will retain, will they be retained.
however Toma, one of the twelve, who they had called Didymas, is not was together with them, when Yehoshua is come.

and in eight days later were his disciples again were inside (in the house), and Toma was with them. comes Yehoshua, while the doors are was locked, and has himself stand in the midst and said: peace be with you!
then says he to Toma: stretch out your finger here and look my hands; and stretch out your hand and do it into in my side, and be not unbelieving, but be a believer!
did Toma answer and said to him: my L-rd and my G-d!
says Yehoshua to him: because you (SG) did me see, do you believe? blessed are those, who have not seen and believe yet!
and yet a many other signs did Yehoshua do before his disciples, which stand not written in the this book.
and the these are written become, so that you (PL) shall believe, that Yehoshua is the Moshiach, the Son of the Most High, and that believing, shall you (PL) have life in his name.
after this did Yehoshua himself again appear to the disciples at the Sea of Tiberias; and did himself appear in such manner:
there are was together Simon Peter and Toma, who they has him called Didymas, and Natan'el from Cana in Galilee, and Zavdai's sons, and another two of his disciples.
says Simon Peter to them: I go to catch fish! say they to him: we will also come with you (SG). and they did go out, and did step in into the boat; and in that night did they nothing catch.
and when it is already was in the morning, is Yehoshua standing at the shore; yet did the disciples not known, that it is Yehoshua.
