who concerning the News Good, are they enemies on account of you (PL), however who concerning the election are they beloved on account of the fathers.
because Hashem has not any regret on his gifts and calling.
because since you (PL) are once were disobedient to Hashem, now however have you (PL) received mercy through their disobedience,
thus are also they now disobedient become, so that through the mercy to you (PL) should they now also reach mercy.
because Hashem did everyone enclose/include in the disobedience, so that He shall be merciful to everyone.
o, who for a depth of riches and wisdom and knowledge of Hashem! how incomprehensible are His judgments and unsearchable His ways!
because who has known the mind of the L-rd? or who was His advisor?
or who has Him before given (a gift), and it shall to him recompensed to be? (Yeshayah 40, 13.)
as all is of Him and through Him and to Him; to him be glory on (to) eternity. Amen.

I implore you (PL) therefore, brothers, by the mercies of Hashem, that you (PL) shall offer your (PL) bodies as a living, holy sacrifice, which is pleasing to Hashem, because that is your spiritual service.
and be not likened to the this world, but be transfigured yourselves by the renewal of your mind, so as to determine what it is Hashem's good and pleasing and perfect will.

because I speak to everyone among you (PL), through the grace, that is me given become, not to mind of yourselves higher than it do belong to be, but to think modestly, every one according to the measure of faith, which is to him assigned become by Hashem.
because as in one body have we a many body parts, and not all body parts have the same task,
so are we, the many, one body in the Moshiach, and every separate (one) members one of the other.
and having different gifts according to the grace, that is to us given been, whether prophecy, (let us prophecies say) according to the measure of our faith;
if serving, in the service; if a teacher, in the teaching;
if an admonisher, in the reproof saying; the givers, with freely giving, the leader, with effort; the bestower of loving kindness with cheerfulness.
let the love be without falseness; have hate the bad, clung yourself to the good.
have love one (for) the other with brotherly love; in the allocating honor, let every one first in mind have the other;
be not indolent in diligence, be zealous in the Spirit; serve the L-rd;
in the hope, be rejoicing; in a trouble, be patient; in the prayer do, keep on;
be giving for the needs of the kedoishem, be diligent you (PL) to be bringing in strangers.
bless the (ones), who persecute you (PL); bless, curse not.
rejoices with the (ones), who rejoice themselves, weep with the (ones), who weep.
have unity among yourselves. think not of haughty things, but lower yourself to the lowly. keep yourself not for any wise ones.
repay not up any one with evil for evil. think over these things, which are good for all men.
on how much it lies in you (PL), if possible, see to live in peace with all men.
beloved, be yourself not revenged, but make a place for the wrath, because it stands written: with Me is vengeance I will repay, says the L-rd G-d. (Deuteronomy 32, 35.)
therefore, if your enemy is hungry, give him to eat; if he is thirsty, give him to drink; because doing the these, you gather fire coals on his head. (Proverbs 25, 21-22)
let you not be overcome by the bad, but be overcoming the bad with the good.
let every one themselves be subject to the higher authorities, because it is there is not any authority, except of Hashem, and the existing authorities are set become from Hashem.
so then, the one, who resist himself against the power, that (one) resists self against Hashem's ordinance; and the rebels, will over themselves receive a judgment.

because the rulers are not any terror for the one, who does good, but for the one, who does evil. (if) you want however not fear to have before the authority? then do the good, and you (SG) will have from it a praise;

because it is Hashem's servant for your sake to the good. when however you (SG) do the evil, then have fear; because not in vain bears it the sword; because it is Hashem's servant to carry out wrath (punishment) on the one, who does evil things.
therefore must one self be subject, not only on account of the wrath, but also on account of the conscience.
for this reason pay you (PL) also taxes, because they (the people in power) are Hashem's servants and occupy themselves with the this one thing.
give up every one that, which you (PL) are obligated: tax, to whom tax belongs, tariff, to whom tariff belongs, fear the one, whom fear belongs, honor, to whom honor belongs.
be anyone nothing in debt, except love to have one the other; because the one, who has love the other, has fulfill did the Torah.

because you (SG) shall not adultery commit, you (SG) shall not murder, you (SG) shall not steal, you (SG) shall not covet (Exodus 20, 13-17), and every other command, are bound up together in the this word: you (SG) shall love have your neighbor as you yourself. (Leviticus 19, 18.)
the love does the neighbor not in no way evil not; therefore is the love the fulfilment of the Torah.
and the these shall you (PL) do, knowing the time, that the hour is already came, to rise from sleep; because now is our salvation nearer, than when we did begin to believe.
the night is passed and the day has itself come nearer; let us then cast off the deeds of the darkness and put on the weapon of the light.
let us walk humbly, as by day, not gorging and guzzling, not in fornication and debauchery, not in dissensions and in envy.
but put on the L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach, and see, that your worries for the body shall not lead to the satisfying the lusts.
the one weak in the faith shall you (PL) welcome do, but not to hold debates over doubtful opinions.
one believes, that he may everything eat, the weak one however eats only greenery.
the one, who eats, shall not despise do the one, who eats not; and the one, who eats not, shall not judge the one, who eats yes; because Hashem has him accepted.
who you are, who judges a some one else's servant? he stands or falls before his own lord! he will however upheld to be, because the L-rd is able him make stand.
one person makes a distinction between one day and an other, and an other holds every day for equal; let everyone be entirely sure in himself in the mind.

the (one), who observes (a certain) day, observes he it before the L-rd; and the one, who eats, eats before the L-rd, because he thanks yet Hashem for this; and the (one), who eats not, eats not before the L-rd; and thanks also Hashem for this.
because none of us lives not for himself alone, and none dies not for himself alone.
because when we live, live we to the L-rd, and when we die, die we to the L-rd; therefore, whether we live or we die, are we the L-rd's.
because for the this purpose is Moshiach died and alive became (came to life again), so that he shall be L-rd over dead and the living ones.
however you (SG), why you judge your brother? or you (SG), why you are despise your brother? because we all will stand before Hashem's throne of judgment.
because it stands written: just as I live, says the L-rd G-d, to Me will self bow every knee, and every tongue will praise G-d. (Yeshayah 45, 23.)
just so then will every one of us have to give up a judge account to Hashem for himself alone.
do then more not judge one the other. but keep (resolve) rather that for right, not to place any stumbling block or a trap before the brother.
I know, and am confident in the L-rd Yehoshua, that essential is any thing not defiled; except for him, who considers something as defiled, for him is it defiled.
because if your brother becomes grieved through a food, (which you (SG) eats), go you more not according to the love. let that one, for whom Moshiach did die, not lost become through your food!
let therefore your good not become any reason to blaspheme;
because this kingdom of Hashem consists not in to eat and to drink, but in righteousness and peace and joy in the Spirit the Holy.
because the one, who serves the Moshiach in the this (way), is pleasing to Hashem and is approved by men.
let us then ourselves pursue after the things of peace and after the things, through which we will build up one the other.
destroy not Hashem's work on account of a food. everything is pure; only it is evil for the man, who when he eats it, becomes he a stumbling block (for an other).
there is good not to eat any meat, and not to drink any wine, and not to do this, through which your brother is tempted.
the faith, which you (SG) have, have you (SG) before Hashem. blessed is the one, who condemns self not himself with, what he allows himself.
the one however, who is doubtful, when he eats, is condemned because he does it not of faith; and all, what is not of faith is a sin.
we, the strong ones, have a debt, to be tolerant of the weaknesses of the weak, and not self alone to satisfy.
let every one of us seek to please his chaver to the good, to build up.
because Moshiach did also not seek self alone to please, but as it stands written: the shame, which your insulters did (to) you put on, have fallen upon Me. (Psalms 69, 10)
because everything, which is from previously written, is written become for our learning, so that through patience and the comfort of the Scriptures (the Holy) should we have the hope.
and the G-d of patience and of comfort shall you (PL) give, that you (PL) shall have among yourselves one mind according to the Moshiach Yehoshua;
so that you (PL) shall agree, with one mouth, to give honor (to) the G-d and Father of our L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach.
therefore shall you (PL) welcome do one the other, as also the Moshiach has us welcome did, to Hashem's honor.
because I say, Moshiach is born become to be a servant of the circumcised on account of the truth of Hashem, so as to confirm the promises to the fathers,
and so that the nations of the world should give honor to Hashem for His mercy, as it stands written: therefore will I you praise among the nations, and to your Name sing. (Psalms 18, 50.)
and again it is said: rejoice self, you (PL) nations (of the world), with His people. (Deuteronomy 32, 43.)
and again: praise the L-rd (G-d), you (PL) all nations (of the world), and give Him a praise, all nations. (Psalms 117, 1.)
and again Yeshayah says: there will be the root of Yishai, and this One, who stands up to reign over the nations (of the world); on Him will the nations hope. (Yeshayah 11, 1, 10.)
and the G-d of hope shall you (PL) fill with every joy and peace in the believing, so that you (PL) shall be rich in the hope through the might of the Spirit the Holy.
my brothers, I myself am confident about you (PL), that you (PL) are filled with goodness, filled with every knowledge, and are able to say admonishing words one to the other.
I however have written to you (PL), partly boldly, so as you (PL) to remind through that grace, what is me given become from Hashem,

to be a servant of the Moshiach Yehoshua to the nations of the world, serving as a kohen in the News Good of Hashem, so that the sacrifice of the nations of the world shall become acceptable, holy through the Spirit the Holy.
I have therefore something, with which myself to boast in the Moshiach Yehoshua, with the issues, which are concerning Hashem.
because I will myself not dare to speak of anything except of that, which Moshiach has worked through me, to bring the nations of the world to obedience, in word and deeds real,

with the might of signs and wonders, with the might from the Spirit the Holy, so, that I have from Jerusalem and the region around up to Illyricum everywhere fully announced the News Good of the Moshiach;
striving myself so, to proclaim the News Good where Moshiach's Name is yet not become known, so that I shall not build upon an another's foundation,
but as it stands written: they, to whom it is not told been about him, will see, and the (ones), who have not heard, will understand. (Yeshayah 52, 15)
on account of which I am actually several times prevented become to come to you (PL).
however now, at last not having any place in the these places and yearning for long years to come to you (PL),

will I to you (PL) come, when I will be on the way to Spain. because I hope you (PL) to see on this journey, and by you (PL) sent to be there there, when I will myself to the first a little satisfy with you (PL).
now however travel I to Jerusalem, to serve the kedoishem.
because it is Macedonia and Achaia well pleased to make a joint donation for the benefit (of) the poor among the kedoishem in Jerusalem.
because it is them well pleased, and they are their masters of debt. because if the nations of the world have a share in their spiritual things, are they obligated them to serve in material things.
therefore when I will have completed the these, and having sealed for them the these fruit, will I journey through your land to Spain.
and I know, that coming to you (PL), will I come with the fullness of Moshiach's blessing.
I ask you (PL) however, brothers, through our L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach and through the love of the Spirit, that you (PL) shall strive along with we in your (PL) prayers for me to Hashem,
so that I shall saved to be from the rebellious in Yehudah, and that my service in Jerusalem shall be acceptable to the saints;
so that I shall come with joy to you (PL), if wills (it) Hashem, and myself rest up with you (PL).
and the G-d of peace shall be with you (PL) all. Amen.
I remind to you (PL) to the good our sister in Moshiach Phoebe, who is also a minister in the kehile of Cenchreae,

so that you (PL) shall her so receive in the L-rd as it stands on for kedoishem, that you (PL) shall her help in everything, in whatever she will you (PL) just need; because she had also been a helper for many, and for me myself.
give up peace (greeting) Prisca and Aquila, my co-workers in the Moshiach Yehoshua,
who did lay down their own neck for my life; whom not only I am thankful, but also all kehiles of the nations of the world;
and give up peace (greeting) the kehile in their house and give up peace my beloved Epaenetus, who is the first fruit to the Moshiach in Asia.
give up peace Miryam, who did much work for your sake.
give up peace Andronicus and Yunia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are well known among the Shlichim, and are already were in the Moshiach before me.
give up peace Ampliatus, my beloved in the L-rd.
give up peace Urbanus, our co-worker in the Moshiach, and my beloved Stachys.
give up peace Apelles, the putting to test (proven) (believer) in the Moshiach. give up peace the household of Aristobulus.
give up peace my relative Herodion. give up peace the (ones) of the household of Narcissus, who are in the L-rd.
give up peace Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who did hard work in the L-rd. give up peace the beloved Persis, who did very much work in the L-rd.
give up peace Rufus, the chosen one in the L-rd, and the mother his and mine.
give up peace Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers with them.
give up peace Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, also Olympas, and all kedoishem, who are with them.
give up peace one the other with a holy kiss. all kehiles of the Moshiach give you (PL) up peace (greeting).
and I beg you (PL), brothers, attention to give on the (ones), who create on dissensions and stumbling blocks contrary to the teaching, which you (PL) have taught become; and avoid them out.
because such men serve not our L-rd Moshiach, but their own stomach; and through beautiful and smooth words mislead they the hearts of the simple people.
because your obedience is (to) everyone gone abroad. therefore rejoice I me over you (PL); but I want, that you (PL) shall be wise ones what relates to the good and naive what relates to the evil.
and the G-d of peace will in a short time trample the Satan under your (PL) feet. may the grace of our L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach be with you (PL) all.
Timothy, my co-worker, and Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my relatives, give you (PL) up peace.
I, Tertius, the scribe of this letter, give you (PL) up peace in the L-rd.
Gaius, whose hospitality I and the whole kehile enjoy, give you (PL) up peace. Erastus, the treasurer of the city (Corinth), and Quartus the brother, give you (PL) up peace.
the grace of our L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach shall be with you (PL) all. Amen.

to him however, who can you (PL) strengthen according to my News Good and the preaching of Yehoshua the Moshiach, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was hidden from eternal times onwards,
is however now revealed become, and through the scriptures of the prophets on command by the eternal G-d known made to all nations to the obedience of the faith;
to Hashem the only wise one shall be glory through Yehoshua the Moshiach forever and ever! Amen.
Paul, called to be a Shliach of Yehoshua the Moshiach, through Hashem's will, and Sosthenes, the brother,

to the kehile of Hashem, which is in Corinth, to the sanctified in the Moshiach Yehoshua, to the called (to be) holy ones, together with all, who call on the Name of our L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach at every place, their (L-rd) and ours;
grace to you (PL) and peace from G-d, our Father, and of the L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach.
I thank Hashem always for you (PL), for the grace of Hashem, which has to you given been in the Moshiach Yehoshua;
that in everything are you (PL) rich become in Him, in every word and in all knowledge;
according to as this witness say of the Moshiach did itself establish firmly in you (PL);
so, that you (PL) are not behind remain in any kind of gift; waiting on the revelation of the L-rd our Yehoshua the Moshiach,
who will you (PL) also establish firmly till to the end, (so that you (PL) shall be) innocent in the day of our L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach.
yes, Hashem is faithful, through Whom you (PL) have called become to the fellowship of His Son Yehoshua the Moshiach the L-rd our.

I ask you (PL) however, brothers, by the Name of our L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach, that you (PL) shall all speak (one and) the same, and that there shall not be among you (PL) any quarrels; but that you (PL) shall be fortified in the same mind and in the same thought.
because about you (PL), brothers, am I aware become through Chloes (sons of house), that there are here disagreements with you (PL).
and I say this, because every one of you (PL) says: I am of Paul (i.e. Paul is my Rebbe etc); and I of Apollos; and I of Kefa; and I of the Moshiach.
(question) is then the Moshiach divided become? is Paul for you (PL) hung up on the tree become? or are you (PL) immersed become in the mikveh in the name of Paul?
I thank Hashem, that I had anyone of you (PL) not immerse did in a mikveh except Crispus and Gaius;
so that anyone shall not say, that you (PL) are immersed become in the mikveh in my name.
and I have also immersed in the mikveh the sons of house of Stephanas; further know I not, if I have immerse did in the mikveh anyone else.
because the Moshiach has me not sent immerse to be in a mikveh, but to proclaim the Good News; not with any clever word, so that Moshiach's tree should not powerless become.
because the word of the tree is foolishness to the (ones), who are lost; for us however, who are saved, is it Hashem's might.
because it stands written:
where is the wise one? where the scribe? where the master of dispute of the this world? or did then Hashem not to foolish made the wisdom of the world?
because since in the wisdom of Hashem did the world not recognize Hashem through wisdom, did Hashem grant through the foolishness of preaching to save the (ones), who believe.
and while Jews request signs and Greeks seek wisdom,
call we out a Moshiach hanged up on the tree, for Jews actually a stumbling, and for Greeks a foolishness;
however for the called ones themselves, whether Jews or Greeks, Moshiach the might of Hashem and the wisdom of Hashem.
because Hashem's foolishness is wiser than men; and Hashem's weakness stronger than men.
because you (PL) see (after all) your calling, brothers, that it is there is not (among you (PL)) any many wise ones according to the flesh, not many powerful, not many genteel;
only the foolish things of the world did G-d choose, so that to shame the wise ones; and the weak things of the world did Hashem choose, so that to shame the strong;
and the non genteel of the world, and the despised did Hashem choose, even that, which is not, so that nullify to be that, which is indeed;
so, that any flesh (and blood) shall itself not boast before Hashem.
from Him however are you (PL) in the Moshiach Yehoshua, who did for us become wisdom of Hashem, and righteousness and holiness, and redemption;
so that, as it stands written: who it boasts himself, that (one) should himself boast in the L-rd (G-d). (Yirmeyah 9, 23)
and I, brothers, coming to you (PL), did not come with high rhetoric or wisdom, you (PL) to proclaim the testimony of Hashem.
because I have myself resolved nothing to know among you (PL), except Yehoshua the Moshiach, and him as hung up on the tree.
and was with you (PL) in weakness and in fear and in great trembling.
and this word my and my preaching have not been with persuasive words of wisdom, but with proof of Spirit and power,
so that your faith shall not be in human wisdom, but in the power of Hashem.
wisdom however speak we among the perfection, yet not the wisdom of world the this, also not of the rulers of the this one world, who become lost;
but we speak the wisdom of Hashem in a mystery, the concealed (wisdom), which Hashem has from long ago predetermined for our glory sake;
which anyone of the rulers of the this one world has it not known; because would they it yes known, would they not hung up on the tree the L-rd of glory;
but as it stands written:
to us however did Hashem it revealed through His Spirit; because the Spirit searches everything out, even the depths of Hashem.
because who among men knows what (is happening) in a man, if not the man's spirit in him? also so knows anyone not who it is in Hashem, except Hashem's Spirit.
and we have not received the spirit of the world, but the Spirit, which is from Hashem; so that we shall know, what it is us given become of Hashem.
about this speak we also with words, which not human wisdom teaches, but which the Spirit the Holy teaches; comparing spiritual things with spiritual (words).

the natural man however receives not on that (which comes) from Hashem's Spirit; because it is a foolishness for him; and he can it (at all) not understand because it must judged become in a spiritual way.
the spiritual (man)—(man of the Spirit)—however judges everything, and is himself by anyone not judged.
because who did know the Spirit of the L-rd (G-d), that he shall Him (something) teach? we however have the Spirit of the Moshiach. (Yeshayah 40, 13)
and I, brothers, could not speak to you (PL) as to spiritual (men) but as to fleshly, as to suckling infants in the Moshiach.
milk did I you (PL) give to drink, not any (solid) food; because you (PL) have it not be able to tolerate; and even now can you (PL) it still also not to tolerate;
because you (PL) are still all carnal; because all time there is here among you (PL) envy and discord, are you (PL) then not carnal and lives as (ordinary) men?
because when one says: I am of Paul; and an other: I am of Apollos: are you (PL) (then) not (ordinary) men?
what is then Apollos? and what Paul? only servants, through whom you (PL) had believed; and every one, as the L-rd has him given.
I did plant, Apollos did water; Hashem however did make (it) grow.
so around is already the planter nothing, and the waterer nothing; but Hashem, who makes grow.
the planter and the waterer are one; and each one will received his own reward according to his own labor.
because we are Hashem's co-workers: Hashem's ploughfield, Hashem's building are you (PL).

according to the grace of Hashem, which is me given become, did I as a wise master builders laid a foundation; an another however builds (thereon). let therefore everyone attention give, how he does thereon build.
because anyone can not lay any other foundation, except the one, which (is) laid (already), which is Yehoshua the Moshiach.
if however someone builds on the this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, straw,

will everyone's work revealed become; because the Day will it make (obvious) clear, because it will itself be revealed through fire; and the fire itself will test everyone's work, of what for a sort it is.
will (if) anyone's work, which he has thereon built, remain (standing), will he received a reward.
will (if) anyone's work burned become, will he to suffer loss; himself however will he saved become; yet as through fire.
(question) know you (PL) (then) not, that you (PL) are Hashem's Heikhal, and that the Spirit of Hashem dwells in you (PL)?
if someone destroys Hashem's Heikhal, will Hashem him destroy; because Hashem's Heikhal is holy, and you (PL) are it.
let anyone not deceive. if someone among you (PL) thinks, that he is a wise one in the world, shall he become a fool, so that he shall become wise.
because the wisdom of the this one world is foolishness with Hashem; because it stands written: he catches the wise ones in their cunning; (Job 5, 13.)
and again: the L-rd know the thoughts of the wise ones, that they are futile. (Psalms 94, 11.)
let himself therefore anyone not boast in man. because all is yours,
whether Paul, or Apollos, or Kefa, or the world, or the life, or the death, or the present, or the future: all belongs to you (PL),
and you (PL) to the Moshiach, and the Moshiach to Hashem.
so then shall us (every) man consider, as servants of the Moshiach and as stewards of the mysteries of Hashem.
here moreover it is required with stewards, that every one shall found to be faithful.
for me however is it a small thing judged to become by you (PL), or by a human day (of judgment); even alone judge I myself also not.
because I know nothing against me alone; but with the this am I (yet) not justify; it you (PL) however the L-rd, who does me judge.

therefore shall you (PL) nothing judge before the future time, until the L-rd will come, who also lights up the hidden things of the darkness and reveals the desires of the hearts; and then will every one receive his praise from Hashem.

and this, brothers, did I apply to me alone and to Apollos of for your sake; so that you (PL) shall in us learn (what it means): not outside of that, which it stands written! so that anyone shall self not inflate as the one against the other.

because who makes you exceptional? and what (such) have you, which you (SG) have not received? if however you (SG) have (it now indeed) received, why do you boast yourselves, as you (SG) would it not received have?
even now, you (PL) are already filled become, you (PL) are already rich become, you (PL) reign already—without us; and I wish would you (PL) did reign, so that we should reign along with you (PL).

because it seems to us out, that Hashem has us, the Shlichim, brought out as (the very) last, as sentenced to the death; because we have become a spectacle before the world and before angels and before men.
we (are) the fools because of Moshiach, you (PL) however (are) wise ones in the Moshiach; we—weak ones, you (PL) however—warriors; you (PL) have honor, we however (become) scorned.
until to the present hour hunger we and thirst, and are naked, and are beaten and have not any home;
and labor, working with (our) own hands; cursed they us, bless we, being us persecuted, hold we out;
insulted are we, speak we sweet words; like the garbage of the world did we become, everyone's rubbish until now.
not you (PL) to shame write I this, but, like beloved children of mine, you (PL) to say warning.

because when even you (PL) would have had ten thousand guides in the Moshiach, have you (PL) however not had any many fathers; because in the Moshiach Yehoshua have I you (PL) fathered through the News Good.
therefore ask I you (PL), be my imitators.

Thus on account of that have I sent to you (PL) Timothy, who is my beloved and faithful child in the L-rd, who will you (PL) remind my ways in the Moshiach Yehoshua, as how I teach everywhere in every kehile.
some have themselves conceited, like as I would not come to you (PL).
I will however soon come to you (PL), if wills Hashem, and will find out, not the words of the inflated, but the might their.
because the kingdom of Hashem is not in word, but in might.
what wish you (PL)? shall I come to you (PL) with a rod, or with love and with the spirit of humility?
everywhere hears one about fornication among you (PL), and such a fornication, which (happens itself) even not among the nations (of the world), that someone shall have the father's wife.
and you (PL) are arrogant? should you (PL) not rather ought to grieve, so that the one, who did such a deed, shall taken away to be from your midst?
because I, although distant from you (PL) that pertains the body, however with you (PL) in the spirit, have already judged, like as I would have been present, the one, who has this these so done,
that in the Name of our L-rd Yehoshua, while you (PL) will yourselves gather together and my spirit with you (PL) with the power of the L-rd our Yehoshua,
to turn over such people to the Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that the spirit shall saved to be in the Day of the L-rd.
your boast self is not good. (question) know you (PL) then not, that a small amount of yeast makes sour the whole dough?
clean out then out the old yeast, so that you (PL) shall become a new dough; just as you (PL) are unleavened. because also our (sacrifice) Pesach has sacrificed become, the Moshiach;
let us then so keep Yom Tov, not with the old yeast, also not with the yeast of evils and anger, but with the unleavened bread of purity and truth.
I have (to) you (PL) written in a letter, that you (PL) shall yourselves not mix with with fornicators;
yet (means this not) in general not with the fornicators of the world, or with the extortioners and robbers, or idolater; because you (PL) would then need to depart from the world;

now however have I (to) you (PL) written, that you (PL) shall yourselves not mix with, when someone, who calls himself brother, is an adulterer, or a gelt greedy, or a idolater, or a reviler, or a drunkard, or a robber; with such people shall you (PL) even not eat together.
because what has it to do with us to judge the (ones), who are outside (of the kehile)? you (PL) judge yet even not the (ones), which are inside!
the (ones) however outside will Hashem judge. clean out out the evil man from among you (PL).
how dare one of you (PL), who has something against an other, himself to litigate before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?
or know you (PL) not, that the saints will judge the world? and if the world will judged to be by you (PL), (question) are you (PL) then not worthy to judge in trifling matters?
(question) know you (PL) then not, that we will judge angels? all the more reason already what is concerning laws of Mammones!
and you (PL), if you (PL) have something (to decide) which relates to laws of Mammones, seat/install you (PL) the not esteemed in the kehile for judges?
to your shame say I this. so if, there is found actually not any one wise among you (PL), who would be able to conciliate among brother and brother?
but a brother goes to trial himself with a brother, and the these (does he) before the unbelievers!

above all is it already a decline for you (PL), that you (PL) have among yourselves litigation issues. why suffer you (PL) not rather an injustice? why allow you (PL) yourselves not rather be deprived?
but you (PL) yourselves do injustices and deprive, and the these (do you (PL) to) brothers!

or know you (PL) not, that unrighteous will not inherit the kingdom of Hashem? deceive yourselves not alone: not any fornicators, not any idolater, not any adulterers, not any masters of lusts, not any man defiler,
not any thieves, not any (money) greedy, not any guzzler, not any blasphemers, not any robbers, will inherit the kingdom of Hashem.

and such are some of you (PL) were; but you (PL) are washed become, but you (PL) are sanctified become, but you (PL) are justify become in the Name of the L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach and in the Spirit of our G-d.
all is for me permitted (quote unquote); however not all is good (for me). all is me permitted (quote unquote); however I want of nothing become dominated.
foods for stomach, and the stomach for the foods (quote unquote); Hashem will however this and those will destroy. the body is not for fornication, but for the L-rd; and the L-rd for the body;
and Hashem did rouse/awaken the L-rd (from the dead), and will us also raise through his power.
(question) know you (PL) then not, that your (PL) bodies are body parts of the Moshiach? shall I then take the body parts of Moshiach and them make for the body parts of a harlot? mercy and peace!
or know you (PL) not, that the one, who unites himself with a harlot, is one body (with you (PL))? because he says: the two will be one flesh. (Genesis 2, 24.)
the one however, who unites himself with the L-rd, is one spirit.
escape then from fornication. every sin, which a man commits, is outside of the body (quote unquote); the one however, who is fornication, sins against his own body.
or know you (PL) not, that your body is a Heikhal for the Spirit the Holy, who is in you (PL), whom you (PL) have from Hashem? and you (PL) belong not to self alone,
because you (PL) are (with) price bought become; therefore shall you (PL) give glory to Hashem in your body!
and concerning the one (the matter), what you (PL) did write; it is good for a man not to touch a woman (quote unquote).
but on account of fornication shall every (man) have his own wife, and every woman her own husband.
let the man give his debt to the wife; and exactly so the wife the man.
the wife has not any authority to say over her own body, only the man; and just so has the man not any authority to say over his own body, but the wife.

separate yourselves not up one from the other, except if you (PL) are in agreement thereon until to a certain time, so that you (PL) shall yourselves devote to prayer, and come yourselves again together, so that the Satan shall you (PL) not bring to any temptation through your non restraint.
and the these say I in the way of permission, not as a directive.
I would have wanted, that all men should be as I am myself. but every one has his own gift from Hashem, this one thus, and that (one) thus.
and to the unmarried and to the widows say I: it is good for them to remain so, as I am.
but if they can self not restrain, let them marriage have; because it is better marriage to have than to burn (from desire).
and the married say I on, not I, but the L-rd, that a woman shall self not separate from the man;
but if she does herself separate, let her remain not married, or herself be reconciled with the husband; and a man shall not leave his wife.
to the others however say I, not the L-rd, if a brother has a unbelieving wife, and she agrees to live with him, shall he her not leave.
and if a wife has an unbelieving husband, and he agrees one with her to live, shall she not leave the husband.

because the unbelieving husband becomes sanctified through the wife, and the unbelieving wife becomes sanctified through the brother; because if not, would your (PL) children be unclean, they are now however holy.
if however the unbeliever wants self separate, let he self separate: in such cases is the brother or the sister not slavishly bound; then Hashem has you (PL) called (to life) in peace.
because what you know, wife, perhaps will you save the husband? or what you know, husband, perhaps will you save your wife?
but how the L-rd has everyone assigned, as Hashem has everyone called, so shall he himself conduct. and so give directive I in all kehiles.
is the one called (when) a circumcised? let him not to be uncircumcized, is someone called as an uncircumcised? let him self not circumcised be.
the circumcision is nothing, and the foreskin is nothing; only the observe the commands of Hashem.
let every one remain in the this calling, in which he is called become.
you are called as a servant? make you (SG) not any worries therefore; but if you (SG) can set free become, make the most of it.
because who it is called in the L-rd as a slave, this one is the the L-rd's a freed (man); just as so is the one, who is called as a free (man), a slave of the Moshiach.
you (PL) were (with a) high price bought become; be then not any slave of men.
brothers, shall every one remain in the station, in which he is called become before Hashem.
and concerning virgins, have I not any command of the L-rd; I give only my opinion, as such a person, which has received mercy by the L-rd, to be faithful.
I hold therefore the these for good on account of the present difficult time, that it is good for a man so to remain:
you are bound to a wife? seek not free to become. you are free become from a wife? seek not any wife.

and when you (SG) you shall even get married, you have (also) not sinned; and when the virgin has wedding, did she (also) not sin. such will however have troubles in the flesh; and I wants this you (PL) spare.
I say however the these, brothers: the time is short, so that from now on should those, which have wives, be, as they would not have had;
and those who weep, as they would not weep; and those, who are self rejoicing, as they would self not rejoice; and the (ones), who buy one, as they would nothing possess;
and those, who deal with the world, as they would it not deal with; because the form of the this one world passes away.
and I want you (PL) shall be without worries. the not married is concerned self for the things of the L-rd, how he shall please the L-rd;
the married one is concerned self about the things of the world, how he shall please his wife;

and he is divided. and the not married woman and the virgin cares for self for the things of the L-rd, so that she shall be holy both in the body as well as in the spirit; the wedding had (woman) however cares for self about the things of the world, how she shall please the husband.
and I say the these for your own benefit; not in order that to cast a net upon you (PL), but as it is seemly, and (that) you (PL) shall be able to serve the L-rd without distraction.

if however someone thinks, that he does on his virgin a shame, if she should pass her ripe years, and it is thus like a debt, let (that) he do, what he wants; he commits not any sin; they permitted wedding to have.
the one however who stands firm in his heart, because he is not compelled, and has power over his own will, and has the these decided in his own heart to keep his virgin, does he well.
so around also that (one), who power wedding his virgin, does well; and that (one), who makes her not marry, will do better.
a wife is bound as long as the husband of her lives; and when you (PL) husband dies, is she free to marry with whomever she wants; only in the L-rd.
better however it is you (PL), according to my opinion, when she remains thus; and it seems to me, that also I have the Spirit of Hashem.
and what relates to sacrifices to idols: know we, that we all have knowledge (quote unquote). the knowledge puffs up, the love however builds up.
if one speaks self one, that he knows something, knows he yet not, as he should know;
who however it has love (for) Hashem, that (one) is by Him known.
therefore, about eating of sacrifices to idols, know we, that an idols is nothing in the world, and that it is not any G-d except the one.
and when even there find self so called g-ds, whether in heaven, or on the earth, as there are actually there a many g-ds and a many l-rds,
yet for us—just one G-d, the Father, from whom all things are, and we (exist) for Him; and one L-rd, Yehoshua the Moshiach, through whom all is, and we (exist) through him.
the (this very) knowledge is however not in everyone; but some, in the custom/habit until now to the idols, eat it as a sacrifice to idols; and because their conscience is weak, becomes it defiled.
food however brings us not nearer to Hashem; neither (do) we to lose, when we eat not, nor (do) we gain, when we eat yes.
see however that the these freedom (of) yours (PL) shall not become any stumbling block for the weak.

because if someone sees you, who has knowledge, sitting (at the table) in the idol temple, might will then not the conscience of the one, who is weak, be encouraged to eat of the sacrifices to the idols?
and through your knowledge becomes the weak one lost, the brother, for whom the Moshiach is died.
and sinning thus against the brothers, and wounding their weak conscience, sin you (PL) against the Moshiach.
therefore, if a meal misleads my brother to the temptation, will I on eternal never way more not eat any meat, so that I shall not mislead my brother to the temptation.
(question) am I then not free? (question) am I then not a Shliach? (question) have I then not seen our L-rd Yehoshua? or are you (PL) then not my work in the L-rd?
if for others am I not a Shliach, yet for you (PL) am I yes; because the seal of my Shlichus are you (PL) in the L-rd.
my defense for those, who judge me, is this:
(question) have we then not any right to eat and to drink?
or have we then not any right be accompanied by a sister as a wife? as also the other Shlichim and the brothers of the L-rd and Kefa.
or am I it alone and Bar-Nabba, that we have not any right not to work?
when serves there a soldier on his own expenses? who plants it a vineyard, and eats not its fruit? or who tends/feeds a flock, and eats not of the milk of the flock?
I speak this simply as a man? or says not it? even the Torah?
because in law of Moses stands written: you (SG) you shall not shut/muzzle an ox the mouth, when he treads (the grain). (Deuteronomy 25, 4) or concerns Himself then Hashem (only) for oxen?
or says he it for our sakes in general? yes, for our sakes is it written become; because the plower must plow with hope, and the thresher with hope to have a share.
if we have you (PL) sown spiritual things, is it such great thing, if we should reap your (PL) material things?

if others have a share in the right over you (PL), have we then no longer (right)? we however have not used the these right, but we endure anything, so that we should not create any kind of hindrance for the News Good of the Moshiach.
or know you (PL) then not, that those, who occupy themselves with holy ministries, eat of the things in Beis HaMikdash, and those, who serve/attend at the altar, have a share in altar?
and thus has also the L-rd commanded for those, who say/preach on the News Good, to live from the News Good.

I however have myself not made use with any of the these things; and have this not written, so that should it thus do in relation to me; because it is me rather to die, than someone shall negate make my glory.
because if I announce the good News, have I not with what myself to boast, because upon me lies a debt; because woe is me, when I announce not the good News!
because if I do the these willingly, have I a reward; if however not gladly/willingly (of my own will)—is it a stewardship/commission me entrusted.
what then is my reward? that announcing the News Good, shall I propose the News Good free of charge, and not make any use of my right in the good News.
because being free of (to) everyone, have I myself made for everyone's servant, so that I shall more (people) gain.

and to Jews did I become as a Jew, so that I shall gain Jews; to the (ones), who are under the (stickler legalism) Torah, as under the (stickler legalism) Torah, not being myself under the (stickler legalism) Torah, so that I shall gain the (ones), who are under the (stickler legalism) Torah;

to the (ones), who are without a Torah, as without a Torah, yet not being as without a Torah before Hashem, but in the Torah of the Moshiach (Acts 21:20), so that I shall gain the (ones), who are without a Torah.
I am become to the (ones) weak a weak one, so that I shall gain the weak; I am become all things to (to) all men, so that by all means shall I save some.
and all do I on account of/because of the good News, so that I shall have a share in you (PL).
(question) know you (PL) then not, that the (ones), who run in the arena, run really all, one however reaches the prize? so shall you (PL) run, so that you (PL) shall it received.
and every boxer controls himself in everything. and they (do it) so that they should received a perishable crown; we however an imperishable.
therefore run I so, not as in the darkness; thus box I, not as one, who strikes the air;
but I suppress my body and keep it in slavery, so that while I have preached to others, shall I myself not rejected to be.
because I want not from you (PL) to conceal, brothers, that all our fathers are under the cloud, and all did pass through the sea;
and all are mikveh immersed become to Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
and all did eat the same spiritual food (Exodus 16:15);
and all did drink the same spiritual drink (Ex 17:1–7); because they did drink from the spiritual rock, who has them accompanied; and the rock was the Moshiach.
but in the most of them did Hashem not have any pleasure; because they did perish in the desert.
and the these things did occur as previews for our sakes, so that we should not desire for the evil, as those did lust.
and you (PL) shall also not be any idolater, as a some of them; as it stands written: the people did themselves sat down to eat and drink, and did get up to play. (Exodus 32, 6.)
and let us also not fornication do, as a part of them did fornication do, and there were fell in one day three and twenty thousand.
let us also not test the L-rd (G-d), as a part of them did put to the test, and were killed by the snakes.
murmur also not, as a part of them did murmur, and were killed by the destroyer.
this all is to those happened for a preview, and it is written become as a reproof for our sakes, to whom the world times have attained their goal.
therefore the (one), who thinks, that he stands, shall attention give, that he shall not fall.

any temptation has you (PL) not seized, except that which a man can to tolerate; Hashem however is faithful, Who will you (PL) not allow tested become above your (PL) powers; but together with the temptation will He also make an escape, so that you (PL) shall be able to withstand.
therefore, beloved my, shall you (PL) flee from idolatry.
I speak as to those with understanding; judge you (PL) yourself, what I say.

the cup of blessing, upon which we make a blessing, (question) is it then not sharing with the blood of the Moshiach? the bread/matzah, which we break, (question) is it then not sharing with the body of the Moshiach?
because there is one bread/matzah, are we, the many, one body; because we all have a share in the one bread/matzah.
look upon Israel according to flesh: (question) are then not those, who eat the sacrifices, participant in the altar?
what then is it then that I say? that a sacrifice to an idol is something? or that the idol (itself) is something?
but that what the nations (of the world) are sacrificing, are they sacrificing to demons and not to Hashem; and I want not, that you (PL) shall come into sharing with demons.
you (PL) can not drink the cup of the L-rd and the goblet of demons; you (PL) can not partake at the table of the L-rd and at the table of demons.
or shall we enrage the L-rd? (question) are we then stronger than He?
all is permitted (quote unquote); not all however useful. all is permitted (quote unquote); not all however builds up.
let anyone not seek the his own, but the other's (good).
everything, which they sell in the butcher shop, shall you (PL) eat, and not investigate be on account of the conscience;
because the earth is the L-rd's (Hashem's), and you (PL) fullness. (Psalms 24, 1.)
and if someone of the unbelievers will you (PL) invite to a feast, and you (PL) want to go, shall you (PL) eat all, that they will place before you (PL), and not inquire on account of the conscience.
if however someone will to you (PL) say: the these is a idol sacrifice—shall you (PL) it not eat on account of that one, who has it you (PL) reminded, and because of the conscience:
conscience, say I however, not your own but the other one's; because why shall my freedom judged become by an another's conscience?
if I benefit something with a blessing, why shall shall I be maligned about that, upon which I make a blessing?
therefore, if you (PL) eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to Hashem's glory.
be not any stumbling block for Jews, nor for Greeks and not for the kehile of Hashem;
so as also I (make an effort self) to to please everyone in everything, not seeking my own benefit, but the (benefit) of a many (others), so that they should saved become.
be my followers (imitators), just, as also I am (follower) of the Moshiach.
I praise you (PL), brothers, that you (PL) remember me in everything, and you (PL) hold fast the traditions, as I have them you (PL) handed over.
I want you (PL) however let know, that the head of every man is the Moshiach; and the head of the wife is the man; and the head of the Moshiach is Hashem.
every man, when he does prayer or says prophecies and his head is covered (cross dressing like a hooded woman), put to shame/dishonors his head.
and every woman, when she does prayer or says prophecies and her head is unveiled (without tsnyeus), disgraces her head; because it is one and the same as if she would self (head) shave.
because if a woman covers herself not, let her herself also be shorn; and if it is a worry for a woman herself (to be) shorn or shaved (the hair), let her herself coverup.
because the man indeed is not obligated himself to cover the head, because he is Hashem's reflection and glory; the woman however is the glory (reflection) of the man.
because not the man is from the woman, but the woman from the man;
also is the man not created become for the sake the woman, but the woman for the sake the man;
therefore is the woman obligated to have (a sign of man's) rule on the head for the angels sake.
yet is not the woman without the man, not the man without the woman in the L-rd.
because as the woman is from the man, so is the man also through the woman; all however is from Hashem.
judge you (PL) among self alone: is it proper, that a woman shall prayer do to Hashem not covered up?
or teaches then you (PL) not the nature itself, that if a man has long hair, is it a dishonor for him?
a woman however, if she has long hair, is it her glory; because the long hair is her given become as a veil.
if however someone has in mind to to be a lover of dissensions, have we not such custom, the kehiles of Hashem also not.
and enjoining you (PL) the these, praise I you (PL) not, because you (PL) comes together not to the better, but to the worse.
because first hear I, that when you (PL) gather yourselves in the kehile, are there dissensions among you (PL); and a part thereof believe I.
because it is necessary, that it shall be among you (PL) schisms, so that the tested should known become among you (PL).
and when you (PL) come yourselves together, it is it not in order that to to eat the feast of the L-rd;
because every one proceeds with his own meal while eating; and one is hungry, and an other is drunk.

(question) have you (PL) then not any houses, (where) to eat and drink? or are you (PL) degrading the kehile of Hashem? and put to shame the (ones), who have not? who shall I you (PL) say? shall I you (PL) praise? for this praise I you (PL) not.
because I have it received from the L-rd, which I have you (PL) also handed over, that the L-rd Yehoshua did in the night, in which he was handed over become, took bread;
and making a blessing, did he it break and said: this is my body, which is being broken for your sake; do the these in memory of Me.
also so the goblet after the feast, saying: the this one cup is the new covenant in my blood; this do every time, when you (PL) drink (from it), in memory of Me.
because every time, when you (PL) eat this bread and drink the this cup, say (announce) you (PL) on the the L-rd's death, until he will come.
consequently, who it eats this bread or drinks this cup of the L-rd unworthily, that (one) is guilty himself against the body and the blood of the L-rd.
but let a man himself test/prove, and so eat from the bread and drink from the cup.
because who it eats and drinks unworthily, that (one) eats and drinks a judgment for himself, because he did not make any distinction between the the L-rd's body.
on account of that can be found among you (PL) a many feeble and sick, and not a few are asleep (the sleep of death).
if however we would self alone examine, would we not judged be.
become we however judged by the L-rd, become we disciplined, so that we shall not condemned become together with the world.
therefore, brothers of mine, when you (PL) come together to eat, wait one on the other.
and if someone is hungry, let him eat at home, so that you (PL) shall yourselves not gather together for a judgment. and the rest will I remedy do, as soon I will come.
and concerning (gifts) from the Spirit, brothers, want I not, you (PL) shall be uninformed.
you (PL) know (after all), that when you (PL) were nations (of the world), how you (PL) had yourselves let guided to mute idols, and it had you (PL) led.
therefore let I you (PL) know, that anyone, who speaks through Hashem's Spirit, says not: cursed shall be Yehoshua; and anyone can not say: Yehoshua is L-rd Adon, except through the Spirit the Holy.
the gifts however are diverse, but the Spirit is the same.
and the ministries are diverse, yet is it the same L-rd.
and the operations, are diverse however the same Hashem, who works all things in all mentshn.
each one however is given the manifestation of the Spirit (the Holy) to (some) benefit.
because one is given through the Spirit a word of wisdom (Acts 16:6,7); and an other a word of knowledge (Acts 5:3), according to the same Spirit;
an other faith (Mat 17:20) in the same Spirit; and an other gifts of healing (Acts 8:7), through the one Spirit;

and an other to do wonders (1 Kgs 17:1); and an other, prophecy (Acts 11:28); and an other, to differentiate (Acts 16:16) spirits; an other, kind tongues (Mark 16:17); and an other, interpretation (1 Cor 14:27) of the tongues;
this all however is done by one and the same Spirit (the Holy), who distributes out every one individually, as He wants.
because as the body is one, and has a many body parts, and these all body parts of the body, (although) they are a many, are one body; so also is the Moshiach.
because in one Spirit are we all immersed become in the mikveh to one body, both Jews and Greeks, as slaves as free (men); and we did all drink become with one Spirit.
then the body is not one member, but a many.
if the foot shall say: because I am not any hand, do belong I not to the body, belongs he then not on account of that to the body?
and if the ear shall say: because I am not any eye, do belong I not to the body; (question) belongs not it? on account of that to the body?
if the entire body were an eye, where would have been the sense of hearing? and if it would wholly have been hearing, where would have been the sense of smell?
now however did Hashem situated the body parts, every one of them in the body so as he did want.
and if all would have been one member, where were the body?
now however are there actually a many members, but one body.
and this eye can not say to the hand: I need you not have; or again the head to the feet; I need you (PL) not have!
but on the contrary, the body parts of the body, which appear out to be the weaker ones, are (in fact) necessary.
and the (parts) of the body, which we regard to be not so noble, the these dress we with more honor; and our not respectable (ones) clothe we the most;
our respectable (ones) however need it not; yes, Hashem has (so) composed the body, that He did lavish more honor to the less important (member),
so that there shall not be any division in the body; only that the members shall care for one the other.
and if one member suffers, to suffer all members with (it); and if one member receives honor, rejoice themselves all members with (it).
and you (PL) are Moshiach's body, and members each one individually.
and Hashem did some appoint in the kehile, first Shlichim, second nevi'im, third teachers, then wonders, then gifts of healing, helpers, stewardship, various tongues.
(question) are then all Shlichim? (question) are then all nevi'im? (question) are then all teachers? (question) (do) then all miracles?
(question) have then all the gifts of healings? (question) speak then all with tongues? (question) interpret then all?
strive however to obtain the greater gifts.
if I speak already with the tongues of men and angels, have however not any love, am I a resounding copper or a jingling cymbal.
and when I have prophecy and know all mysteries and every knowledge; and have even the whole faith, even to to be able to to move mountains, have however not any love, am I nothing.
and when I distribute out my entire fortune to feed the hungry, and when I give over my body to be burned, have however not any love, helps it me nothing.
the love is patient, merciful; the love is not envious; the love boasts self not, blows self no airs;
behaves self not on immodestly, seeks not its own, provokes (to anger) self not, thinks not any evil.
rejoices self not on any wrong, but rejoices yes with the truth;
it covers over all things; believes all things, hopes all things; endure all things over.
the love goes never not under (never fails); but if there are there prophecies, will they come to nought to be; if tongues, will they cease; if knowledge, will it abolished to be.
because we know partly, and our prophecies saying is partial;
when however the perfection will come, will the partial come to nought to be.
when I was a child, have I spoken as a child, have understood as a child, did think as a child; when however I am become a man, have I put aside the childish things.
because now see we in a mirror, and in an enigma; then however face to face; now know I in part, then however will I know (fully), exactly in this way as I am also (fully) known.
and now remains faith, hope, love, the these three; however the greatest of the these is the love.
strive after the love; and desire the spiritual gifts, but preferable, that you (PL) shall prophecies say.
because the one, who speaks in an (unknown) tongue, speaks not to men, but to Hashem; because anyone is not understanding, and he speaks mysteries in the Spirit.
the one however, who says prophecies, speaks to men to build up, and reproof, and comfort.
who it speaks in a tongue, that (one) built up self alone; and the (one), who says prophecies, builds up the kehile.

and I want, that you (PL) shall all speak with tongues, however further, that you (PL) shall prophecies say; and greater is the (one), who says prophecies, than the (one), who speaks in tongues, unless that he shall also interpret, so that the kehile shall receive edification.

because the L-rd Himself will descend from heaven, with a sound, with the voice of the arch angel, and with the trumpet of Hashem; and the dead in the Moshiach will standing up again before all;
