therefore shall you (PL) encourage one the other with the these words.
and what relates to the times and seasons, brothers, have need you (PL) not, that one shall write to you (PL).
because you (PL) yourselves know quite accurately, that the Day of the L-rd comes as a thief in the night.
while it will be said: peace and safety, will then suddenly come on them their disaster, as pangs on a childbirth, and they will never way no escape.
you (PL) however are not in the darkness, that the day shall you (PL) surprise as a thief;
because all are you (PL) children of the light and children of the day; we are not of the night, also not of the darkness;
therefore let us not sleep as the others, but watch and be sober.
because the (ones), who sleep, sleep by night; and the (ones), who get drunk themselves on, getting drunk themselves on by night.
but because we are of the day, let us be sober, let us ourselves clothe with the breast shield of faith and love, and, as a helmet, the hope of salvation.
because Hashem has us not appointed to wrath, but to the obtain salvation through the L-rd our Yehoshua the Moshiach,
who did die for our sakes, so that also whether we are awake or whether we sleep, shall we live together with Him.
comfort then yourselves and build up one the other, as you (PL) do it also.

we ask you (PL) however, brothers, that you (PL) shall recognize the (ones), who toil themselves among you (PL), and are the (ones) who are over you (PL) in the L-rd and speak to you (PL) words of reproof,
and you (PL) shall them grant very much honor with love on account of their work. have peace among yourselves.
and we are you (PL) exhort, brothers, you (PL) shall warn the idle, strengthen the faint of heart, support the weak, be patient in relation to (to) everyone.
see, that anyone shall not repay any one evil for evil; but always shall you (PL) chase after the good one for the other and for all.
rejoice yourselves always;
do prayer without ceasing;
be thankful for everything; because this is Hashem's will in the Moshiach Yehoshua for your sake.
quench not the Spirit;
scorn not prophecies (to say);
test all out, hold firm the good;
move away yourselves from evil in every form.

and the G-d of peace Himself shall you (PL) sanctify through and through; and shall your whole spirit and soul and body kept be without a blemish at the coming again of our L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach.
faithful is the One, who calls you (PL), who will it also do.
brothers, do prayer for us.
give up peace all brothers with a holy kiss.
I adjure you (PL) by the L-rd, that this letter shall read be before all brothers.
the grace of our L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach shall be with you (PL).
Paul and Silvanus and Timothy to the kehile of the Thessalonians in G-d our Father and in L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach;
grace to you (PL) and peace from G-d the Father and the L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach.

we are obligated always to thank Hashem for you (PL), brothers, as is fitting self, because your faith grows very strong, and the love of every one of you (PL) (to) everyone increases itself in relation to the others,

so, that we ourselves boast self about you (PL) in the kehiles of Hashem, over your perseverance and faith in all your (PL) persecutions and troubles, that you (PL) endure over; it is a proof of Hashem's righteous judgment;
so that you (PL) shall considered to be worthy of the kingdom of Hashem, for which you (PL) suffer also;
because it is after all a righteous thing with Hashem to repay troubles to the (ones), who do you (PL) on troubles,
and to you (PL), the troubled ones, place of rest with us at the revelation of the L-rd Yehoshua from heaven with the angels of His power
in a flame of fire, granting a vengeance recompense (to) the (ones), who know not Hashem and are not obedient to the Good News of our L-rd Yehoshua;
the these will suffer a punishment, an eternal destruction from the presence of the L-rd and from the glory of His power,
when He will come glorified to be of His saints, and marvelled at to be in all believers—because our witness say is by you (PL) believed become—in that Day.
therefore do we also always pray do for your sake, so that our G-d shall you (PL) make worthy of this call, and fulfill with power every desire (of yours) to the good; and (every) work of faith;
so that the Name of our L-rd Yehoshua shall glorified be in you (PL), and you (PL) in Him, according to the grace of our G-d and the L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach.
we implore you (PL) however, brothers, about the coming of our L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach and our being gathered ourselves with Him,

that you (PL) shall yourselves not let quickly move in your mind, and not be alarmed, not by any spirit, not by any word, not by any letter as from us, immediately as the Day of the L-rd would already here be;
let you (PL) anyone not mislead never way; because (He will not come) if it will not before all come the fall away heresy (from faith), and the man of sin will revealed be, the son of destruction,
who stands himself opposed and raises up himself over all, that is called G-d or worship; so, that he will himself sit down in the Heikhal of Hashem, showing himself, that he is G-d.
(question) remember you (PL) then not, that while I am yet was with you (PL), have I you (PL) this said?
and now know you (PL), what there holds back, that he shall revealed be in his appropriate time.
because the mystery of lawlessness works already; only the one, who restrains now, must taken away be from the midst.
and then will revealed be the evil one, whom the L-rd Yehoshua will slay with the breath of his mouth and him destroy with the appearing of his coming;
that his coming is according to the working of the Satan with much power and false signs and wonders,
and with every deception of unrighteousness for those, who become lost, because they have not embraced the love of truth, so that saved to become.
and on account of that sends them Hashem a powerful deception, that they shall believe the lie;
so that all shall judged be, which have not believed the truth, but have had a pleasure in wickedness.

we however are obligated always to thank Hashem for you (PL), brothers, beloved of Hashem, because from beginning on did Hashem you (PL) choose to salvation in the holiness by the Spirit and in the faith in (the) truth;
to which He has you (PL) also called through our News Good, to obtaining the glory of our L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach.
stand then fast, brothers, and keep the traditions, which you (PL) have taught been, both through our word, and through our a letter.
and our L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach Himself and G-d the Father ours, who has us love had and us given an eternal comfort and a good hope in His grace,
shall encourage your (PL) hearts and (you (PL)) strengthen in all kinds of deeds good and every good word.
to the end, brothers, do prayer for us, that the word of the L-rd shall run and glorified be, as with you (PL);
and that we should saved be from corrupt and evil men; because not all have the faith.
faithful however is the L-rd, who will you (PL) strengthen and keep from evil.
and we are confident about you (PL) in the L-rd, that what we command you (PL), that do you (PL) and will it do.
and shall the L-rd lead your (PL) hearts to the love of Hashem and to the perseverance of the Moshiach.

and we command you (PL), brothers, in the Name of the L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach, that you (PL) shall self separate from every brother, who leads an idle life and not according to the tradition, which you (PL) have received from us.
because you (PL) yourselves know, that you (PL) ought us to emulate; because we have self not behaved idle among you (PL);
we did to anyone not eat any bread without paying, but with labor and toil, working by night and by day, so that we should not fall for anyone of you (PL) to burden;
not because we have not any right, but so that we ourselves should self you (PL) give for an example, us to copy.
because even when we are was with you (PL), did we you (PL) the these command, that who it want not to work, that (one) shall also not eat.
because we hear, that some among you (PL) lead self on idle, they work not, but meddle themselves in strangers business.
such people however command we and warn in the L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach, that they should work quietly and eat their own bread.
you (PL) however, brothers, be not weary to do deeds good.
and if someone is not obedient to our word through this letter, shall you (PL) the this point out, and yourselves not mix with him, so that he shall himself to be ashamed.
yet shall you (PL) him not consider as any enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
and the L-rd of peace Himself shall you (PL) always give peace and in all ways. may the L-rd be with you (PL) all.
the greeting of I, Paul, with my own hand, which is a mark in every letter; so write I.
shall the grace of our L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach be with you (PL) all!
Paul, a Shliach of the Moshiach Yehoshua according to the command of Hashem our Savior, and the Moshiach Yehoshua our hope,
to Timothy, my true son in the faith: grace, mercy, and peace from G-d the Father and from the Moshiach Yehoshua the L-rd our.
as I have you urged to remain in Ephesus, when I am go to Macedonia, so that you (SG) you shall command some (people), not to teach other teachings (heterodoxy),
and themselves not to occupy with legends and genealogy letters without an end, which lead to disputes more than to edification of Hashem in the faith; (so shall you (SG) do.)
the purpose however of this command is love out of a pure heart and good conscience and sincere faith;
of which some have been deviated, and themselves turned to empty words,
wishing to be teachers of Torah, although they understand nothing, neither what they say, nor what they assert.
we however know, that the Torah is good, when someone uses it according to the Torah,

knowing the this, that the Torah is not enacted for the righteous, but for the unrighteous and rebellious, for the ung-dly and sinners, for the unclean and profane, for those, who strike father and mother, murderers,
for fornicators, ones lying with men, kidnappers, liars, who swear falsely, and whatever there is contrary to the healthy doctrine;
according to the News Good of gloriousness of the blessed G-d, which was me entrusted became.
I thank Him, who did me strong make, Moshiach Yehoshua our L-rd, because He did me consider for trustworthy, appointing me to (His) service;
me, who I am before was a blasphemer and a persecutor and a scoffer; yet did He Himself have mercy on me, because I have it done not knowingly in unbelief;
and the grace of our L-rd did itself very much increase (in me) with faith and love, which is in the Moshiach Yehoshua.
trustworthy is this word, and worthy wholly to be received, that Moshiach Yehoshua is come into the world into to save sinners, of which I am the foremost;

but therefore has He on me mercy had, so that in me before everyone shall Yehoshua the Moshiach show His entire patience, for an example for those, which will first (going to) believe in Him unto eternal life.
but to the King of of eternity, the immortal, invisible, the only G-d, may be His honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
the this commandment place I before you (SG), my son Timothy, according to the prophecies, which are before go about you (SG), that you (SG) shall struggle through the these the good struggle,
having faith and a good conscience, which some have cast away from themselves and suffered shipwreck concerning the faith;
among whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to the Satan, so that they shall learn not to blaspheme.
I am therefore urging, that before all should supplication, prayers, petitions, thanksgiving, done be for all men;
for kings and all rulers, so that we shall lead a quiet and calm life in complete g-dliness and moral earnestness.
the these are good and acceptable before Hashem our Redeemer,
who wants, that all men shall saved be, and come to the knowledge of the truth.
because there is (here) one G-d, and one mediator between Hashem and men, the man, Moshiach Yehoshua,
who was Himself given for a redemption for all; that witness say of it should given be in the appropriate time;
for which I am appointed become as herald and Shliach (the truth say I, and not any lie) a teacher of Torah for the nations of the world in the faith and truth.
therefore want I, that the men should prayer do in every place, lifting up holy hands without anger and dissensions.
also in this way the women should themselves adorn with modest clothing, with respectable comportment and modesty; not with braiding the hair, not with gold, or pearls, or expensive clothing;
but with deeds good, as it becomes for women, who profess themselves to be fearer of heaven.
a woman shall learn quietly with full subjection.
and I give not any woman authority to be teacher of Torah and not to rule over (her) husband, but to be silent.
because Adam is to the first created become, later Eve;
and Adam did himself not let deceive; but the woman, letting herself be deceived, is come to a transgression;
she will however saved be through bearing children, if they will remain in the faith and love and holiness with modesty/tsnies.
this is a faithful word: if one aspires to the position of a Mashgiach (Overseer), desires he a good thing.
the Mashgiach (Overseer) must therefore be without a flaw, a husband of one wife, sober, modest, a humble person, a bringing in stranger, capable teacher;
not any drunkard, not any fighter; but mild, not any quarreler, not any money lover;
who rules well with his own house, holding his children in submission, with full moral earnestness
(if however one know not how to rule over his own house, how then will he be concerned over the kehile of Hashem?);
not any new disciple, so that he shall not become puffed up and fall under in the judgment of Satan.
and he must also have a good name from the outside, so that he shall not fall into in any shame and in the Satan's trap.
also so must the deacons be serious (people), not any double tongued, not any lovers of much wine, not inclined towards shameful gain;
who hold the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
and let the these before all be tested; later should they serve as deacons, if they are without a flaw.
also in this way must the women be serious, not any gossip speakers, temperate, faithful in all things.
deacons should be husbands of one woman, who rule well over their children and over their own houses;
because if they have well served as deacons, obtain they themselves a good position and great boldness in the faith, which is in the Moshiach Yehoshua.
this write I you (SG), hoping to you (SG) to come in a short time,
and if I will myself delayed, so that you (SG) shall know how one needs himself behave in Hashem's house, which is the kehile of the living G-d, the pillar and foundation of the truth.

and not to deny great is the mystery of fearer of heaven: He, who has Himself unveiled in the flesh, is proven just become in the Spirit, did Himself appear to angels, is announced become to the nations (of the world), believed on in the world, received up become into glory.
the Spirit however says expressly, that in later times will some fall away from the faith, holding themselves to deceitful spirits and devilish teachings
through the hypocrisy of liars, who wear in their own (cauterized) conscience a sign (mark) burnt out as with a glowing (hot) iron,
forbidding wedding to have, and (ordering) one shall himself abstain from (certain) foods, which Hashem did create to enjoy with thanksgiving for the believers and who have recognized the truth.
because entire creation of Hashem is good (note: verse says “good”; not “food”), and nothing is rejected, if one receives it only on with a blessing,
because it becomes holy through Hashem's word and through prayer.

if you (SG) will propose the these things before the brothers, will you be a good servant of the Moshiach Yehoshua, brought up in the words of the faith and of the good teaching, which you (SG) you have already followed;
but the profane and old wives legends shall you (SG) avoid. exercise yourself however to fearer of heaven;
because the bodily exercise brings few benefits; fearer of heaven however is of benefit for everything, having a promise for the present life and for the (world) which comes.
trustworthy is this word, and worthy wholly accepted to to be;
because for the this strive we ourselves and are being insulted, because we have put our hope on the living G-d, who is the helper of all men, especially of the believers.
this shall you (SG) command and teach.
shall anyone not despise do your youth, but be an example for the believers, in word, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
until I will come, give attention on the reading, on the exhortation saying, on the teaching.
neglect not within you (SG) the gift of grace, which is you (SG) given become through a prophecy, with laying on of the hands of the elders.
be concerned about the these things; occupy yourself with them, so that your progress shall be obvious clear for every (one).
give attention for you (SG) yourself and for the teaching. remain in them; because (in) doing the these, will you save you yourself, and those, who hear you.
over an elder shall you (SG) yourself not speak harshly, but be him exhort, as a father; the younger (men), as brothers;
older women, as mothers; the younger, as sisters, in complete purity.
give up honor to widows, who are indeed widows.
if however a certain widow has children or grandchildren, let them before all learn to be g-dfearing in their own house and repay good to the parents; because the these is acceptable before Hashem.
the real widow however and solitary has (her) confidence on Hashem, and keeps on with supplication and prayers by night and by day.
and those, who live in pleasures, are the living death.
this shall you (SG) command, so that they shall be without a flaw.
if however someone provides not for his relatives, and above all for his sons of house, has he denied the faith, and is worse than a non-believer.
as a widow shall counted be those, who are not less than sixty years old, the wife of one man,
about whom is it given testimony about her deeds good, if she did brought up children, welcomed strangers, washed the feet of the holy ones, helped the sufferers, followed all kinds of deeds good.
the younger widows however shall you (SG) not accept; because when they live in pleasures against the Moshiach, want they wedding to have;
they deserve a judgment, because they have abandoned their first commitment.
and in the same time learn they to be lazy, going about from house to house; and not only to be lazy, but are also gossips and meddle themselves in the other's business, speaking what they must not.
I want therefore, that the young shall get married, bear children, take care of a household, and not give the opponent any kind of opportunity to slander;
because some have themselves already turned away after the Satan.
if a believing (woman) has widows with herself, shall she them care for, and not fall to burden the kehile; so as (kehile) to be able to care for the real widows.
the elders, who rule well, should considered to be as worthy a double honor, especially those, who toil themselves in word and in the teaching.
because the verse says: an ox while threshing shall you (SG) not muzzle the mouth (Deuteronomy 25, 4), and: the laborer is worthy the wages his.
against an elder shall you (SG) not accept any accusation, except unless according to two or three witnesses.
the sinners shall you (SG) reprove before all, so that even the remaining shall fear have.
I adjure you before Hashem and the Moshiach Yehoshua and the chosen angels, that you (SG) shall observe the these things without discrimination, and nothing do with partiality.
give anyone not any laying on of hands too quickly, participate you not in the sin of others; keep yourself clean.
drink no longer any water, but use a little wine on account of your stomach and the frequent sicknesses of yours.
the sins of some men are plainly clear, and go ahead to the judgment; other men however follow they (sins) after.
and also in the same way the deeds good are plainly clear beforehand, and those, which are not so, can yet not hidden be.
all, who are slaves under yoke, should consider their masters as worthy of every honor, so that Hashem's Name and the teaching shall not blasphemed be.

and those, who have masters believers, shall they not despise do, because they are brothers, but shall them even more serve, for they are believers and beloved, who have a share in the gift (of Hashem). this shall you (SG) teach and exhort.
if someone teaches otherwise and agrees not one with healthy words, the (words) of the L-rd our Yehoshua the Moshiach, and the teaching, which is according to fearer of heaven,
is he arrogant, knows nothing, but craving over controversies and dissensions over words, from which it comes out envy, quarrels, slanders, evil thoughts,
disputes of men with a corrupt understanding and who there lack they the truth, who think, that fearer of heaven is a means to gain.
fearer of heaven however with contentment is a great gain;
because we have nothing brought into the world, and can nothing carry out;
having however food and clothing, let us be content with the these.
however those, who want to get rich, fall into in a temptation and in a snare and in many senseless and harmful lusts, which drown the men in destruction and perditions.
because the root of all evil is the love for money; which some have desired and have misled become from the faith and have self alone pierced with a many sufferings.
you (SG) however, Hashem's man, run from the these things, and pursue after righteousness, fearer of heaven, faith, love, perseverance, humility.
so wrestle yourself the good struggle of the faith, seize on the eternal life, to which you (SG) are called become and you have confessed the good confession before a many witness.
I order you (SG) before Hashem, who makes everything to live, and before Moshiach Yehoshua, who did witness said before Pontius Pilate the good confession,
that you (SG) shall keep this commandment without a spot and without a flaw, until to the revealed to be of our L-rd Yehoshua the Moshiach,
who He will show in the appropriate time the blessed and only Mighty One, the King of kings and L-rd of l-rds,
who only He alone has immortality, and dwells in a light, to which one can not approach, whom any man has not seen and can not see; glory to Him and the Everlasting Might, Amen.

the rich ones in the present world shall you (SG) command, that they should themselves not exalt, and that they should not put their confidence on uncertain riches, only on the living G-d, who gives us everything the left over to enjoy;
that they should do good, become rich in deeds good, be good givers, ready to help;
accumulating (for) themselves a treasure as a good basis for the future to come, so that they shall reach the true life.
o Timothy, observe up that entrusted (to you), avoiding profane and empty words and the opposing opinions of the false named knowledge (quote unquote);
to which some have self profess and have gone astray from the faith. may the grace be with you (PL).
Paul, a Shliach of the Moshiach Yehoshua, through Hashem's will, according to the promise of the life, which is in the Moshiach Yehoshua,
to Timothy, my beloved son: grace, mercy and peace from G-d the Father and the Moshiach Yehoshua our L-rd.
I thank Hashem, whom I serve from my fathers on with a pure conscience, that without ceasing have I you in memory in my prayers, by night and by day.
I long you to see, remembering your tears, so that I shall filled be with joy,
when I remind myself in your sincere faith, which did before all dwell in your grandmother Lois and in your mother Eunice, and have I convinced, that also (is) in you (SG).
on account of this reason remind I you, that you (SG) shall again rekindle (up to a flame) the gift, of Hashem, which is in you (SG) through the laying on of my hands.
because Hashem has us not given any spirit of fear, but of power and love and authority over self alone.
therefore shall you (SG) you not to be ashamed with the witness say of our L-rd, and also not with me, his prisoner; but bear the suffering for the News Good according to the power of Hashem,

who did us save and called with a holy calling, not according to our deeds, but according to his own counsel and grace, which is us given become in the Moshiach Yehoshua before (ahead of) eternal times,
and is now revealed become through the appearing of our Redeemer Moshiach Yehoshua, who did destroy make the death and brought to the light the life and the immortality through the News Good,
for which I am appointed become as a herald, and Shliach, and teacher of Torah.

on account of that cause suffer I actually the these things; yet ashamed I myself not; because I know in whom I have believe, and have myself convinced, that He is able to keep my deposit until to that Day.
keep yourself by the pattern of healthy words, which you (SG) did hear from me, in faith and in love, which is in Moshiach Yehoshua.
watch over up the good deposit through the Spirit the Holy, who dwells in us.
the these you know, that from me have themselves deserted all, who find self in (Minor) Asia, among whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
may the L-rd grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus; because a many times did he me refresh, and himself not ashamed with my chains,
but coming to Rome, did he me diligently search for and found—
may him the L-rd (Yehoshua) give, that he shall find mercy by the L-rd (G-d) in that Day—and how much he did me serve in Ephesus, you know quite well.
therefore you (SG), my son, strengthen yourself in the grace, which is in Moshiach Yehoshua.
and what you (SG) you have heard from me before a many witnesses, this give over to faithful men, who will be competent to teach also others.
suffer along with (us) as a good soldier of the Moshiach Yehoshua.
any soldier entangles himself not in the affairs of this life; so that he shall well please the officer,
who has him taken into soldiery. and when someone wrestles himself as an athlete, becomes he not crowned, if he did himself not wrestle according to the rules.
the farmer, who labors, shall be to the first to enjoy of the fruits.
understand what I say; because the L-rd will you (SG) give wisdom in every thing.
remember Yehoshua the Moshiach, who did stand up again from the dead, is from the seed (of) David, according to my News Good;
for which I suffer even to up to chains, as a criminal; but Hashem's word is not chained.
therefore bear I everything over for the sake of the chosen, so that they also should obtain the salvation in the Moshiach Yehoshua with eternal glory.
this is a faithful word: for if we are died together with him, will we also live together with him;
if we have endured, will we also rule together with him; if we will him deny, will he also us deny;
if we faithful not, remains He (still) faithful; because He can Himself not deny.
this bring all to the memory, charging them before Hashem, themselves not to waver over words, which profit to nothing, (except) to the subversion (of) the hearers.
give you (SG) the effort, yourself to present before Hashem as an approved worker, who needs himself not to be ashamed, who lays out out correctly the word of truth.
avoid however from the unworthy and empty words; because they lead further to a many more evils,
and their word devours like gangrene; from them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,
who have been deviated from the truth, saying, that it is already was resurrection of the dead ones; and turn over the faith of some.
yet Hashem's strong foundation stands firm, having the this seal: the L-rd knows the (ones), who are His, and: may self turn away from iniquity every one, who calls on the the L-rd's Name.
in a large house can be found not only gold and silver pots, but also wooden and earthen ones; and the first to honor and the last to dishonor.
when therefore someone will himself purify from the these, will he be a vessel to honor, holy, useful to the L-rd, prepared for all kinds of deeds good.
flee however from the youthful lusts, and pursue after righteousness, faith, love, peace with those, who call on the L-rd out of a pure heart.
however foolish and childish quarrels shall you (SG) avoid, knowing, that they bring about quarrels.
the L-rd's servant however shall himself not quarrel, but be friendly in relation to (to) everyone, competent to teach (others), a patient,
who speaks with humility reproving to the rebellious; perhaps will Hashem them grant repentance, to the recognition (of) the truth,
and again sober to be (escape) out of the Satan's trap out, who he has them taken captive to his will.
the these however shall you (SG) know, that in the last days will come terrible times.
because the people will be lovers of self alone, lovers of money, boastful, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, g-dless,
inhuman, not inclined forgive to be, fiendish, not restrained, cruel, enemies of good,
betrayers, frivolous, conceited, who have love pleasures more than they have love Hashem;
who have a form of fearer of heaven, denying however the power thereof; also from the these turn you away.
because from the these are the (ones), who steal themselves into in houses and take captive foolish wives, who are loaded with sin and to be misled by various lusts,
who always learning they, and can never not come to the knowledge of the truth.
and exactly like Yanes and Yambres did themselves oppose Moses (Rebbeinu), so stand themselves also the these against the truth; men with a corrupt understanding, rejected who concerning the faith.
they will however far not come; because their foolishness will be plainly clear before everyone, as it is also happened with others.
you (SG) however have followed my teaching, my conduct, my purpose, my faith, my forbearance, my love, my endurance,
my persecutions, sufferings, which did come on me in Antioch, in Iconium, in Lystra; which for a persecutions I did endure; and from all has me the L-rd rescue did.
yes, all, who want live g-dfearing in Moshiach Yehoshua, will persecuted be.
evil men however and deceivers will become worse and worse, will deceive and deceived become.
you (SG) however abide in that, which you (SG) have learned, and which was you (SG) entrusted become, knowing from whom you (SG) have it learned,
and because from childhood on you have known the scriptures the Holy, which can you make wise to salvation through faith, which is in Moshiach Yehoshua.
